npc.a_bearded_woman.greet_msg_1: [LT] GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_captain_1: [LT] I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_captain_2: [LT] Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_key_1: [LT] The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_key_2: [LT] If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_kidnap_1: [LT] Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_kidnap_2: [LT] It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_pirate_1: [LT] In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_pirate_2: [LT] Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_pirate_3: [LT] If only our plan had worked!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_1: [LT] It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_10: [LT] Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_11: [LT] As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_12: [LT] The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_13: [LT] When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_2: [LT] All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_3: [LT] Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_4: [LT] We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_5: [LT] I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_6: [LT] That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_7: [LT] He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_8: [LT] So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plan_9: [LT] He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plundering_1: [LT] As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_plundering_2: [LT] As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_scams_1: [LT] The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_scams_2: [LT] And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_scams_3: [LT] So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_ship_1: [LT] Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_ship_2: [LT] He said the canoes would do for a while. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kw_ship_3: [LT] I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_1: [LT] I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_3: [LT] Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_4: [LT] If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_5: [LT] I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_6: [LT] Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_7: [LT] I am not a princess, I am an actor!
npc.a_beautiful_girl.greet_msg_1: [LT] So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
npc.a_beggar.array_1: [LT] Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
npc.a_beggar.array_2: [LT] However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...
npc.a_beggar.array_3: [LT] His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know? ...
npc.a_beggar.array_4: [LT] So why don't you show your dedication to the poor? Go and help Chavis at the poor house. He's collecting food for people like us. ...
npc.a_beggar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
npc.a_beggar.say_1: [LT] Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you? ...
npc.a_beggar.say_2: [LT] However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit. ...

npc.a_beggar.say_4: [LT] So why don't you show your dedication to the poor? Go and help Chavis at the poor house. He's collecting food for people like us. ...
npc.a_beggar.say_5: [LT] If you brought enough of the stuff you'll see that the king will grant you entrance in his {palace}.

npc.a_prisoner.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics.
npc.a_prisoner.greet_msg_1: [LT] Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
npc.a_prisoner.say_1: [LT] Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, \z I will give you something. Hehehe!
npc.a_prisoner.say_2: [LT] My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. \z Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
npc.a_prisoner.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.
npc.a_restless_soul.greet_msg_2: [LT] Ahhhh! At last someone that can listen to my {story}!
npc.a_strange_chalice.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_1: [LT] 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_10: [LT] Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_11: [LT] Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_12: [LT] Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_13: [LT] Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_14: [LT] Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_15: [LT] One day I'll go and look.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_16: [LT] Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_17: [LT] Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_18: [LT] I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_19: [LT] You shut up. Me not want to hear.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_20: [LT] Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_21: [LT] Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_22: [LT] Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_23: [LT] Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_24: [LT] They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_25: [LT] Me not fight them, they not fight me.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_26: [LT] Me wish I could make weapon like it.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_27: [LT] Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_5: [LT] Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_6: [LT] Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_7: [LT] It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_8: [LT] It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_9: [LT] Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.

npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.greet_msg_1: [LT] I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_1: [LT] My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_2: [LT] I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_3: [LT] This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_5: [LT] Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.greet_msg_1: [LT] What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_10: [LT] These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_12: [LT] I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_13: [LT] Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_14: [LT] Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_15: [LT] Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_16: [LT] The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_18: [LT] Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_19: [LT] Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_20: [LT] You pitiful two-eyed creatures. In our eyes, you look weird. It is pathetic how much you depend on hands and legs. Since we bonelords have more eyes than any creature in the world, it is obvious that you can determine the value of a species by the number of its eyes.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_21: [LT] Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races. The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now. In our language the name of our race is not fix but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_22: [LT] Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic. Your brain is not suited for the mathemagical processing necessary to understand our language.To decipher even our most basic texts, it would need a genius that can calculate numbers within seconds in his brain.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_3: [LT] Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_4: [LT] They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_6: [LT] It's a fine library, isn't it?
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_7: [LT] I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_9: [LT] Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.

npc.ahmet.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.ajax.greet_msg_1: [LT] You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
npc.al_dee.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Take a look in the trade window to your left.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_1: [LT] Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_10: [LT] I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_11: [LT] My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: [LT] It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_13: [LT] If you want to challenge monsters in the {dungeons}, you need some {weapons} and {armor} from the local {merchants}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_14: [LT] If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_15: [LT] Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_16: [LT] The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_17: [LT] Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: [LT] One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_2: [LT] Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_20: [LT] Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_21: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_22: [LT] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_23: [LT] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_24: [LT] I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_25: [LT] Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_26: [LT] Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_27: [LT] Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_28: [LT] A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_29: [LT] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_3: [LT] Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_30: [LT] The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_31: [LT] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_32: [LT] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_33: [LT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_34: [LT] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_35: [LT] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_36: [LT] No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_37: [LT] I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_38: [LT] Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_39: [LT] He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_4: [LT] Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_40: [LT] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_41: [LT] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_43: [LT] Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_45: [LT] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_46: [LT] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_47: [LT] He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_48: [LT] If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_49: [LT] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_5: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_50: [LT] She's currently recovering from her travels in the {academy}. It's always nice to chat with her!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_51: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_52: [LT] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_53: [LT] She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_54: [LT] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_55: [LT] This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_56: [LT] She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_57: [LT] Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_58: [LT] Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_6: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_60: [LT] Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_7: [LT] If you need general {equipment}, just ask me for a {trade}. I can also provide you with some general {hints} about the game.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_8: [LT] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_9: [LT] I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
npc.al_dee.voice_1: [LT] Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.voice_2: [LT] Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.voice_3: [LT] Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.voice_4: [LT] Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
npc.albinius.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.
npc.alesar.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.alexander.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi there |PLAYERNAME|, and welcome to the {magic} store.
npc.alexander.stdmod_1: [LT] Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alexander.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.alexander.voice_1: [LT] Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alia.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.alia.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.alia.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.alia.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.alia.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.alia.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.alia.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.alia.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.alia.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.alia.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.alia.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.alkestios.farewell_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.alkestios.greet_msg_1: [LT] Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
npc.alkestios.kw_fae_1: [LT] Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ...
npc.alkestios.kw_fae_2: [LT] We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: [LT] Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: [LT] We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: [LT] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: [LT] We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: [LT] I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: [LT] It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
npc.alkestios.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.altar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_1: [LT] Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_2: [LT] Find the Golden Anchor and click there, after talk with Navigator.
npc.alternative_rock.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.amanda.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.amanda.stdmod_1: [LT] Well, I would do it myself but I can't leave town for a longer time. Would you be so kind to bring me a vial of holy water from the White Raven Monastery?
npc.amanda.stdmod_10: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.amanda.stdmod_12: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.amanda.stdmod_14: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_15: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.amanda.stdmod_16: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.amanda.stdmod_18: [LT] You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_19: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_2: [LT] I thank you a lot in advance. The power of the holy water from the White Raven Monastery is legendary. For my task it is indispensable. We talk about that when you get back.
npc.amanda.stdmod_20: [LT] A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.amanda.stdmod_21: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.amanda.stdmod_22: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.amanda.stdmod_23: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.amanda.stdmod_24: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.amanda.stdmod_25: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.amanda.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.amanda.stdmod_27: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.amanda.stdmod_28: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.amanda.stdmod_29: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.amanda.stdmod_3: [LT] It's your decision. I will ask the next believing mind that visits the temple of Banor's blood.
npc.amanda.stdmod_30: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.amanda.stdmod_31: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.amanda.stdmod_32: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.amanda.stdmod_33: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.amanda.stdmod_34: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.amanda.stdmod_4: [LT] Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
npc.amanda.stdmod_5: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.amanda.stdmod_6: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_8: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.amanda.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.amarie.voice_1: [LT] Please leave me alone... I have to study.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_1: [LT] What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_2: [LT] The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_3: [LT] The pending freight from the saffron coasts is overdue.
npc.amber.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
npc.amber.stdmod_1: [LT] I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.stdmod_10: [LT] My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
npc.amber.stdmod_11: [LT] Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
npc.amber.stdmod_12: [LT] Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_13: [LT] Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_14: [LT] I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the {sewers}.
npc.amber.stdmod_15: [LT] I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below {Thais}. The small sewer system of {Rookgaard} has some nasty rats to fight.
npc.amber.stdmod_16: [LT] Oh, I fought {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, even {dragons}, and many other creatures.
npc.amber.stdmod_17: [LT] I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
npc.amber.stdmod_18: [LT] Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
npc.amber.stdmod_19: [LT] I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_2: [LT] Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
npc.amber.stdmod_20: [LT] I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_21: [LT] I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_22: [LT] I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_23: [LT] A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_24: [LT] King Tibianus is the ruler of {Thais}. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.amber.stdmod_25: [LT] A fine city, but the {king} has some problems enforcing the law.
npc.amber.stdmod_26: [LT] The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the {mainland}.
npc.amber.stdmod_27: [LT] Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
npc.amber.stdmod_28: [LT] I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
npc.amber.stdmod_29: [LT] If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
npc.amber.stdmod_3: [LT] What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
npc.amber.stdmod_30: [LT] You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
npc.amber.stdmod_31: [LT] The most important tools you need are a {rope}, a {shovel} and maybe a {torch}.
npc.amber.stdmod_32: [LT] One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
npc.amber.stdmod_33: [LT] Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
npc.amber.stdmod_34: [LT] You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
npc.amber.stdmod_35: [LT] I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
npc.amber.stdmod_36: [LT] You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
npc.amber.stdmod_37: [LT] A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_38: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in buying or selling anything.
npc.amber.stdmod_39: [LT] I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
npc.amber.stdmod_4: [LT] Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
npc.amber.stdmod_40: [LT] I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells {tools}.
npc.amber.stdmod_42: [LT] She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my {raft} as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
npc.amber.stdmod_44: [LT] Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
npc.amber.stdmod_45: [LT] To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
npc.amber.stdmod_46: [LT] I heard her offers are extraordinarily good.
npc.amber.stdmod_47: [LT] The oracle is said to show you your {destiny} once you are level 8.
npc.amber.stdmod_48: [LT] She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
npc.amber.stdmod_49: [LT] I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_5: [LT] <sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
npc.amber.stdmod_50: [LT] Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_51: [LT] He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish. <gulps>
npc.amber.stdmod_52: [LT] He's funny in his own way.
npc.amber.stdmod_53: [LT] No, I didn't go to the {bank} yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_54: [LT] A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
npc.amber.stdmod_55: [LT] Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
npc.amber.stdmod_57: [LT] I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
npc.amber.stdmod_58: [LT] An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defense of {Rookgaard}.
npc.amber.stdmod_59: [LT] Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their {prisoner} for a few months.
npc.amber.stdmod_60: [LT] I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
npc.amber.stdmod_61: [LT] It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_62: [LT] In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_63: [LT] My favorite dish is {salmon}. Oh please, bring me some.
npc.amber.stdmod_64: [LT] Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
npc.amber.stdmod_67: [LT] Ok, then I won't tell you another Orcish word.
npc.amber.stdmod_68: [LT] Do you bring me my notebook?
npc.amber.stdmod_69: [LT] Excellent. Here, take this short sword as a reward.
npc.amber.stdmod_70: [LT] Mhm, whatever you have there, it is not my notebook.
npc.amber.stdmod_9: [LT] I fought fierce {monsters}, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest {dungeons} and crossed the {sea} on a {raft}.
npc.amber.voice_1: [LT] I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.voice_2: [LT] Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
npc.amber.voice_3: [LT] What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
npc.amber.voice_4: [LT] Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
npc.amber.voice_5: [LT] <sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.voice_1: [LT] AHHHH THE PAIN OF AGESSS! THE PAIN!
npc.anderson.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.anderson.stdmod_1: [LT] Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.anderson.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you want a passage to
npc.anderson.stdmod_5: [LT] Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to Senja, {Folda} and {Vega} and back to {Tibia}.
npc.anderson.stdmod_6: [LT] We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
npc.anderson.stdmod_7: [LT] We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
npc.anderson.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_2: [LT] Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_3: [LT] If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
npc.anerui.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
npc.anerui.stdmod_10: [LT] The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
npc.anerui.stdmod_11: [LT] We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
npc.anerui.stdmod_12: [LT] The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
npc.anerui.stdmod_13: [LT] Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_14: [LT] Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_15: [LT] I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
npc.anerui.stdmod_16: [LT] That is the race to which I belong.
npc.anerui.stdmod_17: [LT] The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
npc.anerui.stdmod_2: [LT] Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
npc.anerui.stdmod_3: [LT] Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
npc.anerui.stdmod_4: [LT] Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
npc.anerui.stdmod_5: [LT] Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
npc.anerui.stdmod_6: [LT] Watch the sky, it will tell you.
npc.anerui.stdmod_7: [LT] I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
npc.anerui.stdmod_8: [LT] If they ever existed they are gone now.
npc.anerui.stdmod_9: [LT] The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
npc.aneus.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and take care of you!
npc.aneus.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.aneus.stdmod_1: [LT] It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
npc.aneus.stdmod_2: [LT] The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
npc.aneus.stdmod_3: [LT] The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
npc.aneus.stdmod_4: [LT] The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
npc.angelina.greet_msg_1: [LT] The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
npc.angelina.greet_msg_2: [LT] Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
npc.angelo.greet_msg_1: [LT] The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
npc.angelo.greet_msg_2: [LT] Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
npc.angelo.greet_msg_4: [LT] The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
npc.angus.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, what can I do for you?
npc.appaloosa.greet_msg_1: [LT] Salutations, |PLAYERNAME| I guess you are here for the {horses}.
npc.archery.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.
npc.archery.stdmod_1: [LT] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.stdmod_2: [LT] I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Archery's Hut. I am also {selling} ammunitions.
npc.archery.voice_1: [LT] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.
npc.archery_rook.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.

npc.arkulius.stdmod_9: [LT] I have better things to do than helping you. See that ice statue over there? My dear friend Alverus needs to be revived!

npc.aurita.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.

npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.greet_msg_2: [LT] Greetings, mortal. Be aware that you are trying my patience while we are talking.
npc.azalea.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.azalea.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.azalea.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.azalea.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.azalea.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.azalea.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.azalea.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.azalea.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.azalea.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.azalea.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.azalea.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.azalea.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.azalea.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.azalea.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.azalea.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.azalea.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.azalea.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.azalea.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.barazbaz.array_1: [LT] Ancient structures in the sewers you say? Well, our city has had a certain bloody past, even before it has been city at all. But to investigate the archives for what you may have found is a time-consuming process. ...
npc.barazbaz.array_2: [LT] Usually, I'm too much bound to my duties to the city to sacrifice time for such an endeavour. ...
npc.barazbaz.array_3: [LT] But on the other hand, just now is the time of an important decision of the magistrate concerning the funding of the archives. It is a matter easily overlooked by our good citizens. ...
npc.barazbaz.array_4: [LT] If you'd be so kind to place just one of your votes for the funding of the archives, I would be inclined to take the time for your investigation in turn. ...
npc.barazbaz.array_5: [LT] Just go to Marvin in the magistrate and vote for a greater funding of the archives. Afterwards, I might be able to present you with some first results of my investigations on your behalf.
npc.barazbaz.array_6: [LT] Today, we have advanced far more and could have the ruins investigated in a far more efficient way. And that is what I would just recommend you to do: get a necrometer from magistrate Jondrin upstairs and investigate the ruins thoroughly.
npc.barazbaz.say_1: [LT] Ancient structures in the sewers you say? Well, our city has had a certain bloody past, even before it has been city at all. But to investigate the archives for what you may have found is a time-consuming process. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_10: [LT] Something like the ruins you have found. What you have seen there hints to a new incident, though. As if someone or something was searching for something. In the past, when those ruins were buried, people were primitive and superstitious. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_11: [LT] Today, we have advanced far more and could have the ruins investigated in a far more efficient way. And that is what I would just recommend you to do: get a necrometer from magistrate Jondrin upstairs and investigate the ruins thoroughly.
npc.barazbaz.say_12: [LT] I know that handwriting you describe! It belongs to a traveller from far away. Magistrate Sholley introduced him to me and she was quite excited to learn more about our city's past. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_13: [LT] I should have thought of him right in the beginning when I heard the stuff you mentioned. But I haven't seen him for a while. You should ask Sholley about her friend to learn about his whereabouts.
npc.barazbaz.say_2: [LT] Usually, I'm too much bound to my duties to the city to sacrifice time for such an endeavour. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_3: [LT] But on the other hand, just now is the time of an important decision of the magistrate concerning the funding of the archives. It is a matter easily overlooked by our good citizens. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_4: [LT] If you'd be so kind to place just one of your votes for the funding of the archives, I would be inclined to take the time for your investigation in turn. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_5: [LT] Just go to Marvin in the magistrate and vote for a greater funding of the archives. Afterwards, I might be able to present you with some first results of my investigations on your behalf.
npc.barazbaz.say_6: [LT] Excellent! Concerning the ancient ruins that you have found, well, if you are not familiar with the city's history, feel free to browse a few books here. I will only refer to some basics here, so I don't waste your time. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_7: [LT] The first humans that lived here and that we have any records of lived in slavery of an ancient evil. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_8: [LT] The nature of this evil is up to debate, but there are hints that this evil predated the settlement of men and that it perhaps was part of a more ancient civilisation or caused the downfall of the latter. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_9: [LT] After that evil had been overcome, much was sealed away. Some say that only forbidden knowledge had been sealed, but others like me were always worried that more had been hidden. ...
npc.barbara.farewell_msg_1: [LT] LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!

npc.barbara.stdmod_2: [LT] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
npc.barnabas_dee.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
npc.barnabas_dee.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] 'The impetuosity of youth', as my friend Mordecai would say.

npc.bertha.voice_1: [LT] Hey there, need some general goods or paperware?
npc.bertram.say_1: [LT] Oh my! You look so great in your uniform! \z You archpostwomen are not only daring but also beautiful. \z Here take it, that's the key you wanted. Just promise to visit me now and then!
npc.billy.greet_msg_1: [LT] Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
npc.billy.stdmod_1: [LT] Add one fresh dead rat and stir it well...
npc.billy.stdmod_10: [LT] I came here for peace and leisure, so leave me alone with 'time'.
npc.billy.stdmod_11: [LT] Rather give your {money} to me than leaving it at the bank. Hehe.
npc.billy.stdmod_13: [LT] If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
npc.billy.stdmod_14: [LT] I'm a cook, not a priest. If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
npc.billy.stdmod_15: [LT] I'm the best cook around. You can sell most types of {food} to me. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you as well as my offers.
npc.billy.stdmod_17: [LT] If you bring me a fresh rat for my famous stew, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.billy.stdmod_18: [LT] Nah, this is not a real shop. I have some offers, though. If you're interested, just ask me for a {trade}. There are other {merchants} on {Rookgaard} as well.
npc.billy.stdmod_19: [LT] There is so much to explore! Better hurry to get to the continent! Once you're level 8, look for the {oracle}.
npc.billy.stdmod_2: [LT] Argh, if I only had a pan!
npc.billy.stdmod_20: [LT] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.billy.stdmod_21: [LT] There are lots and lots of dusty books. You can read them for some basic knowledge about the world. Then again, you could also ask around in the village.
npc.billy.stdmod_22: [LT] The king and his tax collectors are far away. You'll meet them soon enough.
npc.billy.stdmod_23: [LT] Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}. They make a fortune here with all those wannabe heroes.
npc.billy.stdmod_24: [LT] This island will prepare you for the main continent of {Tibia}. Learn to fight and grow stronger!
npc.billy.stdmod_25: [LT] Don't be scared, you should be safe as long as you stay in town. Dangerous monsters are roaming the {dungeons}.
npc.billy.stdmod_26: [LT] You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around. One example are the {sewers} below Rookgaard.
npc.billy.stdmod_27: [LT] The local sewers are invested by {rats}. Fresh rats give a good stew, you can sell them to me.
npc.billy.stdmod_28: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. Food of almost any kind!
npc.billy.stdmod_29: [LT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.billy.stdmod_3: [LT] Bread, cheese, ham and meat! All fresh!
npc.billy.stdmod_30: [LT] That's right, I'm the god of cooking!
npc.billy.stdmod_31: [LT] I'd love to make pancakes, but I'm lacking a decent {pan}. If you get me one, I'll reward you.
npc.billy.stdmod_32: [LT] Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.billy.stdmod_34: [LT] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.billy.stdmod_35: [LT] I can spell but I don't know any spells.
npc.billy.stdmod_36: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.billy.stdmod_37: [LT] I like him, we usually have a drink or two once a week and share stories about {Willie}.
npc.billy.stdmod_38: [LT] That girl is all about party now. I think she was fed up with {equipment} selling.
npc.billy.stdmod_39: [LT] Now that's one crazy fellow. I usually hear him scream about some hole.
npc.billy.stdmod_40: [LT] He's a fisherman and somehow his hut is always infested with cockroaches.
npc.billy.stdmod_41: [LT] That old hag always finds someone to do her work. I have no clue how she is doing that.
npc.billy.stdmod_42: [LT] Decent guy. He sells general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and so on.
npc.billy.stdmod_43: [LT] She's pretty indeed! I wonder if she likes bearded men.
npc.billy.stdmod_45: [LT] Don't listen to this old wannabe, I'm the best cook around.
npc.billy.stdmod_46: [LT] He never leaves the temple. He spends his time caring for those who newly arrive here. You can ask him for a heal if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.billy.stdmod_47: [LT] That's {Obi's} granddaughter. She helps him out by selling {armors} and {shields}. I think she'll be a beauty when she's grown up.
npc.billy.stdmod_48: [LT] I never see that guy around.
npc.billy.stdmod_49: [LT] Her shop is super-duper exclusive. If you're a premium adventurer, check it out in the western part of town. Lotsa nice offers there.
npc.billy.stdmod_5: [LT] Buying many types of food and ingredients, too!
npc.billy.stdmod_50: [LT] She lives in the very south of this town, selling her potions. Sweet - well, sweet-loving girl.
npc.billy.stdmod_51: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.billy.stdmod_52: [LT] He must have the most boring job there is.
npc.billy.stdmod_53: [LT] I don't like his headmaster behaviour. Then again, he IS the headmaster of the {academy}.
npc.billy.stdmod_54: [LT] Tom the tanner buys what's too nasty or too old to eat, animal-wise. Dead wolves and such.
npc.billy.stdmod_55: [LT] He is one of the king's best men and here to protect us.
npc.billy.stdmod_56: [LT] Have you found a pan for me?
npc.billy.stdmod_57: [LT] A pan! At last! Take this in case you eat something my cousin has cooked.

npc.bozo.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi there, how's it hanging, |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
npc.bozo.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
npc.bozo.stdmod_10: [LT] I wonder if they love my water squirt flowers as much as all other plants.
npc.bozo.stdmod_11: [LT] They are the king's favourites, because they know how to 'bow'.
npc.bozo.stdmod_12: [LT] Did you notice that old knights have their scars just on their backs?
npc.bozo.stdmod_13: [LT] A fitting place for a {jester}. I guess there are worse {jobs} around.
npc.bozo.stdmod_14: [LT] Bozo: Nah, no jests about His Royal Highness.
npc.bozo.stdmod_15: [LT] I rarely leave the castle. It's really stressful to be as popular as me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_16: [LT] This castle is my home. A fitting place for a jester and all other fools. Feel welcome.
npc.bozo.stdmod_17: [LT] I'm a jester, not a doctor!
npc.bozo.stdmod_18: [LT] My name is Bozo. But it's more than a name, it's a lifestyle for me!
npc.bozo.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you know the one with the dragon? Where - and then ... hahahaha! Oh no, I guess I ruined it.
npc.bozo.stdmod_20: [LT] Ever since the first guild was created, there is a great demand of jesters and fools to join them.
npc.bozo.stdmod_21: [LT] Sell? Hmm, I know a little about magic and by chance I can sell you a truly unusual {weapon}.
npc.bozo.stdmod_23: [LT] I know the newest jokes in tibia.
npc.bozo.stdmod_24: [LT] Thank you, I'm fine, the gods are with me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_25: [LT] Pheeew! That sounds disgusting! Are you a cook at Frodo's?
npc.bozo.stdmod_29: [LT] Hey, the little one is almost as funny as me!
npc.bozo.stdmod_3: [LT] The fools' guild? Are you serious? No, of course not! Hahaha!
npc.bozo.stdmod_31: [LT] She's pretty but too serious for my taste.
npc.bozo.stdmod_32: [LT] Humourless old guy! Once, he turned me into a frog for painting his distasteful cave in pink.
npc.bozo.stdmod_33: [LT] A man of steel with a stomach of wax. Never offer him a beer!
npc.bozo.stdmod_34: [LT] He's my baby brother. If you tell him I sent you, he will grant you an extra spell or two.
npc.bozo.stdmod_35: [LT] He sells spell scrolls each day at midnight, but you have to address him that very second.
npc.bozo.stdmod_36: [LT] I better make no jokes about THIS matter.
npc.bozo.stdmod_37: [LT] Did you know that he sells a 'power axe of doom' now? Run and buy it, he only has got three in store.
npc.bozo.stdmod_38: [LT] He would make a fine jester, too.
npc.bozo.stdmod_39: [LT] I know a lot of monster jokes. Just tell me a monster's name, come on.
npc.bozo.stdmod_40: [LT] Why are the experienced heroes quicker than others? ... The demons love fast food!
npc.bozo.stdmod_41: [LT] Where do ghouls buy their robes? ... In a boooohtique!
npc.bozo.stdmod_42: [LT] Why do dragons breathe fire? ... They ate too many sorcerers in chilli sauce!
npc.bozo.stdmod_43: [LT] Why do orcs have green skin? ... They ate at Frodo's!
npc.bozo.stdmod_44: [LT] How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point they have!
npc.bozo.stdmod_45: [LT] If you believe half the rumours he's spreading, you will get in a lot of trouble.
npc.bozo.stdmod_46: [LT] If you are a bad jester, you get a chance to visit them now and then.
npc.bozo.stdmod_47: [LT] What do all little minotaurs want to become when they are grown-ups? ... Cowboys, of course!
npc.bozo.stdmod_48: [LT] Why do trolls live underground? ... Because there are so many pks on the surface!
npc.bozo.stdmod_49: [LT] Why are bonelords so ugly? ... Because their mom and dad were bonelords, too!
npc.bozo.stdmod_5: [LT] I wanted to become a sorcerer, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_50: [LT] Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
npc.bozo.stdmod_51: [LT] Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?
npc.bozo.stdmod_52: [LT] I had a cousin named like that.
npc.bozo.stdmod_54: [LT] Isn't he the author of the book 'Fun with Demons'?
npc.bozo.stdmod_55: [LT] He is kind of a father figure to me. Of course he denies all kinship to me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_56: [LT] He's a smart one. I heared he hid in a foreign country as the first bugs showed up.
npc.bozo.stdmod_57: [LT] I am not foolish enough to believe in the existence of this weapon.
npc.bozo.stdmod_58: [LT] Oh, I saw some demon carvings in the dungeons as I hid there after a little joke on old Stutch.
npc.bozo.stdmod_59: [LT] Yes, they showed demons, seven actually, dancing around a sword! In something like a flaming pit.
npc.bozo.stdmod_6: [LT] I wanted to become a druid, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_60: [LT] Ah, don't ask me! Usually mages and mystics know more about such stuff.
npc.bozo.stdmod_61: [LT] I'm the royal jes ... uhm ... the royal tax-collector! Do you want to pay your taxes?
npc.bozo.stdmod_62: [LT] Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_63: [LT] Thank you very much. I will have a drink or two on your health!
npc.bozo.stdmod_65: [LT] I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
npc.bozo.stdmod_66: [LT] Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_67: [LT] Here you are, I already lessened your load.
npc.bozo.stdmod_68: [LT] You don't know what offer you are missing!
npc.bozo.stdmod_69: [LT] Do you want to buy a 'mace of the fury' for 250 gold?
npc.bozo.stdmod_7: [LT] I wanted to become a paladin, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_70: [LT] Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_71: [LT] And here it is, it suits you well!
npc.bozo.stdmod_72: [LT] You dont know what offer you have passed!
npc.bozo.stdmod_74: [LT] Do you want to kiss me?
npc.bozo.stdmod_75: [LT] Uh, oh! ... I am seeing stars!
npc.bozo.stdmod_76: [LT] Pah, I didn't want to kiss you anyway!
npc.bozo.stdmod_77: [LT] Well, women don't behave necessarily in a ladylike way just because they dress like one!
npc.bozo.stdmod_78: [LT] Has any man said to you that you're not only beautiful but also intelligent?
npc.bozo.stdmod_79: [LT] This is a world of fantasy and full of surprises!
npc.bozo.stdmod_8: [LT] I wanted to become a knight, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_9: [LT] The good thing about them is that they can't be at two places at the same time.
npc.bozo.voice_2: [LT] Do you know the one with the dragon? Where - and then ... hahahaha! Oh no, I guess I ruined it.
npc.bozo.voice_3: [LT] The fools' guild? Are you serious? No, of course not! Hahaha!
npc.brasith.stdmod_1: [LT] You may buy all the things we grow or gather at this place.
npc.brasith.stdmod_10: [LT] Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
npc.brasith.stdmod_2: [LT] We abandoned the gods a long time ago. A short time after they abandoned us.
npc.brasith.stdmod_3: [LT] They are lost, and if they still exist they are alone in the cold and the darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_4: [LT] The Kuridai left the true path and can't see their error. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_5: [LT] We have still much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.
npc.brasith.stdmod_6: [LT] The Cenath forgot as many as they learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.
npc.brasith.stdmod_7: [LT] I don't claim to understand this creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
npc.brasith.stdmod_8: [LT] They are so many, so planless, so divided. They choose a path I do not want for my own race.
npc.brasith.stdmod_9: [LT] Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
npc.brewster.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.brewster.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.brewster.stdmod_11: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.brewster.stdmod_12: [LT] Yes, I have been informed and haven't yet drunk enough to forget, so you can count yourself lucky. Are you prepared to <hicks> receive my line of the prayer?
npc.brewster.stdmod_13: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in <hicks> harmony'. Now, take your stake to Tyrias in <hicks> Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer. I shall let him know what he is to do.
npc.brewster.stdmod_15: [LT] You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.
npc.brewster.stdmod_16: [LT] You have already received my line of the prayer. Don't make me do more work than necessary!
npc.brewster.stdmod_17: [LT] A blessed stake? That's a <hicks> strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.brewster.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.brewster.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.brewster.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.brewster.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.brewster.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.brewster.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.brewster.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.brewster.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.brewster.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.brewster.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.brewster.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.brewster.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.brewster.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.brewster.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.brewster.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.brewster.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.brewster.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.brewster.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.brewster.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.briasol.voice_1: [LT] Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia.

npc.brodrosch.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you want me take you to {Cormaya}, {Farmine} or to {Gnomprona}?

npc.bron.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh no! Was that really me? This is so embarassing, I have no idea what has gotten into me. Was that the fighting spirit you gave me?
npc.bron.stdmod_1: [LT] This... person... makes me want to... say something bad... must... control myself. <sweats>
npc.bruno.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
npc.bruno.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Buy all the fish you want. It's fresh and healthy, promised.
npc.bruno.stdmod_1: [LT] Well, I sell freshly caught fish. You like some? Of course, you can buy more than one at once. *grin* Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.bruno.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, I sell freshly caught fish. You like some? Of course, you can buy more than one at once. *grin* Just ask me for a {trade}.

npc.bruno.stdmod_5: [LT] My job is to catch fish and to sell them here.
npc.bruno.stdmod_6: [LT] Ah yes, my lovely wife. God forgive her, but she can't stop talking. So my work is a great rest for my poor ears. *laughs loudly*
npc.bruno.stdmod_7: [LT] I like this old salt. I learned much from him. Whatever. You like some fish? *grin*

npc.budrik.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hiho, hiho |PLAYERNAME|. Why do you {disturb} me?
npc.budrik.kw_shearton_softbeard_1: [LT] Yes, I remember him well. It was a tragedy. An earthquake led to a cave-in and many of our brave miners died. ...
npc.budrik.kw_shearton_softbeard_2: [LT] Their ghosts still haunt the Grothmok tunnel in which they died, so we had to seal it off.
npc.budrik.stdmod_11: [LT] This is no funhouse. Leave the miners and their drilling-worms alone and get out! We have already enough trouble without you.
npc.budrik.stdmod_2: [LT] We understand the ways of the earth like nobody else.
npc.budrik.stdmod_3: [LT] I'm a miner, not your mother. Go ask someone else.
npc.budrik.stdmod_4: [LT] The hideout of the Horned Fox is probably a dangerous if not lethal place for inexperienced adventurers. It is the source of all the {trouble} around here.
npc.budrik.stdmod_5: [LT] He is a minotaur who was kicked out of Mintwallin. He must have some kind of {hideout} nearby.
npc.budrik.stdmod_6: [LT] This is not an amusement park! Leave the miners and their drilling-worms alone and get out! We've already got enough {trouble} without you.
npc.budrik.stdmod_7: [LT] We occasionally come across nasty beasts in the deepest mines.
npc.budrik.stdmod_8: [LT] My name is Budrik Deepdigger, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.budrik.stdmod_9: [LT] The {Horned Fox} is leading his bandits in sneak attacks and raids on us.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_10: [LT] Our city blends in with the nature surrounding it. Our {druids} take care of that.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_11: [LT] They are our main magic support and play a major role in our battle {tactics}.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_13: [LT] K.I.S.S.! Keep It Simple, Stupid! Complicated tactics are too easy to be crushed by a twist of fate.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_14: [LT] Our elite forces are trained by rangers and druids. In the woods they come a close second to elves.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_16: [LT] Sorry, we don't recruit foreigners. Maybe you can join if you prove yourself in a mission for the queen.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_2: [LT] We are in constant training and in perfect health.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_3: [LT] I am the general of the queen's army. I don't have time to explain this concept to you.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_4: [LT] Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_5: [LT] Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_6: [LT] She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_7: [LT] HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE, OUR NOBLE {LEADER}!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_8: [LT] Queen Eloise is a fine leader for our fair town, indeed!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_9: [LT] The army protects the defenceless males of our {city}. Our elite forces are the {Green Ferrets}.
npc.busty_bonecrusher.voice_1: [LT] Behave yourself as long as you are in Carlin, commoner!
npc.cael.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
npc.cael.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
npc.cael.voice_1: [LT] I wish I could learn more about this strange world.

npc.captain_dreadnought.farewell_msg_1: [LT] You sure you want to spend time on this piece of rock? I can show you the world! Huh.
npc.captain_dreadnought.kw_adventurers_g:
[LT] Those fellows help still green adventurers like you, so you learn the lay of the Tibian Mainlands. \z
		With the adventurer's stone you can reach their guild hall from all major temples. ...
[LT] I recommend you travel there as soon as possible.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_1: [LT] Well, that's really generous of you. That'll feed a lot of hungry mouths for a while. \z Right, now which {city} did you say you wanted to go to?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_2: [LT] Negative, can't bring you there without a premium account. \z You should be glad you get to travel by ship - usually that's a premium service too, you know.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_3: [LT] Cast off! Don't forget to talk to the guide at the port for directions to nearest bars... err, shops and \z bank and such!
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_4: [LT] Kid, listen. Answering with a clear {yes} or {no} will get you much further in Tibia. \z Most people are not as sharp-eared as I am. Got that?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_1: [LT] No smuggling aboard this ship! Only 20 pieces of any creature product allowed!
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_10: [LT] That old place? Sorry, I don't sail there, no loot to be had.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_11:
[LT] Some regions in the world can't be accessed by everyone. Gotta pay, you know? \z
	If you spend some real cash for premium time, I can bring you to much more challenging locations.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_12: [LT] That's what the whole place is called.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_13: [LT] Good. Got all you want to take to the mainland, {yes}? Gear, limbs, loot?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_14: [LT] What? Then what DO you want? Learn about the main Tibian {cities}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_15: [LT] While you take time to ponder, I will just stroll over there and pretend not to listen to you thinking.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_16: [LT] Well, I can tell you stuff about
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_17: [LT] So you know it all, huh? Where do you want me to bring you to, kid? |TOWNS|?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_18: [LT] Do you want to know about
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_19: [LT] So, you've decided on your new home city? Which one will it be?

npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_4: [LT] Come hell or high water, we'll reach any port I sail you to!
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_5: [LT] This island is too small. I need sea water around me.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_6: [LT] Ruby Dreadnought. But it's Captain Dreadnought to you!
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_7: [LT] I'm captain of this little sloop here, the Sea Cat.

npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_18: [LT] This is the only safe landing place on Oramond. The cliffs surrounding the isle are too dangerous, you see.
