npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_3: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you may not have heard of me. I am Captain Gulliver, the first Oramondian for a hundred years to have sailed through the mist to your strange lands.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of the 'Sea Goddess', the splendid and beautiful ship you see over there.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_6: [LT] I am the captain of the 'Sea Goddess', the splendid and beautiful ship you see over there.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_7: [LT] The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_8: [LT] Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_9: [LT] I will gladly take on board everything you wish to transport. No pets, though.
npc.captain_gulliver.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Thais and Krailos! Visit the strange lands!
npc.captain_haba.greet_msg_1: [LT] Harrr, landlubber wha'd ya want? Askin' for a {passage}?
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_1: [LT] Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_10: [LT] Dis is no passenger ship it's a WARship. I'm on hunting business.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_11: [LT] Never heard of him. He is no captain that's for sure, otherwise I'd know him. I was on the sea for the last 20 years hunting this, this monster.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_12: [LT] Yee, I've been chasing that monster for over 20 years now. I promise I'll bring it down!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_13: [LT] It lets me forget the long years, the lost years. The years I was chasing after THAT monster, the sea serpent.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_15: [LT] Our last ship has been destroyed by the most evil creature of the ocean: the sea serpent. To continue our hunt, I've bought this ship here.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_17: [LT] I'm faithful - I'll catch that monster one day. Yes I will, as sure as my name is Captain Haba!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_18: [LT] On the high seas there is no queen. At least I didn't see her yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_19: [LT] On the high seas there is no king. At least I didn't see him yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_2: [LT] In the rigging ya lazy fools!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_20: [LT] Arms, legs, head, whatever. I got injuries on almost every part of my body!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_21: [LT] This is no shop boy, this is a warship!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_22: [LT] We aren't even near that location! Wanna swim? Harharhar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_23: [LT] I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_24: [LT] My worst enemy is a huge sea serpent. I dunno when I started to follow it's trail. I'll kill it and if it's the last thing I'll do, I'll kill it!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_25: [LT] This is a ship and the captain is some kind o' leader, isn't he? <mumbles>..stupid..landlubber.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_26: [LT] What fo' godsake shall that be??
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_27: [LT] Seems that they are some sort o' druids fo' the Norseman.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_28: [LT] I'm full of stories mate! Name a body part and I tell you the story what happened to it!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_3: [LT] I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_4: [LT] Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_5: [LT] My name is Haba, Captain Haba for ya little worm.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_6: [LT] I ain't no pirate. Don't let yourself mislead by my pirate hat. I got it from a friend of mine.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_7: [LT] Most o' my friends are dead the others don't like me anymore......well, seems there aren't many left.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_8: [LT] What fo' godsake shall that be??
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_9: [LT] Who are ya calling a barbarian?!? Watch your tongue here on board or you end up as fish fodder!
npc.captain_haba.voice_1: [LT] Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!
npc.captain_haba.voice_2: [LT] In the rigging ya lazy fools!
npc.captain_haba.voice_3: [LT] I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!
npc.captain_haba.voice_4: [LT] Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.greet_msg_1: [LT] Wha'd ya want? Ask me 'bout the {instructions} if you don't know what to do! If you wanna head back to {Svargrond}, let me know.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.greet_msg_2: [LT] You found the spot |PLAYERNAME|!! Grab yourself a helmet of the deep and go explore the {caves} down there.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.sendtrade_msg_: [LT] Here ya go! Use it on the crane when you see the monster. Then refill it every time you use the telescope.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_1: [LT] I'd go by myself and tear that beast's heart out if I were younger. I hope ya can do that for me. Now go and good luck to ya!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_2: [LT] Ya're a coward, aren't ya? Prove that I'm wrong and get your lazy bones up to the lookout!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_3: [LT] Just ask me for a trade if you need a bait.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.stdmod_4: [LT] I can give ya a challenge to test if ya have the guts to be a real sailor. Go up to the lookout and remain there for 24 hours during a storm! Harharhar!

npc.caramellia.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Please leave me alone in my {mourning}.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_1: [LT] Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.stdmod_10: [LT] My father wanted me to marry a wealthy Venorean. He understood so little about love and the ways of the heart.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_11: [LT] The city of the elves is an exotic wonder.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_12: [LT] The city is like the dwarfs that built it. Stony, never-changing and hard to understand for an outsider.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_2: [LT] Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_3: [LT] All is lost. With {Winfred} dead, my love has died and I'm only an empty shell without hope or purpose.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_4: [LT] We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never know what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_5: [LT] I guess he was the one that put my father up to the whole thing. He spied on Winfred and me and it was certainly him that suggested my {imprisonment} in this tower.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_6: [LT] This forsaken place seems as remote from the rest of the world as my heart is.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_7: [LT] Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_8: [LT] The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_9: [LT] Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.
npc.caramellia.voice_1: [LT] Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.voice_2: [LT] Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! As a tailor and merchant I have to say - we need to do something about your {outfit}, shall we?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_10: [LT] Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
npc.carlos.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hey, I thought you were going to run away, but luckily you came back. I'll show you how to change your {outfit}, okay?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_3: [LT] Welcome back! You know, after providing my little outfit service, I like to ask a little favour of you. Can you {help} me?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_4: [LT] Oh hey |PLAYERNAME|, you didn't answer my question yet - could you help me get some {food}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_5: [LT] Welcome back |PLAYERNAME|, I hope you changed your mind and will bring me some {meat}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_6: [LT] Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Did you have a successful hunt and carry a piece of {meat} or ham with you?
npc.carlos.greet_msg_7: [LT] Welcome back, Isleth Eagonst! Do you still have that piece of meat or ham? If so, please ask me for a {trade} and I'll give you some gold for it.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_8: [LT] Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Where did you put that delicious piece of food? Did you eat it yourself? Well, if you find another one, please come back.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_9: [LT] Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
npc.carlos.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
npc.carlos.voice_1: [LT] Hmm, we should do something about your outfit.
npc.carlos.voice_2: [LT] Ah, another adventurer. Let's talk a little.
npc.carlos.voice_3: [LT] Psst! Come over here for a little trade.
npc.carlos.voice_4: [LT] Hello, hello! Don't be shy, I don't bite.
npc.carlos.voice_5: [LT] By the way, if you want to look at old hints again, find the 'Help' button near your inventory and select 'Tutorial Hints'.
npc.carlos.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.carlson.stdmod_2: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.carlson.stdmod_3: [LT] Where do you want to go? To {Folda}, {Senja} or {Tibia}?
npc.cassino.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the Cassino! Here we play with: \n [PAYOUT 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: High for 4, 5, 6 and Low for 1, 2, and 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Odd for 1, 3, 5 and Even for 2, 4 and 6 \n [PAYOUT 500%] {NUMBERS}: You choose the number, and if you get it right ... {$$$$$}
npc.cedrik.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.

npc.cerdras.stdmod_2: [LT] For me, nature is the harmony of the elements. This harmony can be disturbed by certain events, but nature always finds its way back to harmony in the end.

npc.chartan.greet_msg_1: [LT] Great Znake forgive me to converze wiz ziz unworzy blankzkin.
npc.chavis.array_1: [LT] Hey there, just to let you know - I am not a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will not feed themselves. ...
npc.chavis.array_2: [LT] So in case you've got nothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my nose - please help us. ...
npc.chavis.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
npc.chavis.say_1: [LT] Hey there, just to let you know - I am not a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will not feed themselves. ...
npc.chavis.say_2: [LT] So in case you've got nothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my nose - please help us. ...
npc.chavis.say_3: [LT] If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - helping us, helps you in the long term, trust me.
npc.chavis.say_4: [LT] Don't be fooled, we have here masters and servants like everywhere else. The whole system is a scam to subdue the masses, to fool them about what is really happening. ...
npc.chavis.say_5: [LT] The system only ensures that the rich have a better control and the labourers are only used.
npc.chemar.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chemar.stdmod_1: [LT] Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.stdmod_2: [LT] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.chemar.stdmod_3: [LT] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.chemar.stdmod_4: [LT] Do you seek a ride to
npc.chemar.stdmod_7: [LT] I can fly you to {Edron}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Zao}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.chemar.voice_1: [LT] Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.voice_2: [LT] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.chemar.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_1: [LT] Too many possibilities to become a servant of darkness to trust ANYONE!
npc.chester_kahs.voice_2: [LT] Don't tell me I didn't warn you.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_3: [LT] It's all a big conspiracy, mark my words.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_4: [LT] Not everything that walks our streets is human ... or even living.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_5: [LT] We are surrounded by myths, living and dead.
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_1: [LT] Grarkharok's bestest troll tribe! Yeee, good name!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_10: [LT] Fragratosh stupid. He chief of me old tribe. No frogs, no snakes, no smashing humans withrocks. Booooooring tribe! Now me make own tribe!!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_11: [LT] Grarkharok no listen to talk of stinky human! Lalalalalala! Like song? Grarkharok made!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_12: [LT] You have what want! Go go, find lady so be Grarkharok tribe!!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_14: [LT] You say troll speak!! Hmmm, sound like south tribe! You know Ingortrak ?? He chief of big tribe in jungle! Good chief he is!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_15: [LT] I Tem?!?!? No know! Maybe YOU Tem?
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_16: [LT] Me be Grarkharok. No me name Job!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_17: [LT] Tribe Grarkharok will rules Tibia! Me only need troll lady, then start tribe!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_18: [LT] Grarkharok destroy human cave down hill! Human away, my mission done,hrhrhrhrhr!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_2: [LT] Grarkharok make new tribe here! Me Chief now!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_3: [LT] Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_4: [LT] Me tribe in production! Only need troll lady!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_5: [LT] Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_6: [LT] Grarkharok like BOOM, BOOM sound! Go mountain, push rock and BOOM!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_7: [LT] Like it?? Hope troll lady also like it!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_8: [LT] Me no like human. Need quiet to make tribe! Only need troll lady!
npc.chief_grarkharok.stdmod_9: [LT] Yeye, me stole chief club from Fragratosh, hrhrhrh! Now make me own tribe!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_1: [LT] Grarkharok's bestest troll tribe! Yeee, good name!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_2: [LT] Grarkharok make new tribe here! Me Chief now!
npc.chief_grarkharok.voice_3: [LT] Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!
npc.chrystal.greet_msg_1: [LT] At your service |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the post office.
npc.chrystal.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.cipfried.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds. It's my job after all.
npc.cipfried.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! I'll {heal} you if you are injured or poisoned. Feel free to ask me for {help} or general {hints}.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_1: [LT] Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_2: [LT] Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_1: [LT] Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_10: [LT] Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_11: [LT] That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {monsters}, {quests} and {citizens} around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_12: [LT] How can I help you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_13: [LT] Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_14: [LT] I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_15: [LT] A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_16: [LT] If you face spiders, beware of the {poisonous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_17: [LT] If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_18: [LT] Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_19: [LT] There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_2: [LT] Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_20: [LT] Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_21: [LT] Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_22: [LT] Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_23: [LT] Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_24: [LT] You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_25: [LT] You can buy equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {gold}. Some {monsters} also carry equipment pieces with them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_26: [LT] Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
npc.cipfried.stdmod_27: [LT] Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_28: [LT] To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_29: [LT] Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {monster}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_3: [LT] Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_30: [LT] As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_31: [LT] Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_32: [LT] The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_33: [LT] Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_34: [LT] The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will help you if you ask them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_35: [LT] They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_36: [LT] Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_37: [LT] You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_38: [LT] The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_39: [LT] I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_40: [LT] To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_41: [LT] You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_42: [LT] Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_43: [LT] Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_44: [LT] I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_45: [LT] You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_47: [LT] You aren't looking really bad, |PLAYERNAME|. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating {food}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_48: [LT] Obi's {shop} is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} sells {armor} and {shields} upstairs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_49: [LT] She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_50: [LT] That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_51: [LT] I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_52: [LT] That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_53: [LT] In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_54: [LT] Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced {explorer} and {adventurer}. It's always interesting to chat with her.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_55: [LT] He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_56: [LT] Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell {food} there.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_58: [LT] That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_59: [LT] Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_6: [LT] Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {help} or {healing}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_60: [LT] Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_61: [LT] You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_62: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_63: [LT] He is the {bank} clerk, making sure your {money} remains safe.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_64: [LT] Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_65: [LT] Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can sell fresh corpses or even minotaur leather to him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_66: [LT] May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous {monsters}!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_8: [LT] I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to help newcomers in this world.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_9: [LT] You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get {killed}. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
npc.cipfried.voice_1: [LT] Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.voice_2: [LT] Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.voice_3: [LT] Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cledwyn.greet_msg_1: [LT] Blessings, Player! How may I be of service? Do you wish to trade some {token}s, or would you like some {information} or {talk}? Should I {enchant} certain items for you?
npc.cledwyn.voice_2: [LT] Bespoke armor for all vocations! For the cost of some tokens only!
npc.coltrayne.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hey there. Need some armor or weapon? Then ask me for a {trade}.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_1: [LT] Team up with others to defeat monsters!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_10: [LT] Good at potions. Likes experimenting. Can kit you out with magical equipment for a hunt.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_11: [LT] Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't know how to use something? Ask Inigo.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_12: [LT] Don't have much to say about him. Barely know him. Seems a decent spell teacher for mages.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_13:
[LT] I'm sure I've seen his face before somewhere... \z
		never mind. Anyway, he's the knight and paladin spell teacher around here, letting you try them out for free. \z
		Don't underestimate the use of spells, even if you're not a mage.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_14:
[LT] He's just in the next shop to the left, selling food and equipment \z
		like ropes and shovels and fishing rods and such.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_15:
[LT] He had a plan, as usual. Came here, set up the outpost, managed everything. \z
		Looking for a task or quest? He's your man.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_16:
[LT] She's our local healer. Downstairs in the temple and oracle room, that's where she is. \z
		Just say 'heal' or 'help' and she'll help ya if you really need it.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_17:
[LT] Pirates and gold, you get the rest. Hoards gold now for young adventurers - \z
		keeps it safe while you go out hunting.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_2: [LT] Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_3: [LT] Better weapons equal more damage - get yourself some gear right here!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_4: [LT] Gird youselves! Chain mail, bows, spears, swords - we've got it all!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_5: [LT] Skill comes with practice - get out there and kill some beasts!
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_6: [LT] Coltrayne Daggard. Just ask me for a trade to see the latest in chain mail and weapons.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_7: [LT] I'm a blacksmith by trade. Want to keep our lads and lasses safe and equipped with a sharp blade, me.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_8: [LT] You mean to imply I am an inexperienced guardian? Get out of here.
npc.coltrayne.stdmod_9: [LT]  Yes. You wish to trade I guess. At least, you look like you could use some good gear, kid.
npc.coltrayne.voice_1: [LT] Team up with others to defeat monsters!
npc.coltrayne.voice_2: [LT] Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
npc.coltrayne.voice_3: [LT] Better weapons equal more damage - get yourself some gear right here!
npc.coltrayne.voice_4: [LT] Gird youselves! Chain mail, bows, spears, swords - we've got it all!
npc.coltrayne.voice_5: [LT] Skill comes with practice - get out there and kill some beasts!
npc.cornelia.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the finest {armor} shop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.cornelia.stdmod_2: [LT] I run this armoury. If you want to protect your life, you better buy my wares.
npc.cornell.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.cornell.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today, to {Grimvale} or {Edron}?
npc.cornell.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.cornell.stdmod_3: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.cornell.stdmod_4: [LT] I can travel you to {Grimvale} or {Edron}.
npc.corym_butler.greet_msg_1: [LT] We have to dig up valuable resources, but don't get enough to eat. The situation is terrible.
npc.corym_footman.greet_msg_1: [LT] What we get to eat is really ridiculous.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_1: [LT] We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_1: [LT] Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
npc.corym_slave.greet_msg_1: [LT] The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
npc.corym_worker_01.greet_msg_1: [LT] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.corym_worker_02.greet_msg_1: [LT] We need weapons to overcome our situation.
npc.corym_worker_03.greet_msg_1: [LT] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.corym_worker_05.greet_msg_1: [LT] My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
npc.costello.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Feel free to tell me what has brought you here.
npc.costello.say_1: [LT] To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. \z Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. \z Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_1: [LT] I can offer you first & second addons of the following outfit: {Wayfarer}.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_5: [LT] llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_6: [LT] To achieve the first storage addon you need to give me the Old Cape. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_7: [LT] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_8: [LT] To achieve the second storage addon you need to give me the Sedge Hat. Do you have them with you?
npc.cranky_lizard_crone.stdmod_9: [LT] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.cruleo.voice_2: [LT] This will earn me some handsome amount of gold!
npc.dalbrect.say_1: [LT] Can it be? I recognise my family's arms! You have found a treasure indeed! \z I am poor and all I can offer you is my friendship, but ... please ... give that brooch to me?
npc.dalbrect.say_2: [LT] Thank you! I shall consider you my friend from now on! \z Just let me know if you {need} something!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_1:
[LT] I have only sailed to the isle of the kings once or twice. \z
				I dare not anger the monks by bringing travelers there without their permission.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_10:
[LT] Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_11:
[LT] Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_12: [LT] To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_13:
[LT] There is little I can offer you but a trip with my boat. \z
				Are you looking for a {passage} to the isle of kings perhaps?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_14: [LT] My ship is my only pride and joy.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you seek a passage to the isle of the kings for 10 gold coins?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_4: [LT] Well, I'll be here if you change your mind.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_5: [LT] My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud Windtrouser family.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_6: [LT] I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble {legacy}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_7: [LT] Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but {fate} turned against us and threw us into poverty.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_8:
[LT] When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_9:
[LT] When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dallheim.greet_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.greet_2: [LT] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_1: [LT] The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_11: [LT] I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_12: [LT] My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_13: [LT] Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_15: [LT] I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_16: [LT] I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_17: [LT] I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_18: [LT] Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_19: [LT] There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_2: [LT] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_20: [LT] Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_21: [LT] You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_22: [LT] Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_23: [LT] Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_24: [LT] They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_25: [LT] The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_26: [LT] A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_27: [LT] Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_28: [LT] Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_29: [LT] Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_3: [LT] I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_31: [LT] All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_32: [LT] A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_33: [LT] I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_34: [LT] The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_35: [LT] There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_37: [LT] The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_38: [LT] I'm not interested in such party tricks.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_39: [LT] A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_4: [LT] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_40: [LT] It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_41: [LT] It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_42: [LT] Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_43: [LT] I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_44: [LT] Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_45: [LT] He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_47: [LT] He has been on this island as long as me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_49: [LT] He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_50: [LT] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_51: [LT] Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_52: [LT] Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_53: [LT] Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_54: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_56: [LT] Leave me alone with this wimp.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_57: [LT] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_59: [LT] He's guarding the west bridge. Not that a real threat would lurk on the other side.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_6: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_60: [LT] He is a fine cook and farmer. He buys and sells {food}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_61: [LT] You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_62: [LT] You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_63: [LT] You aren't looking really bad. Eat some food to regain strength.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_7: [LT] <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_9: [LT] Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.dallheim.voice_1: [LT] The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.voice_2: [LT] Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.voice_3: [LT] I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.voice_4: [LT] Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dancing_fairy.farewell_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.dancing_fairy.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.dane.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.
npc.dane.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the owner of this place of relaxation.
npc.dane.stdmod_5: [LT] I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade.
npc.dane.stdmod_6: [LT] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_7: [LT] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_8: [LT] Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
npc.dario.greet_1: [LT] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.voice_1: [LT] Increase your knowledge of spells here, young paladin.
npc.dario.voice_2: [LT] Need ammunition, bows or crossbows? Have a look at my wares.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_1: [LT] I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_2: [LT] This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_3: [LT] I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_4: [LT] The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_5: [LT] Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_6: [LT] You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
npc.dermot.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you?
npc.dermot.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_3: [LT] I am Dermot, the magistrate of this isle.
npc.dermot.stdmod_4: [LT] Time is not important on Fibula.
npc.dermot.stdmod_5: [LT] You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
npc.dermot.stdmod_6: [LT] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dermot.stdmod_7: [LT] Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
npc.dixi.greet_1: [LT] Good day, Ma'am. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.greet_2: [LT] Good day, Sir. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here, take a look and choose something nice for you!
npc.dixi.stdmod_1: [LT] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_11: [LT] <giggles> I love gossiping - err, I mean providing valuable information of course, just tell me a name! <winks>
npc.dixi.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm helping my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {trade}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_14: [LT] You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
npc.dixi.stdmod_15: [LT] The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_16: [LT] You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_17: [LT] As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with {Lee'Delle} and much more.
npc.dixi.stdmod_18: [LT] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_19: [LT] If you need a torch, go see {Al Dee}'s store.
npc.dixi.stdmod_2: [LT] Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.stdmod_20: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
npc.dixi.stdmod_21: [LT] Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {monsters} carry with them.
npc.dixi.stdmod_22: [LT] {Lily} sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
npc.dixi.stdmod_23: [LT] The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
npc.dixi.stdmod_24: [LT] King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.dixi.stdmod_25: [LT] Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to {mainland} and choose a {profession}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_26: [LT] If you want to fight monsters in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_27: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_28: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_29: [LT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_3: [LT] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.stdmod_30: [LT] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
npc.dixi.stdmod_31: [LT] You need to make sure you have some basic {equipment} before you head into dungeons such as the {sewers}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_32: [LT] There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
npc.dixi.stdmod_34: [LT] How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
npc.dixi.stdmod_35: [LT] I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.dixi.stdmod_36: [LT] You should never embark on an adventure without it. Ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} for it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_37: [LT] Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.dixi.stdmod_38: [LT] Me and my grandfather {Obi} sell {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {trade} if you like to see our offers.
npc.dixi.stdmod_39: [LT] Norma used to sell {equipment}, but she finally earned enough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
npc.dixi.stdmod_4: [LT] Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.stdmod_40: [LT] I never understand what he's talking about.
npc.dixi.stdmod_41: [LT] I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
npc.dixi.stdmod_42: [LT] Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
npc.dixi.stdmod_43: [LT] In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.dixi.stdmod_44: [LT] One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!
npc.dixi.stdmod_45: [LT] Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
npc.dixi.stdmod_46: [LT] Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy {food}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_47: [LT] He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
npc.dixi.stdmod_48: [LT] Did I hear my name somewhere?
npc.dixi.stdmod_49: [LT] I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?
npc.dixi.stdmod_5: [LT] Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.dixi.stdmod_50: [LT] Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_51: [LT] I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she sells {potions}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_52: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_54: [LT] Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_55: [LT] I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can sell leather and fresh corpses to him.
npc.dixi.stdmod_56: [LT] He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {monsters} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_6: [LT] Good day, Ma'am. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.stdmod_7: [LT] Good day, Sir. How may I help you, |PLAYERNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
npc.dixi.voice_1: [LT] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.voice_2: [LT] Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.voice_3: [LT] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.voice_4: [LT] Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.voice_5: [LT] Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.doctor_gnomedix.greet_msg_1: [LT] Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.dorian.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Why do you disturb me?
npc.doubleday.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...
npc.dukosch.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.duncan.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
npc.duria.stdmod_1: [LT] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_2: [LT] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_3: [LT] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ebenizer.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.ebenizer.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eclesius.greet_msg_1: [LT] Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
npc.eclesius.voice_1: [LT] I'm looking for a new assistant!
npc.eclesius.voice_2: [LT] Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
npc.eclesius.voice_3: [LT] Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
npc.eclesius.voice_4: [LT] I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
npc.eclesius.voice_5: [LT] Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
npc.eclesius.voice_6: [LT] So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?
npc.edala.stdmod_1: [LT] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.edala.stdmod_10: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_11: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_12: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_13: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_14: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_15: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.edala.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.edala.stdmod_5: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_6: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.edala.stdmod_7: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_8: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_9: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eddy.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
npc.eddy.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.eddy.stdmod_1: [LT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eddy.stdmod_2: [LT] I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?
npc.eddy.voice_1: [LT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edgar_ellen.greet_msg_1: [LT] This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_1: [LT] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_10: [LT] Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_11: [LT] For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_12: [LT] A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_13: [LT] A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_14: [LT] A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_15: [LT] A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_16: [LT] A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_17: [LT] On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_18: [LT] One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_19: [LT] A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2: [LT] A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_20: [LT] Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_21: [LT] Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and monsters there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_22: [LT] A king and a beggar know more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_23: [LT] So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_24: [LT] So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_25: [LT] Rather a calling. The weight of words is something not easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3: [LT] A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_4: [LT] The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5: [LT] Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_6: [LT] The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_7: [LT] During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_8: [LT] A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_9: [LT] A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_1: [LT] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
