npc.edowir.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edowir.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
npc.edowir.stdmod_1: [LT] I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.stdmod_2: [LT] I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.
npc.edowir.voice_1: [LT] I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edvard.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.edvard.stdmod_1: [LT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edvard.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.edvard.voice_1: [LT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eighty.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.eighty.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.elane.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
npc.elane.stdmod_1: [LT] We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.elane.stdmod_10: [LT] We will help you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
npc.elane.stdmod_11: [LT] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.elane.stdmod_12: [LT] Some paladins serve in the kings army.
npc.elane.stdmod_14: [LT] How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
npc.elane.stdmod_16: [LT] He must have been skilled before he became the way he is now. Such a pity.
npc.elane.stdmod_18: [LT] The alcohol he sells shrouds the mind and the eye.
npc.elane.stdmod_19: [LT] One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
npc.elane.stdmod_2: [LT] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_20: [LT] He sells a lot of useful equipment.
npc.elane.stdmod_21: [LT] He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
npc.elane.stdmod_22: [LT] A fine warrior and a skilled general.
npc.elane.stdmod_23: [LT] King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
npc.elane.stdmod_24: [LT] A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
npc.elane.stdmod_25: [LT] Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
npc.elane.stdmod_26: [LT] A skilled healer, that's for sure.
npc.elane.stdmod_28: [LT] If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
npc.elane.stdmod_29: [LT] A humble monk and a wise man.
npc.elane.stdmod_3: [LT] I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_30: [LT] Strong man. But a little shy.
npc.elane.stdmod_4: [LT] Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
npc.elane.stdmod_5: [LT] Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
npc.elane.stdmod_6: [LT] There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
npc.elane.stdmod_7: [LT] Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
npc.elane.stdmod_8: [LT] I am a paladin, not a storyteller.
npc.elane.stdmod_9: [LT] Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
npc.elathriel.greet_1: [LT] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.say_1: [LT] If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_1:
[LT] I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_10: [LT] It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_13: [LT] A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_14: [LT] A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_15: [LT] Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_16: [LT] I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_17: [LT] We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_18:
[LT] Like all inferior races, they can be at least of use for something good. \z
				The other castes are just jealous of us making use of them.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_2:
[LT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_20: [LT] Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would not see the necessity to follow OUR way.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_21:
[LT] My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend \z
				that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_22: [LT] Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magic.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_23: [LT] Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_24: [LT] Confused cowards. For all their skill, they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_25: [LT] We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_26: [LT] We watch this city and the actions of its inhabitants closely.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_27:
[LT] The merchants of venore provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_28: [LT] The Thaian kingdom and we share some enemies, so it's only logical to cooperate in a few areas.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_29: [LT] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_3:
[LT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_30: [LT] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_31: [LT] I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_32: [LT] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.stdmod_4:
[LT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_5:
[LT] It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. \z
				It's secured by a sealed door.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_6: [LT] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_7: [LT] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_8: [LT] Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_9: [LT] It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_1: [LT] The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2: [LT] I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_3: [LT] The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_4: [LT] The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_6: [LT] If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_7: [LT] Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_8: [LT] The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
npc.elgar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.elgar.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eliyas.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
npc.eliyas.stdmod_1: [LT] I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_3: [LT] Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.elvith.stdmod_1: [LT] I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
npc.elvith.stdmod_10: [LT] That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_11: [LT] They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
npc.elvith.stdmod_12: [LT] The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_13: [LT] The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
npc.elvith.stdmod_14: [LT] I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
npc.elvith.stdmod_15: [LT] Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
npc.elvith.stdmod_16: [LT] For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said no one can return from there. Since it is not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.
npc.elvith.stdmod_2: [LT] I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
npc.elvith.stdmod_3: [LT] Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
npc.elvith.stdmod_4: [LT] Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
npc.elvith.stdmod_5: [LT] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_6: [LT] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_7: [LT] We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
npc.elvith.stdmod_8: [LT] They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
npc.elvith.stdmod_9: [LT] I bet they were great musicians.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.greet_msg_1: [LT] A shadow preceded you. You wish a {scroll} or a {mission}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.voice_3: [LT] The rats... the rats in the walls...
npc.emael.voice_1: [LT] Not enough space for all my trophies...
npc.emma.farewell_msg_1: [LT] LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
npc.emma.kw_ab'dendriel_1: [LT] The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ...
npc.emma.kw_ab'dendriel_2: [LT] They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
npc.emma.kw_avin_1: [LT] The AVIN is rather a crime syndicate than anything else. If there is something dirty and illegal, they are most likely involved. ...
npc.emma.kw_avin_2: [LT] They are unscrupulous and also do not back away from blackmailing and assassination.
npc.emma.kw_cgb_1: [LT] The CGB is a patriotic organisation that fights our numerous enemies with means that guards or army do not have at their disposal. ...
npc.emma.kw_cgb_2: [LT] We work secretly and covertly. We uncover secret plots and we are both the first line of defence of our city and the last. We are joined only by the best of the best.
npc.emma.kw_liberty_bay_1: [LT] The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ...
npc.emma.kw_liberty_bay_2: [LT] It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
npc.emma.kw_tbi_1: [LT] The TBI is as old-fashioned, stubborn and inflexible as only males can be. What makes this bureaucracy somewhat dangerous, is the money they have at their disposal. ...
npc.emma.kw_tbi_2: [LT] They buy spies and traitors - all of them weak-willed or greedy individuals.
npc.emma.say_1: [LT] The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
npc.emma.stdmod_1: [LT] I am privileged to be in service of our beloved queen!
npc.emma.stdmod_10: [LT] Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
npc.emma.stdmod_11: [LT] It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
npc.emma.stdmod_12: [LT] The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
npc.emma.stdmod_2: [LT] We are proud people who fought hard for their freedom and won't allow others to oppress us again.
npc.emma.stdmod_3: [LT] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_4: [LT] I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_6: [LT] The Thaians never got over the fact that we gained our independence. They do everything they can to hinder the prospering of our city.
npc.emma.stdmod_7: [LT] Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
npc.emma.stdmod_8: [LT] Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
npc.emma.stdmod_9: [LT] Strange people with strange customs live in this city. Luckily, we rarely have to deal with them.
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_1: [LT] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_2: [LT] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_1: [LT] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_3: [LT] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_4: [LT] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_5: [LT] Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_1: [LT] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_3: [LT] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.erayo.greet_msg_1: [LT] What the... I mean, of course I sensed you.
npc.eremo.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.eremo.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my little garden, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.eremo.stdmod_1: [LT] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.eremo.stdmod_10:
[LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, \
		the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. \
		Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.eremo.stdmod_11: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.eremo.stdmod_12: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eremo.stdmod_13: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.eremo.stdmod_14:
[LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by \
		the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.eremo.stdmod_15: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.eremo.stdmod_16: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.eremo.stdmod_17: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.eremo.stdmod_18: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.eremo.stdmod_19:
[LT] I teach some spells, provide one of the five blessings, and sell some amulets. \
		Ask me for a trade if you like.
npc.eremo.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the wisdom of solitude, pilgrim.
npc.eremo.stdmod_20: [LT] I am Eremo, an old man who has seen many things.
npc.eremo.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.eremo.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.eremo.stdmod_5:
[LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional \
		protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.eremo.stdmod_6: [LT] Should I teleport you back to Pemaret?
npc.eremo.stdmod_9:
[LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a \
		chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, \
		this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.eremo.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.eroth.farewell_1: [LT] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eroth.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eroth.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the leader of the Cenath caste.
npc.eroth.stdmod_2: [LT] The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our help they would surely die in a foolish war.
npc.eroth.stdmod_3: [LT] Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need no gods.
npc.eroth.stdmod_4: [LT] They lack the understanding of unity. We are keeping them together and prevent them from being slaughtered one by one.
npc.eroth.stdmod_5: [LT] We are the shepherds of our people. The other castes need our guidance.
npc.eroth.stdmod_6: [LT] Magic comes almost naturally to the Cenath. We keep the secrets of ages.
npc.eroth.stdmod_7: [LT] I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.
npc.eroth.stdmod_9: [LT] Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
npc.eruaran.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ashari Lillithy, so we meet {again}! What brings you here this time, general {information}, {transform}, {improve}, {create}, {outfit}, or {talk}?
npc.eruaran.stdmod_1: [LT] What addon you are looking? I need for first addon: {dream warden mask} and for second {dream warden claw}.
npc.eruaran.stdmod_2: [LT] To achieve the first dream addon you need to give me 1 dream warden mask. Do you have them with you?
npc.eruaran.stdmod_3: [LT] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.eruaran.stdmod_4: [LT] To achieve the second dream addon you need to give me 1 dream warden claw. Do you have them with you?
npc.eruaran.stdmod_5: [LT] Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.eshaya.greet_msg_1: [LT] Suon's and Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
npc.eshaya.voice_2: [LT] I should talk to Kallimae soon.
npc.eshaya.voice_3: [LT] Issavi's safety is my first concern.
npc.esrik.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to my little forge.
npc.eustacio.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a busy day. You can check your status or ask me about the location of ongoing raids.
npc.eva.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.eva.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.example_merchant_i18n.stdmod_2: [LT] Of course! Here are my offers.
npc.ezebeth.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello! I guess you are here for a {mission}.
npc.fa_hradin.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
npc.fa_hradin.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
npc.falonzo.kw_boundaries_1: [LT] We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ...
npc.falonzo.kw_boundaries_2: [LT] Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
npc.falonzo.kw_dragged_1: [LT] This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ...
npc.falonzo.kw_dragged_2: [LT] but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_1: [LT] I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {anomaly}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_3: [LT] This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_4: [LT] Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_5: [LT] Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have {changed}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_6: [LT] Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.
npc.faloriel.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, dear guest and welcome to my {potion} shop.
npc.faloriel.voice_1: [LT] Health potions! Mana potions! Buy them here!
npc.faloriel.voice_2: [LT] All kinds of potions available here!
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.greet_: [LT] Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
npc.feizuhl.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the furniture store.
npc.feizuhl.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
npc.feizuhl.voice_1: [LT] I sell furniture both to the mourned and the enlightened.
npc.fenbala.farewell_msg_1: [LT] LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
npc.fenbala.stdmod_1: [LT] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
npc.fenbala.stdmod_2: [LT] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
npc.fenech.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the magic store.
npc.fenech.voice_1: [LT] Offering all sorts of magic equipment.
npc.ferks.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.ferryman_kamil.stdmod_1: [LT] You want me to transport you and your spouse to Honeymoon Island {Meluna}?
npc.ferryman_kamil_meluna.stdmod_1: [LT] You want me to transport you and your spouse back to {Fibula}?
npc.ferus.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.ferus.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ferus.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.ferus.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ferus.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.ferus.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ferus.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ferus.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.ferus.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ferus.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ferus.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.ferus.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.ferus.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ferus.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.ferus.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ferus.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ferus.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.ferus.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.ferus.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.ferus.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.ferus.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.finarfin.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.finarfin.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.fiona.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and please come back soon.
npc.fiona.greet_msg_1: [LT] Good day, |PLAYERNAME|. I hope you bring a lot of {magical ingredients} with you.
npc.fiona.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.
npc.fiona.stdmod_1: [LT] The Edron academy is always in need of magical ingredients!
npc.fiona.stdmod_2: [LT] Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a monster, for example bat wings. I buy many of these things if you don't want to use them for quests, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.fiona.voice_1: [LT] The Edron academy is always in need of magical ingredients!
npc.fiona.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and please come back soon.
npc.flickering_soul.array_1: [LT] I was once known as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.array_2: [LT] For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.array_3: [LT] Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.array_4: [LT] Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_1: [LT] It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
npc.flickering_soul.say_10: [LT] Thank you for accepting this burden.
npc.flickering_soul.say_11: [LT] You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
npc.flickering_soul.say_12: [LT] My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
npc.flickering_soul.say_13: [LT] I'm not aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, not bound by ties of blood or herritage.
npc.flickering_soul.say_14: [LT] His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.
npc.flickering_soul.say_15: [LT] I despised my followers for their petty agendas and for their limited vision of my own goals and personality.
npc.flickering_soul.say_16: [LT] I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are now free from the burden that you should not have to bear.
npc.flickering_soul.say_17: [LT] You are not tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.
npc.flickering_soul.say_18: [LT] I was once known as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_19: [LT] For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.say_2: [LT] I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took when I left my mundane past behind.
npc.flickering_soul.say_20: [LT] My ambitions were high and knew no limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_21: [LT] Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been enough. There was a hunger in me that nothing could put to rest.
npc.flickering_soul.say_22: [LT] I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was no time to rest. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_23: [LT] And there was no looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_24: [LT] Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.say_25: [LT] Zarganash was not a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_26: [LT] And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_27: [LT] A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_28: [LT] Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_29: [LT] I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash, and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_3: [LT] Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
npc.flickering_soul.say_30: [LT] It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighed even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_31: [LT] Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_32: [LT] I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of knowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this knowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_33: [LT] I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_34: [LT] And I feel others, many others who crave my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
npc.flickering_soul.say_35: [LT] Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters were bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_36: [LT] The fetters and the efforts to call me back are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_37: [LT] They are beginning to feed not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.
npc.flickering_soul.say_38: [LT] You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Now I'm free at last. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_39: [LT] I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Thank you so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!
npc.flickering_soul.say_4: [LT] Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
npc.flickering_soul.say_40: [LT] You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality that I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_41: [LT] Even worse, you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize for their own depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
npc.flickering_soul.say_42: [LT] I hated the world for its flaws and the reluctance of people to comply with my will. I was convinced I was destined for greatness and to change everything. Ordinary beings were far beneath me and my consideration. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_43: [LT] All this opposition, all the wars were a nuisance on my way to greatness. I would have sacrificed the whole world to reach my goals.
npc.flickering_soul.say_44: [LT] Even in the lands of the dead, this one caused a stir. The dead were whispering his name. It made me feel jealous and angry at first, but at some point, after much self-reflection, I could recognize my own faults in the stories about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_45: [LT] It was almost like looking into a mirror for the first time. However, he lived way later than me, and I never met his soul here, so I can't tell more about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_46: [LT] They called me the necromant king, in an act of reverence, but to me it was always more of a slander. To limit my greatness to this insignificant aspect was an insult to my ego. But I let it slip for the greater good. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_47: [LT] I felt it was beneath me to correct them and I went along.
npc.flickering_soul.say_5: [LT] My demise did not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.
npc.flickering_soul.say_6: [LT] My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had not taken into consideration was peace.
npc.flickering_soul.say_7: [LT] I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided not to return to the world of the living.
npc.flickering_soul.say_8: [LT] The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
npc.flickering_soul.say_9: [LT] I'm aware I have no right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?
npc.florentine.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you?
npc.florentine.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.frafnar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? <sighs> So what's the matter?
npc.frans.greet_msg_1: [LT] Beeee greeeeted, Simula! What is your neeeed?
npc.frederik.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi there and welcome to my little magic shop.
npc.freezhild.farewell_msg_1: [LT] I hope you have a cold day, friend.
npc.freezhild.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] I hope you have a cold day, friend.
npc.frodo.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.
npc.frodo.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to Frodo's Hut. You heard about the {news}?
npc.frodo.stdmod_1: [LT] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.stdmod_11: [LT] Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
npc.frodo.stdmod_12: [LT]  I heard it when I was a child.
npc.frodo.stdmod_13: [LT] Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.
npc.frodo.stdmod_14: [LT] Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_15: [LT] Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_16: [LT] Nothing more than a tale for warriors.
npc.frodo.stdmod_17: [LT] Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.
npc.frodo.stdmod_18: [LT] No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...
npc.frodo.stdmod_19: [LT] Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!
npc.frodo.stdmod_2: [LT] I hope you like it. Would you like some {food}?
npc.frodo.stdmod_20: [LT] The king's residence has been renovated lately.
npc.frodo.stdmod_21: [LT] Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.
npc.frodo.stdmod_22: [LT] Here in Thais is the center of Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_23: [LT] He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.
npc.frodo.stdmod_24: [LT] He's able to drink a bottle or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_25: [LT] I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_26: [LT] Oh, that old guy! He's a good customer, that's for sure.
npc.frodo.stdmod_27: [LT] Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?
npc.frodo.stdmod_28: [LT] She makes excellent arrows and bows.
npc.frodo.stdmod_29: [LT] Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.
npc.frodo.stdmod_3: [LT] I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {selling} food.
npc.frodo.stdmod_30: [LT] The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_32: [LT] I think some time ago a stranger from Fibula with that name stayed here for some nights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_33: [LT] I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_34: [LT] A sorceress, you can find her in their guild sitting befor a book - always!
npc.frodo.stdmod_35: [LT] Just between you and me: What a babe!
npc.frodo.stdmod_36: [LT] Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.
npc.frodo.stdmod_37: [LT] The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
npc.frodo.stdmod_38: [LT] Muriel has never visited this place.
npc.frodo.stdmod_39: [LT] I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.
npc.frodo.stdmod_4: [LT] I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
npc.frodo.stdmod_40: [LT] He hardly visits my humble tavern.
npc.frodo.stdmod_41: [LT] A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_42: [LT] That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine i serve.
npc.frodo.stdmod_43: [LT] I don't know where he gets these fluids. If I could sell them here, the hut would be crowded.
npc.frodo.stdmod_5: [LT] Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.
npc.frodo.stdmod_6: [LT] Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
npc.frodo.stdmod_7: [LT] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.frodo.voice_1: [LT] Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Please come back from time to time.
npc.frosty.greet_msg_1: [LT] No, you can't have my nose! If you're in need of a {carrot}, go to the market or just dig up one! Or did you come to bring me a {percht skull}?
npc.frosty.stdmod_1: [LT] What about 'no' do you not understand, hrm? You are more annoying than any {percht} around here! Not to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my nose!
npc.frosty.stdmod_2: [LT] Well why didn't you say that rightaway, if you give me such a skull I can give you one of my {sleighs}.
npc.frosty.stdmod_3: [LT] Always trying to eat my nose!
npc.gabel.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.gabel.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.galuna.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Distance weapons? I sell lots of them.
npc.galuna.voice_1: [LT] Bows, crossbows and ammunition on special sale today.
npc.gamel.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamel.greet_msg_1: [LT] Pssst! Be silent. Do you wish to {buy} something?
npc.gamel.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamon.farewell_msg_1: [LT] You'll come back. They all do.
npc.gamon.greet_msg_1: [LT] Nice to meet you, Mister |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!
npc.gamon.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
npc.gamon.stdmod_1: [LT] Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.gamon.stdmod_2: [LT] Making a stake from a chair? Are you insane??! I won't waste my chairs on you for free! You will have to pay for it, but since I consider your plan a blasphemy, it will cost 5000 gold pieces. Okay?
npc.gamon.stdmod_3: [LT] Argh... my heart aches! Alright... a promise is a promise. Here - take this wooden stake, and now get lost.
npc.gamon.stdmod_4: [LT] You can't even pay for that.
npc.gamon.voice_1: [LT] Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.garamond.array_1:
[LT] Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.garamond.array_2:
[LT] There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.garamond.array_3:
[LT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having \z
			an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.garamond.array_4:
[LT] Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.array_5:
[LT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once \z
			you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.garamond.array_6: [LT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.garamond.say_1: [LT] Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.garamond.say_10: [LT] Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.garamond.say_11: [LT] Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.garamond.say_12: [LT] Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.garamond.say_13: [LT] There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.garamond.say_14: [LT] I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.garamond.say_15: [LT] A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.garamond.say_16: [LT] However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.garamond.say_2: [LT] There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.garamond.say_3: [LT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.garamond.say_4: [LT] Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_5: [LT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.garamond.say_6: [LT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.garamond.say_7: [LT] The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_8: [LT] Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.garamond.say_9: [LT] The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.garamond.stdmod_1: [LT] In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_10: [LT] Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.garamond.stdmod_11: [LT] Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.garamond.stdmod_12:
[LT] A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.garamond.stdmod_13:
[LT] A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.garamond.stdmod_14:
[LT] Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.garamond.stdmod_15:
[LT] Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, it seems to have lead him to \z
		discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.garamond.stdmod_16:
[LT] He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.garamond.stdmod_17:
[LT] Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.garamond.stdmod_2:
[LT] In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_4:
[LT] I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.garamond.stdmod_6:
[LT] Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.garamond.stdmod_7: [LT] I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.garamond.stdmod_8:
[LT] Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.garamond.stdmod_9:
[LT] A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the wonderful and only recently opened Museum of Tibian Arts! Free entrance for everybody, but patrons of the arts are wanted and favoured.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_2: [LT] The Druid of Crunor has sent you? He seems to know that this new museum shines like a diamond. Enjoy your stay! If you like to {support} this place, talk to me.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_4: [LT] You again? How could you flee from the last floor. The cultists should have 'dealt' with you! That beats me. You have to leave this place right now. There's nothing more to say.
npc.gate_guardian.greet_msg_1: [LT] Chhhhzzz. Ugly humanzzz! You better have a good reazzzon to be here!
npc.gelagos.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Hope you die and lose it.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_6: [LT] You are as stupid as Bron.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_7: [LT] Any cyclops is smarter than Bron.
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.greet_msg_1: [LT] Have you come to answer Gelidrazah's questions?
npc.gerimor.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greeting, |PLAYERNAME|! I welcome you to this sacred {place}. If you are interested in {missions} just ask.
npc.gerimor.kw_boogies_1: [LT] Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_boogies_2: [LT] Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are now twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_1: [LT] It doesn't seem that the cults share a common theme or object of reverence but there has to be some connection beyond being at the centre of culminations of disruptive power from beyond. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_2: [LT] The connection is of second thought though. Connected or not, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_3: [LT] We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_1: [LT] Even we know the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_2: [LT] He was the first to bring bright and dedicated minds together, to bring at least a little order and guidance into troubled and chaotic times. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_3: [LT] The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have no place in our mindset.
npc.gerimor.kw_direct_1: [LT] Sometimes it's necessary to do something about a situation that became threatening to the world itself. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_direct_2: [LT] It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nonetheless sometimes we have to interfere.
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_1: [LT] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_2: [LT] Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the 'children of dreams' or 'the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_court_1: [LT] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_court_2: [LT] Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the ,children of dreams' or ,the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_1: [LT] Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_2: [LT] Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_3: [LT] Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.kw_guidance_1: [LT] Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of knowledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about knowledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_guidance_2: [LT] To solve problems we usually try to convince the right people to do the right thing. We usually even lack the means for a more direct interference.
npc.gerimor.kw_maelyrra_1: [LT] She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_maelyrra_2: [LT] I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.
npc.gerimor.kw_me_1: [LT] I'm a member of a circle of persons, that joined wisdom and resources for a common purpose. Let's say, we have an eye on the greater picture in the matters of our world. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_me_2: [LT] We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.	Trying to avert the worst and offering a helping hand where we deem it needed. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_me_3: [LT] We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are not our concern at all.
npc.gerimor.kw_nymphs_1: [LT] Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_nymphs_2: [LT] They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
npc.gerimor.kw_persons_1: [LT] Well, while I focus more on the matters of life, some of my peers have different approaches and emphasize other aspects of the world more in their observations. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_persons_2: [LT] Regardless we share a common goal of balance and harmony.
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_1: [LT] Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_2: [LT] Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_3: [LT] They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_1: [LT] Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_2: [LT] Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_3: [LT] Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_1: [LT] Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_2: [LT] Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_3: [LT] They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
npc.gerimor.kw_works_1: [LT] We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_2: [LT] that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are not meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this knowledge ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_3: [LT] And ultimately not only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it knowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_4: [LT] In some way their tainted knowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_5: [LT] That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
npc.gerimor.kw_worst_1: [LT] We have located some of the worst culminations of otherworldly presence and our sources returned information about them with different results of success. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_worst_2: [LT] Some information I can provide you will be rather sparse and much is left to speculation but you should have at least some lead where to go and investigate.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_1: [LT] This place is a sanctuary of Crunor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_2: [LT] We focus our interest on this we see as threatening for live and the laws of nature itself.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_3: [LT] We might not be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_4: [LT] Interference comes in different forms. In this particular case there is sadly little time for subtlety and a more direct approach is necessary.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_5: [LT] The fae granted me permission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_6: [LT] Those cults have to be stopped by any means possible. These are desperate times and they demand desperate actions.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_7: [LT] Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may not be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_8: [LT] The weakened fabric of our reality still repels the unnatural intruder. The cults provide the thing a hold and supply it with more power, even if we couldn't figure out yet, how this works at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_9: [LT] I have several missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.
npc.gewen.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you? Or do you need a weekly ticket for the Kazordoon public lorry transport?
npc.gewen.stdmod_1: [LT] Nothing beats the feeling of flying with a carpet!
npc.gewen.stdmod_2: [LT] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.gewen.stdmod_3: [LT] Do you seek a ride to
npc.gewen.stdmod_6: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Issavi}, {Zao}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.gewen.voice_1: [LT] Nothing beats the feeling of flying with a carpet!
npc.ghorza.voice_3: [LT] All water drying up and Vuzrog does nothing!
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_left_1: [LT] Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We know that you came for one of those insignia. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_left_2: [LT] The Great Snake approves that you acquire its holy sceptre. We will not question the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_slumber_1: [LT] We were once the heigh priests of the Great Snake. We willingly left our mortal existence behind to become bound to this temple. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_slumber_2: [LT] In this state we can serve the Great Snake in a more suitable way. You have to understand that it is an honour and a privilege, not a sacrifice.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_worthy_1: [LT] The Great Snake deserves that we try to use the best of our abilities and capabilities to serve it. Our existence is a test in this world corrupted by the egg stealers. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_worthy_2: [LT] Only when we overcome all obstacles cast into our way, we will become worthy to serve the Great Snake in all eternity.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_1: [LT] We are the {guardians}. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_10: [LT] There are many forms of corruption in this world. All of it is the work of the egg stealers who spread their taint. The creation hatched by the Great {Snake} was perfect without even the option of corruption.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_11: [LT] Creatures from beyond. Greedy and traitorous, they stole parts of the world and of life for themselves. They corrupted the world by their deceptions and stole our {birthright}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_12: [LT] We were overthrown by those of who we vainly thought we could use for our advantage, even though we knew about the foulness of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_13: [LT] Everything that lacks scales is no true litter of the Great Snake. They are the corrupted kin of the egg stealers.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_14: [LT] Such concepts are of little consequence for the dead.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_15: [LT] They are a manifestation of the snake god's power. They are its avatars in some way.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_16: [LT] We are the true-born. We are the children of the snake. But as children we have yet much to learn. One day we might take our rightful place in creation, but only if we prove {worthy}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_17: [LT] They are the false-born. They hatched from foul eggs - poisoned by the egg stealers. They are numerous and like a plague for the world.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_18: [LT] This was once the centre of power of our religion. From here we ruled Tiquanda in the name of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_19: [LT] We were not aware of another civilisation that was left. Only recently the awareness of the Great Snake touched us in our slumber and we learnt through visions of its other children.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_2: [LT] We are the keepers of this old temple and the guardians of its sacred {secrets}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_3: [LT] We are keepers of the {lore} of the Great {Snake} and we guard some of its {relics}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_4: [LT] The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are not ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_5: [LT] Once the powerful relics of the Great {Snake} were abundant. Most got lost to the ravages of time and our enemies. What is {left} is all the more precious.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_6: [LT] We are the guardians. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_7: [LT] What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8: [LT] In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eyes of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_9: [LT] Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.

npc.gnomus.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. We could really use some {help} from you right now. You should prove {worthy} to our alliance.
npc.gnomus.kw_base_1: [LT] Gnomish supplies and ingenuity have helped to establish and fortify this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_base_2: [LT] Our knowledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gnomes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_1: [LT] Our surveys of the area showed us some spikes in heat and seismic activity at very specific places. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_2: [LT] We conclude this is no coincidence and the enemy is using devices to pump up the lava to flood the area. We have seen it before and had to retreat each time. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_3: [LT] This time though we might have a counter prepared - given me manage to pierce their defences.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: [LT] If you're willing to help us, we could need an escort for arriving {ordnance}, help with {charting} the cave system and someone needs to get some heat {measurements} fast.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: [LT] I'm the main gnomish contact for this base. I coordinate our efforts with those of the dwarves to ensure everything is running smoothly.
npc.gorn.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need?
npc.gorn.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.gorn.stdmod_1: [LT] General goods and paperware for sale!
npc.gorn.stdmod_10: [LT] She's the leader of the paladin guild.
npc.gorn.stdmod_11: [LT] Old Baxter was a rowdy, once. In our youth we shared some adventures and women.
npc.gorn.stdmod_12: [LT] Bah! Go away with this bozoguy.
npc.gorn.stdmod_14: [LT] We had a clash or two in the old days.
npc.gorn.stdmod_15: [LT] Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_18: [LT] You can find him in the sorcerer guild.
npc.gorn.stdmod_19: [LT] This Oswald has not enough to work and too much time to spread rumours.
npc.gorn.stdmod_2: [LT] I am selling equipment of all kinds. Do you need anything?
npc.gorn.stdmod_20: [LT] He advices newcomers to buy at my store. I love that guy!
npc.gorn.stdmod_21: [LT] Strong as an ox, could armwrestle a minotaur, I bet.
npc.gorn.stdmod_22: [LT] He owns the magic shop here. But be aware: The prices are enormous.
npc.gorn.stdmod_3: [LT] The king supports Tibia's economy a lot.
npc.gorn.stdmod_4: [LT] Magic? Ask a sorcerer or druid about that.
npc.gorn.stdmod_5: [LT] I am Gorn. My goods are known all over Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_6: [LT] It is exactly |TIME|. Maybe you want to buy a watch?
npc.gorn.stdmod_7: [LT] This druids are nice people, you will find them in the east of the town.
npc.gorn.stdmod_8: [LT] Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_9: [LT] You can find him in the sorcerer guild.
npc.gorn.voice_1: [LT] General goods and paperware for sale!
npc.graubart.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and don't forget me!
npc.graubart.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME|. Looking for work on my ship?
npc.graubart.stdmod_1: [LT] My name is Graubart, captain of the great SeaHawk!
npc.graubart.stdmod_10: [LT] Bruno is one of the best sailors I know. He is nearly as good as me. *laughs loudly*
npc.graubart.stdmod_2: [LT] Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_3: [LT] Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_4: [LT] I'm a merchant. I sail all over the world with my ship and trade with many different races!
npc.graubart.stdmod_5: [LT] A merchant is someone who trades goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*
npc.graubart.stdmod_6: [LT] I trade nearly everything, for example weapons, food, water, and even magic runes.
npc.graubart.stdmod_7: [LT] You know; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, minotaurs and many others.
npc.graubart.stdmod_9: [LT] Pssst. Marlene is not near right now...? You know... she is a lovely woman, but she talks too much! So I always try to keep distance from her because she can't stop talking.
npc.gregor.array_1: [LT] Well then, listen closely. First, you will have to prove that you are a fierce and restless warrior by bringing me 100 perfect behemoth fangs. ...
npc.gregor.array_2: [LT] Secondly, please retrieve a helmet for us which has been lost a long time ago. The famous Ramsay the Reckless wore it when exploring an ape settlement. ...
npc.gregor.array_3: [LT] Third, we need a new flask of warrior's sweat. We've run out of it recently, but we need a small amount for the show battles in our arena. ...
npc.gregor.array_4: [LT] Lastly, I will have our smith refine your helmet if you bring me royal steel, an especially noble metal. ...
npc.gregor.array_5: [LT] Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.gregor.say_1: [LT] Well then, listen closely. First, you will have to prove that you are a fierce and restless warrior by bringing me 100 perfect behemoth fangs. ...
npc.gregor.say_2: [LT] Secondly, please retrieve a helmet for us which has been lost a long time ago. The famous Ramsay the Reckless wore it when exploring an ape settlement. ...

npc.gregor.say_5: [LT] Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.gregor.stdmod_1: [LT] Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
npc.gregor.stdmod_10: [LT] Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
npc.gregor.stdmod_11: [LT] It is time to join the Knights!
npc.gregor.stdmod_12: [LT] Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
npc.gregor.stdmod_13: [LT] Some day someone will make something happen to him...
npc.gregor.stdmod_14: [LT] A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
npc.gregor.stdmod_15: [LT] I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
npc.gregor.stdmod_16: [LT] Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
npc.gregor.stdmod_18: [LT] Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
npc.gregor.stdmod_2: [LT] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_20: [LT] A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
npc.gregor.stdmod_21: [LT] Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
npc.gregor.stdmod_23: [LT] I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
npc.gregor.stdmod_24: [LT] He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
npc.gregor.stdmod_26: [LT] Only the bravest warriors may wear adorned helmets. They are traditionally awarded after having completed a difficult task for our guild.
npc.gregor.stdmod_3: [LT] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_4: [LT] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.gregor.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_6: [LT] Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_8: [LT] You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
npc.gregor.voice_1: [LT] Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!

npc.grizzly_adams.greet_msg_2: [LT] Welcome to the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite' |PLAYERNAME|. Feel free to do {tasks} for us.

npc.guard_saros.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] I hope to see you soon.

npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_11: [LT] I'll help you find your way through Carlin, the amazon town. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_12: [LT] This city is ruled by Queen Eloise with the help of her female brigade. We have a lot of shops here as well as the usual facilities like depot, temple and so on.

npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_8: [LT] The bank is on the left side of the depot. Eva will be at your service there.

npc.guide_behil.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Daraman's blessings, enjoy your stay in Darashia, |PLAYERNAME|
npc.guide_behil.greet_msg_1: [LT] Daraman's blessings, Black Sabbatth, welcome to Darashia! Would you like some information and a map guide?
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_1: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Darashia? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_10: [LT] I'll show you around Darashia if you like. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_11: [LT] Darashia is an oriental settlement ruled by Caliph Kazzan Ibn Gadral. We have a lot of shops, carpet travel and a rotworm plague, that sums it about up.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_12: [LT] My name is Behil. Glad to be your guide.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm well informed about the status of the world despite all the recent changes.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_3: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Darashia? Let me assist you.

npc.guide_behil.stdmod_6: [LT] The temple is a few floors over the depot. Just walk up the numerous stairs there.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_7: [LT] Muzir takes care of our bank business. His office is in the north-western part of the caliph's palace.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_8: [LT] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_9: [LT] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.

npc.guide_davina.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and enjoy your stay in Liberty Bay, |PLAYERNAME|
npc.guide_davina.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello there, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to Liberty Bay! Would you like some information and a map guide?
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_1: [LT] I'm informed about the status the world is in. If you have questions, let me know.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_10: [LT] Well, I'm a guide. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town. I do this for free, but I'm always happy about a small donation if you can spare some money.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_11: [LT] This city has three main districts - a noble district, a merchant district and the slums. The class difference is clearly visible here. Most shops are in the merchant district. There are also large sugarcane plantations.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm Davina. Glad to help you today.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_2: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Liberty Bay? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_3: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_4: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Liberty Bay? I can show you around the town.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_5: [LT] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_6: [LT] The temple is just north west of the depot. You can't miss it.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_7: [LT] Jefrey, our bank clerk, can be found inside the depot. Easy to find.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_8: [LT] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture and food here.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_9: [LT] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
