npc.guide_davina.voice_4: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Liberty Bay? I can show you around the town.
npc.guide_edna.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Enjoy your stay in Yalahar, |PLAYERNAME|. Meow.
npc.guide_edna.greet_msg_1: [LT] Meow, welcome to Yalahar |PLAYERNAME|! Even though I might not look like it, I can give you {information} and a {map} guide. Need some?
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_1: [LT] Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_2: [LT] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_3: [LT] The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_4: [LT] Our bank clerk Znozel is somewhat... special. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_5: [LT] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_6: [LT] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there, but it's just north of here.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_7: [LT] I'm the only feline guide in Tibia. I might not have fingers anymore, but with my paw I can still mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_8: [LT] Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_9: [LT] I'm Jonathan. Pleased to meet you.
npc.guide_edna.voice_1: [LT] Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me.
npc.guide_elena.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and enjoy your stay in Venore, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.guide_elena.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to Venore, |PLAYERNAME| Would you like some information and a map guide?
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_1: [LT] I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_10: [LT] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_11: [LT] I will help you find your way in the buzzing city of Venore. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_12: [LT] This trading city has been built directly over a swamp and basically stands on stone pillars. We have many large warehouses here. To speak of 'shops' would be an understatement.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm Elena, sweetheart. I love your name, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_2: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Venore? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_3: [LT] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_4: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Venore? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_5: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_6: [LT] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops - well, warehouses - spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the adventurer's guild, hunting grounds, quests and the world status.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_7: [LT] The temple is pretty much in the middle of Venore. If you go south from this harbour, you can't miss it.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_8: [LT] The bank as well as jewel stores can be found in the House of Wealth, in the north-eastern part of Venore. I can mark it on your map if you want.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_9: [LT] You can buy almost everything here! Visit one of our warehouses for weapons, armors, magical equipment, spells, gems, tools, furniture and everything else you can imagine.
npc.guide_elena.voice_1: [LT] I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.
npc.guide_elena.voice_2: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Venore? I can show you around a little.

npc.guide_elena.voice_4: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Venore? Let me assist you.

npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_1: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_10: [LT] The town of Edron with its shops and facilities is built inside strong castle walls. Another remarkable building is the magic academy.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_11: [LT] I'm Jonathan. Pleased to meet you.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_2: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Thais? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_3: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Thais? Let me assist you.

npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_6: [LT] The temple is near the shop area in the eastern part of the castle. Just go downstairs.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_7: [LT] Our local bank clerk is called Ebenizer. You can find him north of the depot, near the food shop.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_8: [LT] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_9: [LT] I'm your guide to the beautiful town Edron. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.

npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_1: [LT] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_10: [LT] This city is a modern marvel of progress. The city's wealth and industry is based on the famous glooth. The magistrate runs the city according to the wishes of its inhabitants.

npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_6: [LT] The First Oramond Bank is an important part of Rathleton, and is situated in the centre of the upper city. I can mark it on your map if you want.

npc.guide_luke.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and enjoy your stay in Thais, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.guide_luke.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello there, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to Thais! Would you like some {information} and a {map} guide?
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_1: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_10: [LT] I'm a guide, overworked and underpaid. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_11: [LT] Thais is the oldest settlement in Tibia. You can hear its history whisper when walking through the streets. Beware of criminals, but else it's a fine city.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm Luke. No jokes, please, I heard them all!
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_2: [LT] Hello, is this your first visit to Thais? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_3: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Thais? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_4: [LT] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_5: [LT] I can tell you all about the {town}, its {temple}, the {bank}, {shops}, {spell trainers} and the {depot}, as well as about the {world status}.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_6: [LT] The temple is in the centre of Thais. Walk east from the harbour and pass by the {depot} until you reach the infamous crossroads, then turn south.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_7: [LT] We have two bankers, Suzy and Naji. Naji is right in the depot. For Suzi, exit the {depot} to the west and walk south-west. Don't forget that I can {mark} important locations on your map.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_8: [LT] You can buy {weapons}, {armor}, {tools}, {gems}, {magical} equipment, {furniture} and {food} here.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_9: [LT] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I {escort} newcomers there.

npc.guide_rahlkora.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to Ankrahmun, |PLAYERNAME| This city can be a bit confusing at first. Would you like some information and a map guide?
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_1: [LT] Need some help finding your way through Ankrahmun? Let me assist you.

npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_12: [LT] Ankrahmun consists almost completely of pyramids. You can walk up and down those pyramids just like you'd climb up stairs. Most shops are on the upper floors.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_13: [LT] My name is Rahlkora. I'm a guide.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_2: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!

npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_7: [LT] The temple is in the south-eastern part of town. If you exit the depot to the south and walk east - slightly south-east - you can't miss it.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_8: [LT] Tesha is in charge of both the bank and the gem store. You can find her on the market pyramid. Just exit the depot on the north side and walk up the next pyramid.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_9: [LT] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.

npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_10: [LT] The elves have constructed Ab'Dendriel mainly in and on trees. There is also a large underground cave system with shops, a prison and troll caves.

npc.guide_tiko.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello there, and welcome to Port Hope! Would you like some information and a map guide?
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_1: [LT] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!

npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_12: [LT] The inhabitants of Port Hope are bravely facing the constant threat from the jungle. The town is built on pile dwellings and most shops are close to each other.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm Tiko and your guide today. Have a good day!

npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_8: [LT] Our bank can be found one floor above the depot. Just talk to Ferks.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_9: [LT] The shops here are very close to one another. I can mark them for you if you'd like.
