npc.gurbasch.stdmod_2: [LT] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Farmine} or {Gnomprona}?
npc.gurbasch.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.habdel.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! See the fine {weapons} I sell.
npc.habdel.stdmod_1: [LT] I sell the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh! Hello! Hello! Did not notice!
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_2: [LT] Be greeted, friend of the ape people. If you want to {trade}, just ask for my offers. If you are injured, ask for healing.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_1: [LT] Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me know many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_2: [LT] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_3: [LT] Things not good now. Need helper to do {mission} for me people.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_4: [LT] We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_5: [LT] Kongra verry strong. Kongra verry angry verry fast. Take care when kongra comes. Better climb on highest tree.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_6: [LT] Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang know {jungle} well.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_7: [LT] Merlkin we are. Merlkin verry wise, merlkin learn many things quick. Teach other apes things a lot. Making {heal} and making {magic}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_8: [LT] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_9: [LT] Jungle is dangerous. Jungle also provides us food. Take care when in jungle and safe you be.
npc.halvar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: [LT] What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: [LT] Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: [LT] My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: [LT] Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: [LT] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: [LT] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: [LT] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: [LT] That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: [LT] The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: [LT] Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: [LT] The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: [LT] It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.hamish.array_1: [LT] Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.array_2:
[LT] Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. \z
				I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. \z
				If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
npc.hamish.say_1: [LT] Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.say_2: [LT] Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.say_3: [LT] Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
npc.hamish.say_4: [LT] Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
npc.hamish.say_5: [LT] I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end!
npc.hamish.say_6: [LT] Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>
npc.hamish.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Take your pick! Or maybe you want to look only at {potions}, {wands} or {runes}?
npc.hamish.stdmod_10: [LT] Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.stdmod_12:
[LT] I craft highly efficient runes, wands and potions - always handy when you're in a fight against monsters! \z
		Ask me for a trade to browse through my stock.
npc.hamish.stdmod_14:
[LT] Never asked about his past. Seems it's a pretty gloomy one. \z
		But he's an excellent blacksmith and seems content enough with his work here.
npc.hamish.stdmod_15:
[LT] Inigo taught me a trick or two since I joined Mr Morris' little crowd. \z
		Quite a nice old chap who's seen much of the world and knows his way around here. \z
		You should definitely ask him if you need help.
npc.hamish.stdmod_16:
[LT] Can be quite feisty if you doubt his seniorship. \z
		<snorts> Knows a thing or two about spells, though. Useful knowledge.
npc.hamish.stdmod_17:
[LT] Keeran? He's a bit like Plunderpurse's shadow, isn't he? \z
		Loves numbers, but I believe underneath it all he always wanted to break out of his boring little job in the city.
npc.hamish.stdmod_18:
[LT] Seems good-natured enough a guy. Nimble with his hands, be it cooking or carpentering. \z
		Seems to want to keep his mind off something, so he's always busy fixing stuff or cooking something up.
npc.hamish.stdmod_19:
[LT] If it wasn't for Mr Morris, maybe none of us would be alive. Or at least, none of us would be here. \z
		He's been everywhere and gathered some adventurers around him to investigate the secrets of Dawnport.
npc.hamish.stdmod_2: [LT] Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_20:
[LT] Our druid, down in the temple. Just appeared out of the blue one day. Keeps to herself. \z
		She must have some reason to stay with us rather than roam the bigger Mainland. Well, we all have our reasons.
npc.hamish.stdmod_21:
[LT] Now there's someone who has lived life to the full! Don't know though \z
		whether I should really believe that he's a clerk now.
npc.hamish.stdmod_3: [LT] You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and buy a new one here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_4: [LT] Ran out of mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!
npc.hamish.stdmod_5: [LT] Low on magic and need a little extra? Get yourself a rune!
npc.hamish.stdmod_6: [LT] Pack of monsters give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!
npc.hamish.stdmod_7: [LT] Health potions to refill your health in combat!
npc.hamish.stdmod_8: [LT] Taking back empty potion flasks! Get your deposit back here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_9: [LT] Careful with that! That's a highly reactive potion you have there!
npc.hamish.voice_10: [LT] Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.voice_2: [LT] Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!
npc.hamish.voice_3: [LT] You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and buy a new one here!
npc.hamish.voice_4: [LT] Ran out of mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!
npc.hamish.voice_5: [LT] Low on magic and need a little extra? Get yourself a rune!
npc.hamish.voice_6: [LT] Pack of monsters give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!
npc.hamish.voice_7: [LT] Health potions to refill your health in combat!
npc.hamish.voice_8: [LT] Taking back empty potion flasks! Get your deposit back here!
npc.hamish.voice_9: [LT] Careful with that! That's a highly reactive potion you have there!
npc.hanna.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Have a look at my wonderful {offers} in gems and jewellery.
npc.hanna.stdmod_1: [LT] Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hanna.stdmod_2: [LT] I am a jeweler. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful offers.
npc.hanna.voice_1: [LT] Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hardek.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.hardek.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need my services?
npc.hardek.stdmod_1: [LT] Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.stdmod_2: [LT] I am buying some weapons and armors.
npc.hardek.voice_1: [LT] Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.harlow.greet_msg_1: [LT] What do you want, |PLAYERNAME|? I'm a {busy} man.
npc.harlow.stdmod_1: [LT] So you are saying you're looking for someone to take you to Vengoth?
npc.harlow.stdmod_10: [LT] Well, I'm kind of a delivery man I guess. I take on small {transportation} jobs with my boat.
npc.harlow.stdmod_3: [LT] I could do that, it's not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 gold pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?
npc.harlow.stdmod_6: [LT] Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 gold?
npc.harlow_vengoth.greet_msg_1: [LT] Want to go back to {Yalahar} for 50 gold? Just ask me.
npc.harlow_vengoth.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage to Yalahar for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.harog.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.harog.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
npc.haroun.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell! May the serene light of the enlightened one rest shine on your travels.
npc.haroun.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.harsky.farewell_msg_1: [LT] LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now!
npc.harsky.stdmod_1: [LT] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.harsky.stdmod_2: [LT] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.hawkhurst.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2: [LT] Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Yes} or {no}?
npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_4: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_2: [LT] Ye' want a passage back to cormaya? {Yes} or {no}.
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_4: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_1: [LT] It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: [LT] Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: [LT] Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: [LT] Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: [LT] Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: [LT] We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eyes open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: [LT] The church of Crunor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: [LT] We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: [LT] The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: [LT] The churches of the gods entrusted me with the enormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: [LT] Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: [LT] Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: [LT] By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: [LT] Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: [LT] The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: [LT] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: [LT] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: [LT] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: [LT] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: [LT] Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
npc.henricus.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] This ungraceful haste is most suspicious!
npc.hireling.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
npc.hireling.greet_msg_1: [LT] It is good to see you. I'm always at your {service}.
npc.hjaern.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. The {spiritual} world looks upon you and your deeds.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_1: [LT] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.humphrey.stdmod_10: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_11: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_12: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_13: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_14: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_15: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_5: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_6: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_7: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_8: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_9: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.huntsman.stdmod_2: [LT] Sorry, I don't think telling a stranger your name is a smart thing to do.
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. You must be the one sent by Lily. Do you have a sack of {herbs} for me?
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_2: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. I still have a present for you! Would you like to have it now?
npc.hyacinth.greet_msg_3: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. As you have found the way to my hut, how can I {help} you?
npc.hyacinth.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here. Don't forget, if you buy potions, there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_1: [LT] Thank you so much! I'm just too old to walk into the village each day, and the herbs must be fresh. Say, would you like to have a sample of my potions as reward?
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_10: [LT] May Crunor bless you and protect you on your journeys!
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_11: [LT] There are only two other druids on Rookgaard, {Lily} and {Cipfried}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_13: [LT] Who knows what it will be? Only time will show.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_15: [LT] What help do you seek? I sell health potions, ask me for a {trade} if you need one.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_16: [LT] I can't teach you magic. On the {mainland} you will learn spells early enough.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_17: [LT] I'm one of the few magic users on this isle. I can sense a follower of the dark path of magic hiding somewhere in the depths of the dungeons.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_18: [LT] It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to question it.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_19: [LT] I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude now.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, then I must have mistaken you with someone else. Or did you lose it on the way?
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_20: [LT] Teaching you about the gods would require too much time. But you can always read the books in the {library}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_21: [LT] The library is in the {academy}, north of the {temple}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_23: [LT] Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have no food here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_24: [LT] Yes, I sell small health potions. Ask me for a trade if you need one.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_25: [LT] I don't care about kings, queens, and the like.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_26: [LT] I rarely visit the town. It's much better here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_27: [LT] There's a huge world waiting for you.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_28: [LT] Most of the so-called monsters of this isle are only creatures of the gods. There are some beasts that are truly monstrous on the {mainland}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_29: [LT] Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have no food here.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_3: [LT] That's too bad... but I'm sure Lily could give you another one. Just walk back and talk to her again.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_30: [LT] The dungeons are dangerous for inexperienced adventurers.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_31: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers. I have only small health potions for sale, though.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_32: [LT] You'll have to buy that from the merchants in town. I'm just a simple druid and healer.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_33: [LT] I'll pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_34: [LT] A greedy and annoying person just like most people are.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_35: [LT] Now she has completely gotten out of her mind.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_36: [LT] He was a promising young druid when something happened to his mind. It's a sad story.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_37: [LT] He does a good job out there.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_38: [LT] I know her since she was little.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_4: [LT] Alright then. Good luck on your travels.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_40: [LT] I saw her stranding with her raft.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_41: [LT] He's a farmer and behaves a little better than his cousin.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_44: [LT] I think she's under bad influence.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_47: [LT] She's a druid. Since she started selling health potions, people visit me only rarely. Which is a good thing, but of course I'll help if I'm needed.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_48: [LT] The oracle will lead you to your {destiny} once you are level 8.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_49: [LT] I think that guy is new. He's a {bank} clerk.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_5: [LT] Oh, but I insist! After all you made the long way. Please, take my reward!
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_50: [LT] He has some inner devils that torture him.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_51: [LT] Tom is the local tanner. That means he always needs fresh corpses or leather.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_6: [LT] Well, make some space and then talk to me again. I give you something really useful.
npc.hyacinth.stdmod_9: [LT] I'm a {druid} and healer, a follower of {Crunor}.
npc.imalas.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? If it's {food}, you've come to the right place.
npc.imalas.stdmod_1: [LT] I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a {trade} if you're hungry
npc.imbuement_assistant.farewell_msg_1: [LT] See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.
npc.imbuement_assistant.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, say {imbuement packages} or {trade} for buy imbuement items.
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_1: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money
npc.imbuement_assistant.say_2: [LT] You have successfully completed your purchase of the items.
npc.imbuement_assistant.voice_1: [LT] Hello adventurer, looking for Imbuement items? Just ask me!
npc.imbuement_assistant.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.
npc.imbul.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage to the
npc.imbul.stdmod_3: [LT] I can bring you either to the {east} end of Port Hope or to the {centre} of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.inigo.array_1:
[LT] It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - no offense meant. \z
					When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, \z
					or a cult, to summon something evil. ...
npc.inigo.array_2:
[LT] If you want to message a specific player, right-click on his or her name and select \z
					'Message to <player name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.
npc.inigo.array_3:
[LT] Anyway. One way or another, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. \z
					Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, \z
					but if you're looking for a quest, go ask Morris for one.
npc.inigo.greet_msg_1: [LT] You came through the {portal}! \z Though it must be different from where you came from, I'm sure you can help us. But first, I can {help} YOU.
npc.inigo.say_1: [LT] It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - no offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_10: [LT] Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful not to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...
npc.inigo.say_11: [LT] If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_12: [LT] There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself not only against {monsters}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {players}, too. ...
npc.inigo.say_13: [LT] To attack, click on your chosen target in the battle list. A red frame will show you which target you are currently attacking. ...
npc.inigo.say_14: [LT] To automatically follow your target, click on 'Chase Opponent' in your combat controls - the top left button. ...
npc.inigo.say_15: [LT] You can also define your attack and defense mode, by selecting {offensive}, {balanced} or {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_16: [LT] Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {players} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...
npc.inigo.say_17: [LT] On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both players consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any player may always attack you, so be watchful. ...
npc.inigo.say_18: [LT] A brown frame around a player indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a player name means he or she attacked or killed another player. ...
npc.inigo.say_19: [LT] Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is not allowed inside the outpost, and not possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_2: [LT] But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {monsters} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...
npc.inigo.say_20: [LT] To chat with other players, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...
npc.inigo.say_21: [LT] If you want to message a specific player, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <player name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.
npc.inigo.say_22: [LT] NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {players} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...
npc.inigo.say_23: [LT] We all have our different ways, but normally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'hello' will open a conversation. ...
npc.inigo.say_24: [LT] Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are not highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your question. ...
npc.inigo.say_25: [LT] To do so, open the NPC Chat Channel and click on the empty space below the NPCs dialogue, and start typing. ...
npc.inigo.say_26: [LT] You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_27: [LT] Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_28: [LT] As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_29: [LT] Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.
npc.inigo.say_3: [LT] You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need help against the monsters that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {help} exactly, I can give you directions.
npc.inigo.say_30: [LT] Second best thing to a rope - a shovel will reveal secret entrances buried under loose stone piles, or under sand, or earth... you will see! ...
npc.inigo.say_31: [LT] Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {monsters} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who knows!
npc.inigo.say_32: [LT] We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unknown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...
npc.inigo.say_33: [LT] When we arrived, we found goblins, minotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...
npc.inigo.say_34: [LT] That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {monsters} battle, but won't leave. ...
npc.inigo.say_35: [LT] It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every help we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...
npc.inigo.say_36: [LT] That is why we need your help - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and help us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any help in how to do these things, ask me.
npc.inigo.say_37: [LT] The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have helped us defend {Dawnport}, and learned enough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...
npc.inigo.say_38: [LT] There you can continue to battle evil - and believe me, there is much of that in our world, alas. <sigh> ...
npc.inigo.say_39: [LT] Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do quests to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.
npc.inigo.say_4: [LT] Hasn't been with us for very long. Very interested in all things mystical, so Menesto was sent down to guard the strange crystal {portal} we found here. ...
npc.inigo.say_40: [LT] Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {spells} of a specific vocation. ...
npc.inigo.say_41: [LT] There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {druid}, {paladin} and {sorcerer}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
npc.inigo.say_42: [LT] We need your help in our battle. Fight {monsters} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_43: [LT] Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_44: [LT] To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_45: [LT] If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_46: [LT] A vocation is your profession and chosen destiny, rolled into one. There are four vocations in {Tibia}: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities with which to fight evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_47: [LT] You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain enough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...
npc.inigo.say_48: [LT] Once you've reached level 8 and want to choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are hurt or poisoned. ...
npc.inigo.say_49: [LT] If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_5: [LT] ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from another plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, not really. But now... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...
npc.inigo.say_50: [LT] I can give you directions how to {play}, some basic survival and {combat} tips, or explain {PvP}, ...
npc.inigo.say_51: [LT] I can also tell you how to talk with other {players} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {questing} or {spells}. ...
npc.inigo.say_52: [LT] I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to know. ...
npc.inigo.say_53: [LT] Oh, but first that help I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!
npc.inigo.say_54: [LT] Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_55: [LT] You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a monster quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_56: [LT] Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_57: [LT] I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_58: [LT] Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_59: [LT] I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {balanced} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_6: [LT] Well, if you have any questions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>
npc.inigo.say_60: [LT] A white skull means that this player attacked and maybe killed another player without justification. ...
npc.inigo.say_61: [LT] A red skull means someone has killed many other {players}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!
npc.inigo.say_62: [LT] Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, selling to travellers along the road. ...
npc.inigo.say_63: [LT] Was robbed and left for dead by some plunderers, when Morris found him. {Morris} patched him up and said he could use him, so Hamish came here. If you need a wand, rune or potion, Hamish's your man.
npc.inigo.say_64: [LT] Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've known him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...
npc.inigo.say_65: [LT] When a fire destroyed his foster family's home, he took up an unsteady life, always wandering around. Then he met {Morris} and decided to go adventuring with him.
npc.inigo.say_66: [LT] Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nobody knows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...
npc.inigo.say_67: [LT] The demon is said to have set Morris free so he can reclaim him at the end of his life, meanwhile having fun watching Morris struggle through hardship and adventures. ...
npc.inigo.say_68: [LT] Anyway. One way or another, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a quest, go ask Morris for one.
npc.inigo.say_69: [LT] Not your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...
npc.inigo.say_7: [LT] Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {monsters}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...
npc.inigo.say_70: [LT] Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is not affected by their magic level. If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_71: [LT] You should never leave without a rope. NEVER. A rope can save your life. I once fell down into a poison spider lair - without a rope, I wouldn't be standing here today! ...
npc.inigo.say_72: [LT] You can buy a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {monsters} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.
npc.inigo.say_73: [LT] Our local healer. Don't know why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...
npc.inigo.say_74: [LT] If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also help you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_75: [LT] When you die, you will be resurrected in the temple of the city you chose as your home. Temple {NPC}s, like {Oressa} here on {Dawnport}, can heal you if you're wounded or poisoned. Some special temple NPCs can also {bless} you. ...
npc.inigo.say_76: [LT] To be fully blessed, you should start the Pilgrimage of Ashes at a local guide in the harbour once you have reached the {mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_77: [LT] Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some items, and other {players} can rob your corpse. ...
npc.inigo.say_78: [LT] On the {Mainland}, you can buy blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent item loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...
npc.inigo.say_79: [LT] Always have a {rope} with you, for a start. A rope is essential.
npc.inigo.say_8: [LT] We need your help in keeping the monsters at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight monsters. ...
npc.inigo.say_80: [LT] Every vocation has specific {spells} that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_81: [LT] As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_82: [LT] Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.
npc.inigo.say_83: [LT] Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {spells} of a specific vocation. ...
npc.inigo.say_84: [LT] There are four {vocations} in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
npc.inigo.say_85: [LT] We need your help in our battle. Fight {monsters} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_86: [LT] Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_87: [LT] To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_88: [LT] If you have any other questions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_89: [LT] The blessings of the gods will protect you from item loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the {mainland} to get the blessings. ...
npc.inigo.say_9: [LT] {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some monsters in order to progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_90: [LT] If you die in a fight from a monster's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...
npc.inigo.say_91: [LT] There is also a blessing that will protect you specifically from losses in a {PvP} fight. This blessing you will need to get again when you have been killed in a PvP fight. ...
npc.inigo.say_92: [LT] Here on {Dawnport}, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you attack another player. If you attack another player or reach level 20, you will lose this blessing.
npc.inigo.say_93: [LT] Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave now, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...
npc.inigo.say_94: [LT] Are you {SURE} you want to {LEAVE} Dawnport for ROOKGAARD?
npc.inigo.stdmod_1: [LT] I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
npc.inigo.stdmod_10:
[LT] I used to be a hunter and trapper, but these bones have grown weary. \z
		I now tan furs and hides and {trade} in creature products. And I can help you find your way if you need directions.
npc.inigo.stdmod_11:
[LT] That's where we are - the world of Tibia. \z
		We're on a small island called {Dawnport}, not far from the coast of the Tibian {Mainland}, to be precise.
npc.inigo.stdmod_12:
[LT] Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. \z
		If you are looking for something to do, you should go to Morris and ask him for quests. \z
		You can also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.inigo.stdmod_13:
[LT] Well, the other fellows you see here, selling stuff and so forth. \z
		Say a name and I'll tell you what I know of him or her.
npc.inigo.stdmod_14:
[LT] Marvellous specimen we have here on {Dawnport}! \z
		Just be careful when you go hunting them, {dying} hurts in {Tibia}! \z
		I will happily buy any creature products you may find.
npc.inigo.stdmod_15:
[LT] Used to be a professor at the magic academy in Edron, I believe. \z
		Likes to see different places, so he joined our illustrous little group. \z
		Sells {sorcerer} and {druid} {spells} to our trainees.
npc.inigo.stdmod_16:
[LT] I'm not sure that's his actual name, but I guess he has good reasons to stay incognito here. \z
		In any case, he's a formidable fighter and knows usefull {spells} for knights and paladins.
npc.inigo.stdmod_17:
[LT] Richard came here as a shipwrecked carpenter, and now sells {tools} and {food} to all adventurers. \z
		If you need a {rope} or {shovel}, {fishing rod} or some provisions for a hunt, you should trade with him!
npc.inigo.stdmod_18:
[LT] Knights are close combat fighters, the toughest vocation of all. \z
		They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.inigo.stdmod_19:
[LT] Druids are nature magicians. \z
		Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.inigo.stdmod_2: [LT] Troll hair, wolf fur, lumps of dirt - bring them to me!
npc.inigo.stdmod_20:
[LT] Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. \z
		You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.inigo.stdmod_21: [LT] Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.inigo.stdmod_22:
[LT] In {Tibia}, you can use different tools with your environment, or for quests. \z
		The most important tools are {rope} and {shovel}. \z
		A {fishing rod}'s also good when you need to eat, and are near a river or the sea.
npc.inigo.stdmod_23:
[LT] Food is very important for your health and mana. \z
		If you are hurt in a fight with a monster, select 'USE' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. \z
		This will slowly refill your health and mana. Here at the outpost, you can buy food from {Richard}.
npc.inigo.stdmod_24:
[LT] Use a fishing rod on a patch of water to see if you can catch fish! \z
		Eating is essential in {Tibia} - if you don't eat when you're hungry, you won't regenerate health or mana. \z
		So you should aways have some {food} with you.
npc.inigo.stdmod_3: [LT] Come to me if you need help!
npc.inigo.stdmod_4: [LT] Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
npc.inigo.stdmod_5: [LT] You came through the portal? Talk to me!
npc.inigo.stdmod_6: [LT] You're going out? Make sure you have a rope with you!
npc.inigo.stdmod_7: [LT] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.inigo.stdmod_8: [LT] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.inigo.stdmod_9:
[LT] Ah, back in the old days, I was called Inigo Verasquiriz, but I doubt my family would acknowledge me. \z
		Those that are still alive, that is.
npc.inigo.voice_1: [LT] I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
npc.inigo.voice_2: [LT] Troll hair, wolf fur, lumps of dirt - bring them to me!
npc.inigo.voice_3: [LT] Come to me if you need help!
npc.inigo.voice_4: [LT] Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
npc.inigo.voice_5: [LT] You came through the portal? Talk to me!
npc.inigo.voice_6: [LT] You're going out? Make sure you have a rope with you!
npc.inigo.voice_7: [LT] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.inigo.voice_8: [LT] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.iptar_sin.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_1: [LT] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_11: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_14: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_16: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_2: [LT] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_3: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_4: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_6: [LT] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_7: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_8: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_9: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.iptar_sin.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.irmana.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the house of fashion, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.ishebad.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned, pilgrim in flesh. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.ishebad.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you want to be promoted in your vocation for 20000 gold?
npc.ishina.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
npc.ishina.stdmod_1: [LT] I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_2: [LT] Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.ishina.stdmod_3: [LT] Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.isimov.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.isimov.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.isimov.stdmod_11: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_12: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.isimov.stdmod_13: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.isimov.stdmod_15: [LT] You should visit Amanda in Edron now, kid.
npc.isimov.stdmod_16: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.isimov.stdmod_17: [LT] A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.isimov.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.isimov.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.isimov.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.isimov.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.isimov.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.isimov.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.isimov.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.isimov.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.isimov.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.isimov.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.isimov.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.isimov.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.isimov.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.isimov.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_1: [LT] You are not one of us. I don't want to talk to you.
npc.iskan.greet_msg_2: [LT] I was told you have been killing huskies here in Svargrond! Never do that again, okay? They are precious animals for us. Give me 500 gold and I will forget that incident without telling it to Jarl Sven. Okay?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_3: [LT] HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Hero of Svargrond! What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.greet_msg_4: [LT] Greetings. What can I {do for you}?
npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_1: [LT] I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ...
npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_2: [LT] To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ...
npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_3: [LT] And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. No idea how we made it home. True story.
npc.iskan.stdmod_1: [LT] I run the dog sled service from this city to {Nibelor}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_10: [LT] The yeti is real and dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_11: [LT] I am not sure what to think about this new custom to accept foreigners as one of us after passing that test. But it's the Jarl's decision, not mine.
npc.iskan.stdmod_12: [LT] The raiders camps are far to the south. There are three of them. Small camp sites of raiding parties might be found almost anywhere though.
npc.iskan.stdmod_13: [LT] They are sometimes trying to catch me and the boys. Such fools, they will never get us. Right, boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_14: [LT] The boys can tell who's an enemy just by the smell.
npc.iskan.stdmod_15: [LT] Me and the boys care only about our own territory.
npc.iskan.stdmod_16: [LT] I guess their healing powers are almost as useful as those of our shamans.
npc.iskan.stdmod_17: [LT] I guess there are guys like me that have a talent to talk to dogs and there are guys like the shamans that have the talent to talk to spirits.
npc.iskan.stdmod_18: [LT] We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
npc.iskan.stdmod_19: [LT] Sven the Younger is our current Jarl. For my standards he's still a puppy, but a smart one at least.
npc.iskan.stdmod_20: [LT] Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
npc.iskan.stdmod_21: [LT] Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
npc.iskan.stdmod_22: [LT] In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.
npc.iskan.stdmod_23: [LT] The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.
npc.iskan.stdmod_3: [LT] I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a {passage}.
npc.iskan.stdmod_4: [LT] This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
npc.iskan.stdmod_5: [LT] Our people are very proud and honest. I guess that's more than most people can say about themselves and their people, right boys?
npc.iskan.stdmod_6: [LT] I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
npc.iskan.stdmod_7: [LT] Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
npc.iskan.stdmod_8: [LT] The boys warn me in advance if a monster is around.
npc.iskan.stdmod_9: [LT] My boys did not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?
npc.ivalisse.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, worshiper of the Astral Shapers! Welcome to the temple! While you are here to pay tribute, you can also learn something about the ancient art of imbuing.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_1: [LT] My {father}, can you tell me if he's alright?
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_2: [LT] Alright then, you are very welcome to explore the temple!
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_4: [LT] There is always time to make a change.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_5: [LT] Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_6: [LT]  I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.ivalisse.stdmod_7: [LT]  I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
npc.iwan.greet_msg_1: [LT] Feel welcome to my gem store, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.iwan.voice_1: [LT] Gems of all kinds! Precious jewellery!
npc.iwar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hiho Storm Killer! Welcome to Kazordoon furniture store.
npc.iyad.farewell_msg_1: [LT] D...Daraman's blessings... oh, how I m...miss my warm Darashia...
npc.iyad.greet_msg_1: [LT] Finally! A c...c...customer! Wh... where do you want to f...f...{fly}?
npc.iyad.stdmod_1: [LT] A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.stdmod_10: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_11: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm k...known as Iyad Ibn Abdul.
npc.iyad.stdmod_13: [LT] The thought of s...some mad sorcerer unleashing some f...fire magic is very tempting.
npc.iyad.stdmod_14: [LT] S...so close and s...still that far away.
npc.iyad.stdmod_15: [LT] For all its m...mistakes, Thais is warm at least.
npc.iyad.stdmod_16: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.stdmod_17: [LT] I would t...trade it for some firewood.
npc.iyad.stdmod_18: [LT] This h...here is no continent. This is h...hell.
npc.iyad.stdmod_19: [LT] Even D...Drefia can't be worse than this land.
npc.iyad.stdmod_2: [LT] Oh p.. please. P... lease let me fly us out of this c... cold.
npc.iyad.stdmod_20: [LT] I d...don't care about any n...news unless it's the announcement of a h....heatwave.
npc.iyad.stdmod_22: [LT] Th...there, in case you have {earmuffs}, I pay w...well!
npc.iyad.stdmod_23: [LT] Do you really have earmuffs f...for me?? If so, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.iyad.stdmod_3: [LT] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.iyad.stdmod_4: [LT] Do you seek a ride to
npc.iyad.stdmod_7: [LT] I'm a licensed c...carpet pilot. I can {transport} you t...to a warm p...place.
npc.iyad.stdmod_8: [LT] I t...{transport} travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. It's w...warm there.
npc.iyad.stdmod_9: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Edron}, to {Kazordoon}, to Z... Zao, to the F...{Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to M... {Marapur} if you like. W....Where do you want to go?
npc.iyad.voice_1: [LT] A... aargh. I wish I had some e... earmuffs to put over this useless t... turban.
npc.iyad.voice_2: [LT] Oh p.. please. P... lease let me fly us out of this c... cold.
npc.jack.array_1: [LT] So it's that name again. You are really determined, aren't you. ...
npc.jack.array_2: [LT] So if he thinks I'm someone he knew who is now 'lost' and needs to come back or whatever - tell him he is WRONG. I always lived here with my mother and sister, I'm happy here and I certainly don't want to go to that academy of yours.
npc.jack.greet_msg_1: [LT] You!! What have you told my family? They are mad at me and I don't even know why! They think I lied to them about working in Edron in secrecy! Why should I even do that!
npc.jack.greet_msg_2: [LT] So, you've returned to Spectulus? What did he say, is anything wrong? You have this strange expression on your face - is there anything wrong? You DID tell me the truth here, didn't you?
npc.jack.greet_msg_3: [LT] Yes? What can I do for you? I hope this won't take long, though.
npc.jack.say_1: [LT] So it's that name again. You are really determined, aren't you. ...
npc.jack.say_2: [LT] So if he thinks I'm someone he knew who is now 'lost' and needs to come back or whatever - tell him he is WRONG. I always lived here with my mother and sister, I'm happy here and I certainly don't want to go to that academy of yours.
npc.jack.voice_1: [LT] Now I need to clean up everything again.
npc.jack.voice_2: [LT] So much to do, so little time, they say...
npc.jack.voice_3: [LT] Could it be...? No. No way.
npc.jack_drone.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.jack_drone.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today? I can travel you back to {thais}.
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage back to thais?
npc.jack_drone.stdmod_2: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_1: [LT] Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_10: [LT] Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_11: [LT] My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm sorry but I don't sail there.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_3: [LT] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_4: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_5: [LT] Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_6: [LT] I have to warn you - we might get into a tropical storm on that route. I'm not sure if my ship will withstand it. Do you really want to travel to Thais?
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_7: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_8: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.jack_fate.stdmod_9: [LT] Where do you want to go? To {Edron}, {Thais}, {Venore}, {Darashia}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Port Hope}?
npc.jack_fate.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_1: [LT] My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_3: [LT] I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh
npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_4: [LT] This is where we are... the volcano island Goroma. There are many rumours about this place.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! There is much we have to {discuss}.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello, stranger! You look suspicious to me. I don't think we have anything to discuss.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_4: [LT] Hello, stranger! Sorry, but I never heard about you. I'm looking for more experienced help.
npc.jack_springer.kw_locations_1: [LT] We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ...
npc.jack_springer.kw_locations_2: [LT] in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_10: [LT] Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11: [LT] In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12: [LT] Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13: [LT] The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14: [LT] These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15: [LT] We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_16: [LT] Death cultists of the Shiron'Fal are trying to locate the bodies of fallen knights and raise them in blasphemous {rituals}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_17: [LT] The churches of the gods worked hand in hand to supply us with the means to {purge} the graves of those knights.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3: [LT] I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_4: [LT] The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_5: [LT] You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_6: [LT] Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_7: [LT] The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_8: [LT] This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_9: [LT] Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
npc.jakahr.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was an honour to serve you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.jakahr.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, mourned pilgrim. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.jakahr.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.jakahr.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] It was an honour to serve you.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_1: [LT] Gerimor is right. As an expert for minotaurs I am researching these creatures for years. I thought I already knew a lot but the monsters in this cave are {different}. It's a big {mystery}.
npc.jamesfrancis.voice_1: [LT] Don't enter this area if you are an inexperienced fighter! It would be your end!
npc.jean_pierre.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. What are you doing out here?
npc.jefrey.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jefrey.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jerom.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello. Sorry, but I'm not in the best {mood} today.
npc.jerom.stdmod_10: [LT] I like it here, at least the town. I was warned that there are nasty creatures outside the town walls but I didn't expect anything to happen so close to town!
npc.jerom.stdmod_11: [LT] I was always good with animals. My parents had a farm, the McRonalds farm. Maybe you know it. Anyway, I had the idea that people may like to have animals as companions and so one led to another.
npc.jerom.stdmod_12: [LT] I'd go mad listening to this 'ribbit' the whole time. But each to his own!
npc.jerom.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_14: [LT] I need to write a letter to the king. I'm not sure if those 2 million gold coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.
npc.jerom.stdmod_15: [LT] I'm there from time to time, catching frogs. People like their bright colours.
npc.jerom.stdmod_16: [LT] My name is Jerom but no need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!
npc.jerom.stdmod_17: [LT] Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore now that I'm ruined.
npc.jerom.stdmod_18: [LT] Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least no animals that pass off as pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_19: [LT] Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_2: [LT] Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_20: [LT] True, why not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_21: [LT] That would be a mission for a hero.
npc.jerom.stdmod_22: [LT] Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country now.
npc.jerom.stdmod_23: [LT] Good idea! Easy to catch and once the owner has been bitten, he can't sue me anymore, hehehe!!.... but wait....I forgot....I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_24: [LT] I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
npc.jerom.stdmod_25: [LT] I don't have anything to earn a living with, everything is destroyed! Otherwise I could offer you pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_26: [LT] I saw a troll rummaging in the remains of my house last night! I'm sure this creature is behind that! But I am too weak to take revenge.
npc.jerom.stdmod_27: [LT] I've been to town and on my way back I heard a deafening sound. Then I saw that the sound came from a huge rock smashing my house.
npc.jerom.stdmod_3: [LT] Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jerom.stdmod_4: [LT] The only animal to catch there is the cobra and most people don't like to keep one as a pet.
npc.jerom.stdmod_5: [LT] Who wants such an animal as a pet?!?!
npc.jerom.stdmod_6: [LT] Those amazons denied making business with me. You know the reason?!? I tell you, the reason was that I am MALE! Ridiculous!
npc.jerom.stdmod_7: [LT] For sure, I would have offered cats!
npc.jerom.stdmod_8: [LT] He gave me the permission to open up a pet shop here. I paid him almost everything I got!
npc.jerom.stdmod_9: [LT] I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to sell me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!
npc.jerom.voice_2: [LT] Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.voice_3: [LT] Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jeronimo.voice_1: [LT] Change your Bar of Gold's for Items here!
npc.jessica.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jessica.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jezzara.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. Talking of flesh, maybe you'd enjoy some {food}?
npc.jezzara.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Sure, take a look at my offers.
npc.jezzara.voice_1: [LT] Food of various kinds, have a look.
npc.julius.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. I assume you have read the {note} about the {vampire} threat in this city.
npc.julius.greet_msg_2: [LT] Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Please excuse me if I appear {distracted}!
npc.julius.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] I'll reward you for every pair of vampire teeth you bring me.
npc.julius.stdmod_1: [LT] I come from a family of {vampire} hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning.
npc.julius.stdmod_2: [LT] A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me.
npc.julius.stdmod_4: [LT] Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes.
npc.julius.stdmod_5: [LT] It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again.
npc.julius.stdmod_6: [LT] Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new.
npc.julius.stdmod_7: [LT] Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess.
npc.junkar_mines.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You are lucky that the service is running right now. Save your coal for the days to come though!
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_1: [LT] So much to do. So many things to be fixed.
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_4: [LT] Well, then you stay here, simple as that.
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_5: [LT] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Thais} or to {Robsons Isle}?
npc.junkar_mines.voice_1: [LT] So much to do. So many things to be fixed.

npc.kais.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hmm... surely you are in need of {help} - will you let me? I am {Kais} the Bound and I can lend you a hand in {healing} your body and soul or even grant an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.kais.stdmod_1: [LT] I have the power to grant you the blood of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you prepared for that?
npc.kais.stdmod_10: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kais.stdmod_11: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kais.stdmod_12: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.kais.stdmod_13: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.kais.stdmod_14: [LT] I know everyone and everything. It is certain that there is another enhanced blessing, the 'heart of the mountain'. Talk to a nomad far to the west of Svargrond, hiding slightly above ground.
npc.kais.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.kais.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.kais.stdmod_5: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kais.stdmod_6: [LT] I am Kais, Kais the Bound. Eternally {fixed} to the wretched place, unless... unless I prove my worth in aiding all those who seek my {help}.
npc.kais.stdmod_7: [LT] Well, as I am quite in a fix currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.kais.stdmod_8: [LT] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.kais.stdmod_9: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.karith.greet_1: [LT] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.

npc.karith.stdmod_2: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_3: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_4: [LT] I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
npc.karith.stdmod_5: [LT] The city was a marvel to behold. It is certain that it have been the many foreigners that ruined it.

npc.kasmir.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_11: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_12: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_13: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_15: [LT] You should visit Rahkem in Ankrahmun now, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_16: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_17: [LT] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
