npc.kawill.stdmod_1: [LT] The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great pyromancer in the nearby fire temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix?
npc.kawill.stdmod_10: [LT] Nice world in general. It's a shame there is so much water ruining the general impression.
npc.kawill.stdmod_12: [LT] May the earth swallow them all!
npc.kawill.stdmod_13: [LT] Ah, a weapon to be feared by man, beast and god alike, jawoll. He who wields it will be both blessed and cursed at the same time.
npc.kawill.stdmod_14: [LT] The day will come when he finally bites the dust.
npc.kawill.stdmod_15: [LT] By using the powers of fire and earth we forced the river that once wound its way through the big old one in other directions, and created our home.
npc.kawill.stdmod_16: [LT] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_17: [LT] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_18: [LT] The first knight of dwarvenkind is a fine woman.
npc.kawill.stdmod_19: [LT] I fear the sorcerers focus on the destructive forces of fire. They forget about the protection earth could provide.
npc.kawill.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the blessing of the life-giving earth, pilgrim.
npc.kawill.stdmod_20: [LT] He is a jolly fellow and one of the oldest dwarves alive.
npc.kawill.stdmod_21: [LT] He is a fine smith and his armour may save your neck one day.
npc.kawill.stdmod_22: [LT] She is a fine cook, jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_23: [LT] Uzgod is a blacksmith and understands the ways of his element well.
npc.kawill.stdmod_24: [LT] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_25: [LT] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_26: [LT] The celestial paladin, the protector of our race. The only divine being we care for and the only one who still cares for dwarfs.
npc.kawill.stdmod_27: [LT] Where earth is giving, fire is taking. That is the way of the elements.
npc.kawill.stdmod_28: [LT] The lifegiving earth protects us, feeds us and takes us home after death.
npc.kawill.stdmod_29: [LT] The mountain we live in is called the big old one. It's the mountain of mountains, and it isand like a friend and protector to our race.
npc.kawill.stdmod_3: [LT] Ok. If you don't want it...
npc.kawill.stdmod_4: [LT] The gods are treacherous and vain. They want to use us like they did in the past. Only the elements can be trusted, because all they want is for nature to run its set course.
npc.kawill.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the great geomancer of dwarvenkind.
npc.kawill.stdmod_6: [LT] We investigate the will of the earth. It is our duty to make sure things to work in their natural way.
npc.kawill.stdmod_7: [LT] Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
npc.kawill.stdmod_8: [LT] I am Kawill Marbleeye, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_9: [LT] There's nothing I need, better ask others.
npc.kawill.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Earth under your feet, pilgrim. What brings you here?
npc.kaya.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.kaya.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.kendra.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.

npc.king_tibianus.greet_1: [LT] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.greet_2: [LT] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_1: [LT] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_10: [LT] The latest news is usually brought to our magnificent town by brave adventurers. They recount tales of their journeys at Frodo's tavern.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_13: [LT] Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_14: [LT] Honour the Gods and above all pay your {taxes}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_15: [LT] Please ask a priest about the gods.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_16: [LT] The citizens of Tibia are my subjects. Ask the old monk Quentin if you want to learn more about them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_17: [LT] He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_18: [LT] He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_19: [LT] He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he sells equipment.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_20: [LT] He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile so we assigned him to work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_21: [LT] The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest {treasure}!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_22: [LT] He is a follower of the evil God Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_23: [LT] He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_24: [LT] The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_25: [LT] Go and hunt them! For king and country!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_26: [LT] Visit Quentin the monk for help.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_28: [LT] Dungeons are no places for kings.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_29: [LT] Feel free to buy it in our town's fine shops.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_3: [LT] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_30: [LT] Ask the royal cook for some food.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_31: [LT] That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_32: [LT] I am the king, so watch what you say!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_34: [LT] Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_35: [LT] The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_36: [LT] Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_37: [LT] The forces of good are hard pressed in these dark times.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_38: [LT] We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_4: [LT] It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_41: [LT] It's the sword of the Kings. If you return this weapon to me I will {reward} you beyond your wildest dreams.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_42: [LT] Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_43: [LT] A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_44: [LT] This organisation is an essential tool for holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_45: [LT] Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_46: [LT] Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious {army}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_47: [LT] I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_48: [LT] To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_5: [LT] Awesome! Please pay a visit to www.otserv.com.br!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_50: [LT] Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_51: [LT] They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_52: [LT] Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_54: [LT] The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_55: [LT] The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_56: [LT] The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_57: [LT] We need the druidic healing powers to fight evil.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_58: [LT] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_59: [LT] I greet thee, my loyal subject |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_6: [LT] Baah is awesome dude that rewrote my outfit script.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_7: [LT] I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and it's my duty to uphold {justice} and provide guidance for my subjects.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_8: [LT] I try my best to be just and fair to our citizens. The army and the {TBI} are a great help in fulfilling this duty.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_9: [LT] Preposterous! You must know the name of your own King!

npc.klom_stonecutter.kw_defences_1: [LT] The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.kw_defences_2: [LT] I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.kw_defences_3: [LT] I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.kw_enemy_1: [LT] I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.kw_enemy_2: [LT] But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_4: [LT] Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_5: [LT] Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
npc.kroox.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to Kroox Quality Armor, |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna take a look, ask me for a trade.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: [LT] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.lailene.greet_msg_1: [LT] What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: [LT] ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.greet_msg_1: [LT] Since you are obviously not one of my relatives who pays me a long overdue visit, we should get {work} right away. We'll see if you can prove your {worth} to our alliance.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.kw_job_1: [LT] Leading the charge! It's a war down here. I maintain the outer defences and supplies which are organised back in Kazordoon and also by the gnomes. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.kw_job_2: [LT] I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an oportunity to help destroying the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.kw_job_3: [LT] But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: [LT] Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: [LT] Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lazaran.greet_msg_1: [LT] Me greet. You no enemy of tribe.
npc.lea.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
npc.lea.stdmod_3: [LT] Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
npc.lea.stdmod_4: [LT] Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
npc.lea.stdmod_5: [LT] Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
npc.lea.stdmod_6: [LT] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lea.stdmod_7: [LT] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lector.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, take a good look at my meat.
npc.lector.stdmod_1: [LT] I can offer you ham or meat. If you'd like to check the quality of my wares, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.greet_msg_1: [LT] Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_1: [LT] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_10: [LT] There are many merchants in this village. Just ask them for a {trade} to see their offers. But I can promise you - my offers are the best around!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_11: [LT] I'm fine. I'm delighted to welcome you as my customer.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_12: [LT] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_13: [LT] How can I help you? Would you like to {trade} with me? I can also give you general {hints}. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_14: [LT] You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_15: [LT] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_16: [LT] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_17: [LT] Well, very important equipment would be a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark {dungeon}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_18: [LT] I sell fishing rods and worms in case you want to go fishing. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_19: [LT] You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_2: [LT] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_20: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry, that's one of the things I don't have for sale. But {Willie} or {Billy} surely have something to eat for you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_21: [LT] The king supports our little village very much!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_22: [LT] In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_23: [LT] Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the {mainland} -  so much to explore!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_24: [LT] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the {oracle}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_25: [LT] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_26: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_27: [LT] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_28: [LT] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_29: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell {footballs}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_3: [LT] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_30: [LT] I really love flowers. My favourites are {honey flowers}. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_31: [LT] You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_32: [LT] Yes, I'm selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_33: [LT] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_34: [LT] He sells {weapons}. However, I can offer you better deals than him!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_35: [LT] I'm glad she stopped selling stuff. There was too much of a competition going on!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_36: [LT] Sometimes, I see him walking outside the village near some hole.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_37: [LT] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_38: [LT] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_39: [LT] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_40: [LT] She lives under the {academy}. Always nice to chat with her!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_41: [LT] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_42: [LT] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters carry also food such as meat. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_43: [LT] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_44: [LT] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just as I do.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_45: [LT] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_46: [LT] She buys all {blueberries} and {cookies} you can find.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_47: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_48: [LT] He is the {bank} clerk, just below the academy.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_49: [LT] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has a lot of important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_50: [LT] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_51: [LT] He is a great warrior and our protector.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_52: [LT] Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_55: [LT] Oh, but it's fun to play!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_56: [LT] Oh, thank you so much! Please take this piece of armor as reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_6: [LT] I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_8: [LT] Well, it's a good idea to leave most of your money in the bank and only take what you need. That way your gold is safe.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_9: [LT] Oh no! I've got to watch what I eat. {Lily} loves cookies, though.
npc.lee_delle.voice_1: [LT] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.voice_2: [LT] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.voice_3: [LT] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.legola.stdmod_1: [LT] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.legola.stdmod_2: [LT] We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.legola.voice_1: [LT] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.liane.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.liane.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.liane.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.liane.voice_2: [LT] Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.liane.voice_3: [LT] If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.liane.voice_4: [LT] No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you!
npc.liane.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.lily.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
npc.lily.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.greet_msg_3: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
npc.lily.kw_premium_1: [LT] If you purchase premium time for your account, this opens up a lot of possibilities. ...
npc.lily.kw_premium_2: [LT] For example, you will be able to travel off the mainland, ride a mount and benefit from offline training as well as having more outfits and magic spells to choose from.
npc.lily.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.lily.stdmod_1: [LT] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.stdmod_10: [LT] Is something... wrong? You didn't lose the herbs, did you?
npc.lily.stdmod_11: [LT] Well, at least you're honest. I can give you another sack, but only if you promise not to lose them this time. Okay?
npc.lily.stdmod_12: [LT] Phew. That's a relief. Well, don't forget to deliver them to Hyacinth! They have to be fresh to create potions.
npc.lily.stdmod_13: [LT] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_14: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_15: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_16: [LT] How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
npc.lily.stdmod_17: [LT] You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
npc.lily.stdmod_18: [LT] I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
npc.lily.stdmod_19: [LT] I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_2: [LT] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.stdmod_20: [LT] My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
npc.lily.stdmod_21: [LT] It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
npc.lily.stdmod_22: [LT] It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
npc.lily.stdmod_23: [LT] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.lily.stdmod_24: [LT] Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
npc.lily.stdmod_25: [LT] Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
npc.lily.stdmod_26: [LT] Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
npc.lily.stdmod_27: [LT] There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
npc.lily.stdmod_28: [LT] The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.lily.stdmod_29: [LT] Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
npc.lily.stdmod_3: [LT] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.stdmod_30: [LT] Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_31: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_32: [LT] I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
npc.lily.stdmod_33: [LT] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lily.stdmod_34: [LT] I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
npc.lily.stdmod_35: [LT] The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
npc.lily.stdmod_36: [LT] Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
npc.lily.stdmod_37: [LT] To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
npc.lily.stdmod_38: [LT]  If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
npc.lily.stdmod_39: [LT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.lily.stdmod_4: [LT] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.stdmod_40: [LT] The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
npc.lily.stdmod_41: [LT] Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
npc.lily.stdmod_42: [LT] If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_43: [LT] Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_44: [LT] Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_45: [LT] If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
npc.lily.stdmod_46: [LT] Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
npc.lily.stdmod_47: [LT] Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_48: [LT] Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lily.stdmod_49: [LT] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_5: [LT] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.stdmod_50: [LT] You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_51: [LT] Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
npc.lily.stdmod_53: [LT] Sorry, you do not have one.
npc.lily.stdmod_55: [LT] Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
npc.lily.stdmod_57: [LT] Oh, I'm sorry. I'm not buying less than 5 blueberries.
npc.lily.stdmod_59: [LT] He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
npc.lily.stdmod_6: [LT] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lily.stdmod_60: [LT] I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
npc.lily.stdmod_61: [LT] He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
npc.lily.stdmod_62: [LT] We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
npc.lily.stdmod_63: [LT] That poor old woman. I wish I could help her.
npc.lily.stdmod_64: [LT] Best tool shop in town, if you ask me.
npc.lily.stdmod_65: [LT] I heard that she's recovering below the academy. She has been on an exciting expedition. I haven't talked to her yet, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_66: [LT] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lily.stdmod_67: [LT] She's {Obi}'s granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just upstairs from Obi's shop.
npc.lily.stdmod_68: [LT] Hyacinth also sells small health potions. He lives outside the village, in a hidden place.
npc.lily.stdmod_69: [LT] If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.lily.stdmod_7: [LT] Oh. In that case, maybe you're interested in a {trade} - I sell potions and buy a few other things.
npc.lily.stdmod_71: [LT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lily.stdmod_72: [LT] He takes care of the {bank}, keeping our money safe.
npc.lily.stdmod_73: [LT] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lily.stdmod_74: [LT] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lily.stdmod_75: [LT] He is a great warrior. He can also tell you much about {monsters} and {dungeons} on this island.
npc.lily.stdmod_76: [LT] He's a farmer and sells {food}. Food will help you regain health when you are injured. Many {monsters} also carry food with them.
npc.lily.stdmod_8: [LT] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: [LT] No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.voice_1: [LT] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.voice_2: [LT] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.voice_3: [LT] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.voice_4: [LT] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.voice_5: [LT] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.voice_6: [LT] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lisander.greet_msg_1: [LT] I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
npc.lokur.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.lokur.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: [LT] I heard he is some scary magician or so.
npc.lorek.stdmod_4: [LT] I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
npc.lorietta.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.lorietta.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.lothar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
npc.lothar.stdmod_1: [LT] I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.lothar.stdmod_10: [LT] I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
npc.lothar.stdmod_11: [LT] Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
npc.lothar.stdmod_12: [LT] What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
npc.lothar.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
npc.lothar.stdmod_14: [LT] Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
npc.lothar.stdmod_15: [LT] I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
npc.lothar.stdmod_16: [LT] What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
npc.lothar.stdmod_17: [LT] Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
npc.lothar.stdmod_18: [LT] Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
npc.lothar.stdmod_19: [LT] Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
npc.lothar.stdmod_2: [LT] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_20: [LT] That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
npc.lothar.stdmod_21: [LT] The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_22: [LT] Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
npc.lothar.stdmod_23: [LT] Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
npc.lothar.stdmod_24: [LT] As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
npc.lothar.stdmod_25: [LT] You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
npc.lothar.stdmod_26: [LT] Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_27: [LT] Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
npc.lothar.stdmod_28: [LT] How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
npc.lothar.stdmod_29: [LT] You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
npc.lothar.stdmod_3: [LT] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_30: [LT] Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
npc.lothar.stdmod_31: [LT] That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
npc.lothar.stdmod_32: [LT] As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
npc.lothar.stdmod_33: [LT] Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
npc.lothar.stdmod_34: [LT] The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
npc.lothar.stdmod_35: [LT] Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
npc.lothar.stdmod_4: [LT] I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
npc.lothar.stdmod_5: [LT] It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
npc.lothar.stdmod_6: [LT] Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
npc.lothar.stdmod_7: [LT] Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
npc.lothar.stdmod_8: [LT] That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
npc.lothar.stdmod_9: [LT] Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
npc.lothar.voice_1: [LT] I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.loui.stdmod_10: [LT] They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
npc.loui.stdmod_11: [LT] Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_12: [LT] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_13: [LT] Everything around us, that is Tibia.
npc.loui.stdmod_14: [LT] Most adventurers take their first steps there.
npc.loui.stdmod_15: [LT] Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
npc.loui.stdmod_16: [LT] This is the place where everything starts.
npc.loui.stdmod_17: [LT] Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_18: [LT] There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_19: [LT] Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
npc.loui.stdmod_20: [LT] The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
npc.loui.stdmod_21: [LT] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_22: [LT] I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
npc.loui.stdmod_23: [LT] I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
npc.loui.stdmod_24: [LT] She owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_25: [LT] She owns a bar in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_26: [LT] Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
npc.loui.stdmod_27: [LT] He has his own monsters, I believe.
npc.loui.stdmod_29: [LT] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_3: [LT] What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_30: [LT] Who's that? Never heard about her.
npc.loui.stdmod_31: [LT] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_33: [LT] The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
npc.loui.stdmod_34: [LT] A hermit on the other side of town.
npc.loui.stdmod_35: [LT] The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
npc.loui.stdmod_37: [LT] Seymour is the headmaster of the local {academy}.
npc.loui.stdmod_38: [LT] I'm sure he has never seen monsters like those in this hole before.
npc.loui.stdmod_39: [LT] I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!
npc.loui.stdmod_5: [LT] I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_6: [LT] I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
npc.loui.stdmod_7: [LT] They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
npc.loui.stdmod_8: [LT] I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
npc.loui.stdmod_9: [LT] While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
npc.loui.voice_3: [LT] What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.lubo.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
npc.lubo.stdmod_1: [LT] Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lubo.stdmod_2: [LT] I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.
npc.lubo.stdmod_3: [LT] This is Ruffy my dog, please don't do him any harm.
npc.lubo.stdmod_4: [LT] I sell torches, fishing rods, worms, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
npc.lubo.stdmod_5: [LT] I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
npc.lubo.stdmod_6: [LT] Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
npc.lubo.stdmod_7: [LT] My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
npc.lubo.stdmod_8: [LT] Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
npc.lubo.stdmod_9: [LT] There are some strange stories about a magicians pet names. Ask Hoggle about it.
npc.lubo.voice_1: [LT] Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lukosch.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.luna.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my {offers}...
npc.luna.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.luna.stdmod_1: [LT] Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.luna.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm selling various herbs, mushrooms, and flowers. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.luna.voice_1: [LT] Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.lurik.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the {explorer society} headquarter of Svargrond, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lynda.array_1: [LT] Dear friends and family, we are gathered here today to witness and celebrate the union of
npc.lynda.array_4: [LT] Through their time together, they have come to realize that their personal dreams, hopes, and goals are more attainable and more meaningful through the combined effort and mutual support provided in love, commitment, and family;
npc.lynda.array_5: [LT] and so they have decided to live together as husband and wife. And now, by the power vested in me by the Gods of Tibia, I hereby pronounce you husband and wife.
npc.lynda.array_6: [LT] *After a whispered blessing opens an hand towards
npc.lynda.array_7: [LT] * Take these two engraved wedding rings and give one of them to your spouse.
npc.lynda.array_8: [LT] You may now kiss your bride.
npc.lynda.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.lynda.stdmod_3: [LT] Great! Marriages should be an eternal commitment.
npc.lynda.stdmod_4: [LT] Ok, you are now divorced of {
npc.lynda.stdmod_5: [LT] Would you like to get married? Make sure you have a wedding ring and the wedding outfit box with you.
npc.lynda.stdmod_7: [LT] And who would you like to marry?
npc.lynda.stdmod_8: [LT] Is your soulmate and friends here with you for the celebration?
npc.maealil.greet_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.maealil.stdmod_11: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake.
npc.maealil.stdmod_12: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.maealil.stdmod_13: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Peace may fill your soul - evil shall be cleansed'. Now, bring your stake to Yberius in the Venore temple for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.maealil.stdmod_15: [LT] You should visit Yberius in the Venore temple now.
npc.maealil.stdmod_16: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_17: [LT] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.maealil.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.maealil.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.maealil.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.maealil.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.maealil.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.maealil.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.maealil.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.maealil.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.maealil.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.maealil.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.maealil.stdmod_32: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.maealil.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.maealil.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.maealil.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.maealil.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.maelyrra.farewell_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.maelyrra.greet_msg_1: [LT] Nature's blessings! Welcome to the land of dreams.
npc.maelyrra.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May your path always be even.
npc.maeryn.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, visitor. I wonder what may lead you to this {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.voice_1: [LT] Not enough purple nightshade ... not enough liquid silver. *sigh*
npc.maeryn.voice_2: [LT] You think the full moon is a romantic affair? Think again!
npc.maeryn.voice_3: [LT] This place isn't safe. You should leave this island.
npc.malor.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, human. When I have taken my rightful place I shall remember those who served me well. Even if they are only humans.
npc.malunga.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings. I have only little time to {spare}, so the conversation will be short. I teach sorcerer {spells} and buy a few magical {ingredients}.
npc.marina.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|. A visitor, how nice!
npc.marina.stdmod_1: [LT] Sorry, I don't have a spare comb. I lost my favourite one when diving around in Calassa.
npc.maris.greet_msg_1: [LT] I hope you have a good reason to step near my {ship}, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.maris.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you want go to the
npc.maris.stdmod_3: [LT] I can take you to {Fenrock} and {Mistrock}!
npc.maris.stdmod_4: [LT] I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris.stdmod_5: [LT] Stop mumbling and don't bug me.
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_3: [LT] I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_4: [LT] I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Mistrock}!
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_5: [LT] I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_fenrock.stdmod_6: [LT] I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_3: [LT] I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Fenrock}!
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_4: [LT] I can take you to {Yalahar} or {Fenrock}!
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_5: [LT] I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.maris_mistrock.stdmod_6: [LT] I am Maris, Captain of this ship.
npc.markwin.greet_msg_2: [LT] Well ... you defeated my guards! Now everything is over! I guess I will have to answer your questions now.
npc.markwin.greet_msg_3: [LT] Oh its you again. What du you want, hornless messenger?
npc.marlene.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
npc.marlene.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_2: [LT] I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_3: [LT] Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
npc.marlene.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
npc.marlene.stdmod_5: [LT] My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
npc.marvin.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
npc.mazarius.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
npc.mehkesh.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
npc.mehkesh.voice_1: [LT] Potions brewed by the leading alchemists of the land!
npc.melchior.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melchior.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
npc.melfar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
npc.melian.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
npc.melian.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a ride to
npc.melian.stdmod_10: [LT] Only licensed carpet pilots are allowed to fly those.
npc.melian.stdmod_11: [LT] There's so much green stuff down there that I'm not sure whether there are any, but yes, might be, might be.
npc.melian.stdmod_12: [LT] Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_13: [LT] Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_14: [LT] That's the name of that dwarven base as far as I know. Got a bit of a pessimistic ring to it if you ask me. Sounds to me like they're starving.
npc.melian.stdmod_15: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_16: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_17: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_18: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_19: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia} on {Darama}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Svargrond} on Hrodmir, to {Edron}, to the {Femor Hills}, to {Issavi} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_20: [LT] The only humans I've seen on this continent are those that come up to my carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_21: [LT] What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
npc.melian.stdmod_22: [LT] You are probably talking about the {FEMOR hills}.
npc.melian.stdmod_23: [LT] It's 2:55 pm right now. I think I'm five minutes late in my schedule.
npc.melian.stdmod_3: [LT] There are many of them to the north and south of this continent. I had thought they only existed on Tiquanda, but I was mistaken.
npc.melian.stdmod_4: [LT] What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
npc.melian.stdmod_5: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Edron}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.melian.stdmod_6: [LT] I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_7: [LT] I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_9: [LT] These mountains don't look friendly. I prefer not staying long inbetween my carpet trips.
npc.memech.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.
npc.memech.voice_1: [LT] Selling weapons and armors to protect mortal souls.
npc.menesto.array_1:
[LT] Finally, reinforcements - oh but no, you came through the crystal portal, like the others! \z
					I am ser Menesto, I guard the portal. That beast caught me by surprise, I lost my dagger and had to retreat. ...
npc.menesto.say_1: [LT] Finally, reinforcements - oh but no, you came through the crystal portal, like the others! I am ser Menesto, I guard the portal. That beast caught me by surprise, I lost my dagger and had to retreat. ...
npc.menesto.say_4: [LT] You look hungry, you should eat regularly to reagain your strength! See what you can find while hunting. Or buy food in a city shop. Here, have some of my rations, I'll take my dagger. Tell me when you're {ready}.
npc.menesto.say_5: [LT] I'll stay here till reinforcements come. Go up the ladder to reach the surface. You'll need a rope for the ropestot that comes after the ladder - here, take my spare equipment. ...
npc.menesto.say_6: [LT] And remember: Tibia is a world with many dangers and mysteries, so be careful! Farewell, friend.
npc.miles_the_guard.stdmod_1: [LT] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.mirabell.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.mirabell.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_1: [LT] The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_2: [LT] I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_3: [LT] Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.mirabell.voice_1: [LT] The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.miraia.greet_msg_1: [LT] Daraman's blessings, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Enlightened Oasis. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.miraia.stdmod_1: [LT] I can offer you lemonade, camel milk, and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.miraia.stdmod_2: [LT] Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.moe.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.
npc.moe.voice_1: [LT] The menu of the day sounds delicious!
npc.moe.voice_2: [LT] The last visit to the theatre was quite rewarding.
npc.moe.voice_3: [LT] Such a beautiful and wealthy city - with so many opportunities ...
npc.mordecai.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
npc.mordecai.voice_1: [LT] Come in, young mages! Purchase the latest in runes and wands!
npc.mordecai.voice_2: [LT] Perhaps I need to bake them hotter? Or was it longer?
npc.mordecai.voice_3: [LT] Offering all sorts of magic equipment!
npc.mordecai.voice_4: [LT] Now where did Alaistar put the wood for the new wands?
npc.mordecai.voice_5: [LT] Hmmm.. Maybe those crushed gems caused the strange side effect?
npc.mordecai.voice_6: [LT] Wands and rods, the true magician's weapons of choice!
npc.morgan.stdmod_1: [LT] I can forge the finest {weapons} for knights and warriors. They may wear them proudly and visible to everyone.
npc.morgan.stdmod_2: [LT] Would you rather be interested in a {knight's sword} or in a {warrior's sword}?
npc.mother_of_jack.greet_msg_1: [LT] I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_2: [LT] Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_3: [LT] There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
npc.mr_brandon.voice_1: [LT] <grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_2: [LT] All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.
npc.mr_morris.array_1:
[LT] One of our ...less fortunate members lost an ancient amulet somewhere on the island, \z
					along with his life. If you could retrieve the amulet at least, there's a little reward. \z
					Would you go on that errand?
npc.mr_morris.array_2:
[LT] Look for a bush with yellow glowing flower buds. It grows only on a special, \z
						light grey-brown sand, and is usually surrounded by fireflies. \z
						Use the herb to pluck off the fresh flower buds, and return to me.
npc.mr_morris.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young adventurer. \z If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.
npc.mr_morris.say_1: [LT] One of our ...less fortunate members lost an ancient amulet somewhere on the island, along with his life. If you could retrieve the amulet at least, there's a little reward. Would you go on that errand?
npc.mr_morris.say_10: [LT] I will reward you if you kill 20 minotaur bruisers. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_2: [LT] Ah, you found the amulet! Ah. Really? Poor Dormovo. Always a bit hasty. Forgot his rope, or food, or potions - it was to be expected he would meet an early end. Oh, well. ...
npc.mr_morris.say_3: [LT] Splendid. Those Dawnfire buds are just the thing against nasty troll bites, you know? But they're quite rare.
npc.mr_morris.say_4: [LT] Look for a bush with yellow glowing flower buds. It grows only on a special, light grey-brown sand, and is usually surrounded by fireflies. Use the herb to pluck off the fresh flower buds, and return to me.
npc.mr_morris.say_5: [LT] Mountain trolls are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_6: [LT] I will reward you if you kill 20 mountain trolls. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_7: [LT] Footmen of the muglex clan are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_8: [LT] I will reward you if you kill 20 muglex clan footmen. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_9: [LT] Minotaur bruisers are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_1: [LT] I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_10:
[LT] Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_11:
[LT] There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, \z
			a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_12:
[LT] Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, \z
			muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, \z
			there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_14:
[LT] There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. \z
			My whole life has been full of such steps.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_15:
[LT] Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. \z
			Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_16:
[LT] Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. \z
			Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, \z
			we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came \z
			through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. \z
			So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... \z
			There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. \z
			Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_17:
[LT] It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. \z
			I like to study their remains.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_18:
[LT] Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? \z
			And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_19:
[LT] What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. \z
			Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_2: [LT] Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_20: [LT] Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_21:
[LT] Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. \z
			Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_22: [LT] Exactly. Has a nice ring to it.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_23: [LT] She's a good listener if you should still hesitate as to the choice of your definite vocation.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_24:
[LT] Well, for him it's always been just a question of ''Your gold or your life'' - gold it is nowadays. \z
			You can stash your loose change at ol' Abram, but make sure to withdraw it once you leave Dawnport!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_25:
[LT] Ran across Inigo a few times on some remote islands, years and years ago. \z
			Talked him into coming along here, and he seems to enjoy helping newcomers find their way. \z
			Passing his knowledge on to the next generation.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_26:
[LT] We found him here half-dead and fixed him up, now he fixes us dinner and roof beams. \z
			Definitely someone you should check out for food, a rope and a shovel.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_27:
[LT] Been together through many a desperate situation. A romantic underneath it all. \z
			Found the time to specialise on spells for paladins and knights somewhere along the way.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_28: [LT] Be careful that he doesn't bore you to death with accountants of, well, your bank account history.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_29: [LT] Ah, the goblin who sneaks around here now and then? Lives in a cave to the west, somewhere.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_3: [LT] There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_4: [LT] Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_5:
[LT] <sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
		Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_6: [LT] So much to investigate, so little time...
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_7: [LT] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_8: [LT] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_9:
[LT] Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.voice_1: [LT] I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.voice_2: [LT] Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.voice_3: [LT] There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.voice_4: [LT] Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.voice_5:
[LT] <sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
		Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
