npc.mr_morris.voice_7: [LT] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.mr_morris.voice_8: [LT] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.muhad.farewell_msg_1: [LT] May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muhad.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, foreigner under the sun of Darama. What brings you {here}?
npc.muhad.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_2: [LT] I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_3: [LT] This is our home - the land of the desert.
npc.muhad.stdmod_4: [LT] We will fight that city until we get back what belongs to us.
npc.muhad.stdmod_5: [LT] We avoid these places you call cities.
npc.muhad.stdmod_6: [LT] I would go crazy living in a cage like that.
npc.muhad.stdmod_7: [LT] We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.stdmod_8: [LT] That is the curse for not following the rules of the desert. No son of the desert has ever come back from the dead.
npc.muhad.stdmod_9: [LT] We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muriel.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
npc.murim.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.murim.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.muzir.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.muzir.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.myra.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are looking for sorcerer {spells} don't hesitate to ask.
npc.myzzi.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello adventurer. It is {good} to see you.
npc.myzzi.voice_1: [LT] You need to find some heroes. Find, find, find!!
npc.nah_bob.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
npc.nah_bob.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.naji.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the Tibian bank, |PLAYERNAME| What can I do for you?
npc.naji.voice_1: [LT] It's a wise idea to store your money in your bank account.
npc.nelly.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important {potions}, {runes} and other magical equipment.
npc.nelly.voice_2: [LT] Also selling runes, potions and magical equipment!
npc.nielson.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.nielson.stdmod_1: [LT] Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nielson.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you want a round-trip passage to
npc.nielson.stdmod_5: [LT] Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to {Folda}, {Senja} and {Vega} and back to Tibia.
npc.nielson.stdmod_6: [LT] We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
npc.nielson.stdmod_7: [LT] We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
npc.nielson.voice_1: [LT] Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nilsor.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.nilsor.say_1: [LT] Do you want to travel to Svargrond?
npc.nilsor.say_10: [LT] The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores. Do you have the glimmercap spores?
npc.nilsor.say_13: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Geyser {Water} in a Waterskin.
npc.nilsor.say_14: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_15: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Fine {Sulphur}.
npc.nilsor.say_16: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_17: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the Frostbite {Herb}
npc.nilsor.say_18: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_19: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient Now bring me Purple Kiss {Blossom}.
npc.nilsor.say_2: [LT] What for ingredient do you have?
npc.nilsor.say_20: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_21: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the {Hydra Tongue}
npc.nilsor.say_22: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_23: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me {Spores} of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom.
npc.nilsor.say_24: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_25: [LT] Thank you for this ingredient. Now you finish your {mission}
npc.nilsor.say_26: [LT] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_27: [LT] Then come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_3: [LT] I have now no mission for you.
npc.nilsor.say_4: [LT] Do you want to buy a waterskin for 25 gold?
npc.nilsor.say_5: [LT] You will find this kind of cactus at places that are called deserts. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed. Do you have a part of that cactus with you?
npc.nilsor.say_6: [LT] I need fine sulphur of an inactive lava hole. No other sulphur will do. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole. Do you have fine sulphur with you?
npc.nilsor.say_7: [LT] The frostbite herb is a local plant but its quite rare. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife. Do you have a frostbite herb with you?
npc.nilsor.say_8: [LT] The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom. Do you have a blossom of a purple kiss with you?
npc.nilsor.say_9: [LT] The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop. Do you have a hydra tongue with you?
npc.nina.greet_msg_1: [LT] Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
npc.nina.stdmod_1: [LT] The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
npc.nina.stdmod_2: [LT] We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
npc.nina.stdmod_3: [LT] I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
npc.ninev.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.ninev.stdmod_1: [LT] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.ninev.stdmod_11: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.ninev.stdmod_14: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.ninev.stdmod_16: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.ninev.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.ninev.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.stdmod_2: [LT] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.ninev.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.ninev.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.ninev.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_3: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.ninev.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.ninev.stdmod_4: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.ninev.stdmod_6: [LT] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.ninev.stdmod_7: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.ninev.stdmod_8: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.stdmod_9: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.ninev.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.ninos.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ninos.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.ninos.voice_2: [LT] If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.ninos.voice_3: [LT] Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.nipuna.voice_1: [LT] I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
npc.nipuna.voice_2: [LT] If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!
npc.nokmir.say_1: [LT] I don't see how you could help me. I'm in deep, deep trouble. I'm accused of having stolen a {ring} from Rerun, but I haven't.
npc.nokmir.say_2: [LT] WHAT?! I can't believe it. You saved my life... well, at least one week of it 'cause that would have been the time I had to spend in jail. If you want to, you can pass the door now and take a look at the northern mines. Have fun!
npc.nokmir.say_3: [LT] Maybe Grombur knows more than me. The thing is he won't talk to me, and he will surely not accuse his best friend as a liar. What a dilemma!
npc.nokmir.say_4: [LT] He's a miner in the southern wing. Maybe he has lost the ring there... but even if I find the ring, no one will believe me. Someone should talk to Grombur. He's Rerun's best friend.
npc.nokmir.say_5: [LT] He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess.
npc.nomad.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.nomad.stdmod_1: [LT] I am able to grant you the heart of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you willing to part with that amount of wealth?
npc.nomad.stdmod_10: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.nomad.stdmod_11: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.nomad.stdmod_12: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.nomad.stdmod_13: [LT] I know of a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery far to the north of Tiquanda's jungles. He is bound to tell you his secrets and offer you the 'blood of the mountain'. ...\nI do not know where exactly but I guess you must first dig that one out to actually talk to him.
npc.nomad.stdmod_14: [LT] I am one with nature, one with the ice and the cold. Names are of no worth out here. Out here, you face isolation and loneliness. Only your strength, willpower and {training} can keep you alive.
npc.nomad.stdmod_15: [LT] My life is one of hardship, hardship I chose freely. Endurance, strength and the power of the will are my only companions in this frigid wilderness. My strength comes from disciplined training and knowledge of the outdoors.
npc.nomad.stdmod_2: [LT] Receive the heart of the mountain then.
npc.nomad.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.nomad.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.nomad.stdmod_5: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.nomad.stdmod_6: [LT] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.nomad.stdmod_7: [LT] Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.nomad.stdmod_8: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.nomad.stdmod_9: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.noozer.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
npc.norf.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, pilgrim. How may I {help} you? Are you in need of {healing}?
npc.norf.stdmod_1: [LT] Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?
npc.norf.stdmod_10: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_11: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.norf.stdmod_12: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_13: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norf.stdmod_14: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_15: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.norf.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.norf.stdmod_4: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.norf.stdmod_5: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_6: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.norf.stdmod_7: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_8: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_9: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norma.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.norma.stdmod_1: [LT] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.stdmod_10: [LT] I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
npc.norma.stdmod_11: [LT] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
npc.norma.stdmod_12: [LT] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.norma.stdmod_13: [LT] Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
npc.norma.stdmod_14: [LT] If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
npc.norma.stdmod_15: [LT] Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
npc.norma.stdmod_16: [LT] Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
npc.norma.stdmod_17: [LT] This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
npc.norma.stdmod_18: [LT] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
npc.norma.stdmod_19: [LT] I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.stdmod_2: [LT] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.stdmod_20: [LT] The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
npc.norma.stdmod_21: [LT] Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
npc.norma.stdmod_22: [LT] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_23: [LT] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_24: [LT] Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
npc.norma.stdmod_25: [LT] <gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
npc.norma.stdmod_26: [LT] Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
npc.norma.stdmod_27: [LT] I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
npc.norma.stdmod_28: [LT] He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
npc.norma.stdmod_29: [LT] Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
npc.norma.stdmod_30: [LT] Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
npc.norma.stdmod_31: [LT] What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
npc.norma.stdmod_32: [LT] I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
npc.norma.stdmod_33: [LT] I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
npc.norma.stdmod_34: [LT] That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
npc.norma.stdmod_35: [LT] The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
npc.norma.stdmod_36: [LT] I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
npc.norma.stdmod_37: [LT] I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
npc.norma.stdmod_38: [LT] She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
npc.norma.stdmod_39: [LT] They tell me strange stories about him and some monsters in a hole. Weird!
npc.norma.stdmod_4: [LT] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.stdmod_40: [LT] That girl thinks that she is soooo special and 'high society'. We used to be friends, but well, things change.
npc.norma.stdmod_41: [LT] That's probably someone I'll never see in my bar.
npc.norma.stdmod_42: [LT] <giggles> That monk with his holier-than-thou attitude hasn't anything against a good mug of wine now and then.
npc.norma.stdmod_43: [LT] If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!
npc.norma.stdmod_5: [LT] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.stdmod_7: [LT] I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
npc.norma.stdmod_8: [LT] It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
npc.norma.stdmod_9: [LT] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.norma.voice_1: [LT] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.voice_2: [LT] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.voice_4: [LT] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.voice_5: [LT] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
npc.nydala.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.nydala.stdmod_1: [LT] Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.nydala.stdmod_2: [LT] My name is Nydala. I run this store.
npc.nydala.stdmod_3: [LT] It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?
npc.obi.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
npc.obi.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
npc.obi.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.obi.stdmod_1: [LT] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_10: [LT] It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
npc.obi.stdmod_11: [LT] My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_12: [LT] I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.obi.stdmod_13: [LT] As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.obi.stdmod_14: [LT] If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
npc.obi.stdmod_15: [LT] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_16: [LT] Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss {Thais} and {Sam}.
npc.obi.stdmod_17: [LT] Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back.
npc.obi.stdmod_18: [LT] My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him.
npc.obi.stdmod_19: [LT] I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper {equipment} to be able to get practice!
npc.obi.stdmod_20: [LT]  told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask {Willie} or {Billy} on the farms west of here.
npc.obi.stdmod_21: [LT] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.obi.stdmod_22: [LT] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the {guards}.
npc.obi.stdmod_23: [LT] The bridge guard {Dallheim} is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it.
npc.obi.stdmod_24: [LT] Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am.
npc.obi.stdmod_25: [LT] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Lily}.
npc.obi.stdmod_26: [LT] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free.
npc.obi.stdmod_27: [LT] I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging {weapons}.
npc.obi.stdmod_28: [LT] Just ask me for a {trade} to see which things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_29: [LT] Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
npc.obi.stdmod_3: [LT] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.stdmod_30: [LT] Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers and the things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_31: [LT] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.obi.stdmod_32: [LT] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_33: [LT] I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
npc.obi.stdmod_34: [LT] I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her.
npc.obi.stdmod_35: [LT] I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me.
npc.obi.stdmod_36: [LT] I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why.
npc.obi.stdmod_37: [LT] An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_38: [LT] Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you!
npc.obi.stdmod_39: [LT] She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow.
npc.obi.stdmod_4: [LT] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_41: [LT] This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm.
npc.obi.stdmod_42: [LT] He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy.
npc.obi.stdmod_43: [LT] Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl!
npc.obi.stdmod_44: [LT] I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions.
npc.obi.stdmod_45: [LT] She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_46: [LT] I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me!
npc.obi.stdmod_47: [LT] The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words.
npc.obi.stdmod_48: [LT] I told everyone he will cause trouble. He talks people into giving him their money and putting it on the {bank}! They rather should leave it here with us honest merchants!
npc.obi.stdmod_49: [LT] He is the head of the local academy. I encouraged him to sponsor you, but no one listens to Obi, no one listens to me, as usual.
npc.obi.stdmod_5: [LT] Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_50: [LT] Well, he just buys what no one else wants. Stuff that's long dead. I can live with that, yes, I can live with that.
npc.obi.stdmod_51: [LT] What a hero, what a hero.
npc.obi.stdmod_6: [LT] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.obi.stdmod_8: [LT] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.obi.stdmod_9: [LT] The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.obi.voice_1: [LT] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.voice_3: [LT] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.voice_4: [LT] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.oblivion.greet_msg_1: [LT] A shadow preceded you. You wish?
npc.oblivion.say_1: [LT] Lost. Hidden. The keys are shadow names. Find them, they will talk to me and reveal what is hidden. Will you go on that quest?
npc.oblivion.say_2: [LT] Yes. Have you gone there and found what you sought?
npc.oblivion.say_3: [LT] Tell me. Begin with the colour.
npc.oblivion.say_4: [LT] Yes. The shadows say this is true. The beauty of House Dunesea, name it.
npc.oblivion.say_5: [LT] The floating gardens. Too beautiful to lie asleep in the memory of men. Yes. The name that is no more in Darkstone?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage to the
npc.old_adall.stdmod_3: [LT] I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.oldrak.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
npc.oldrak.say_1: [LT] How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
npc.oldrak.say_10: [LT] What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
npc.oldrak.say_12: [LT] Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
npc.oldrak.say_13: [LT] There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
npc.oldrak.say_14: [LT] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.say_15: [LT] Would you like to buy a The Holy Tible for 1000 gold?
npc.oldrak.say_16: [LT] You need to complete the quest for the book first before you can buy The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_17: [LT] Here is your The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.say_18: [LT] You do not have enough money.
npc.oldrak.say_2: [LT] You better don't return here until you've defeated the Demon Oak.
npc.oldrak.say_3: [LT] A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a {hallowed axe} to harm that tree. Bring me a simple {axe} and I'll prepare it for you.
npc.oldrak.say_4: [LT] I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
npc.oldrak.say_5: [LT] Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
npc.oldrak.say_6: [LT] You have to first talk about {demon oak} or the {mission} before we continue.
npc.oldrak.say_7: [LT] Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.
npc.oldrak.say_8: [LT] There is no axe with you.
npc.oldrak.say_9: [LT] There is not enough of money with you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_1: [LT] This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The {Dreamers}'. The order became {extinct} a long time ago.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_10: [LT] That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_11: [LT] They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_14: [LT] A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_15: [LT] Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of most powerfull magicwielders in ancient times and known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_16: [LT] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_17: [LT] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_18: [LT] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_19: [LT] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_2: [LT] Many perished in their battles against evil, some went mad, not able to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the darkness.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_20: [LT] I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_3: [LT] They learned the ancient art of {dreamwalking} from some elves they befriended.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_4: [LT] While the dreamwalkers of the elves experienenced the brightest dreams of pleasure, the humans strangely had dreams of {dark omen}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_5: [LT] They dreamed of doom, destruction, talked to dead, tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the {schemes of darkness}.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_6: [LT] They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so could foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_7: [LT] Using this knowledge they formed an order to thwart these plans, and because they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they named their order accordingly.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_8: [LT] It is rumoured to open the entrance to the pits of inferno, also called the nightmare pits. Even if I knew about this secret I wouldn't tell you.
npc.oldrak.stdmod_9: [LT] Before the battles raged across them, they were called the fair plains.
npc.oldrak.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Take care, it's dangerous out there.
npc.olrik.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.olrik.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.olrik.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.omrabas.greet_msg_1: [LT] At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. {Scroll} or {mission}?
npc.omrabas.voice_2: [LT] He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
npc.omrabas.voice_4: [LT] If I ever lay hands on him again...
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_1: [LT] Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_msg_2: [LT] Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_1: [LT] Hmm. No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_3: [LT] Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_4: [LT] Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_5: [LT] I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this {cursed} entrance.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_6: [LT] I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_7: [LT] Good bye adventurer. It was nice to talk with you.
npc.one_eyed_joe.say_8: [LT] Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
npc.ongulf.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.
npc.ongulf.voice_1: [LT] Great, another supply ship is due. How is a dwarf supposed to work under these conditions?
npc.ongulf.voice_2: [LT] Ah, there's nothing like the sound of hammers in the morning.
npc.oressa.array_1:
[LT] Then you should join the ranks of the paladins, noble hunters and rangers of the wild, who rely on the \z
					swiftness of movement and ranged attacks. ...
npc.oressa.array_2:
[LT] Paladins are jacks of all trades. They are tougher than the magically gifted and can carry more items \z
					than druids or sorcerers, but they can take not as much damage as a knight can. ...
npc.oressa.array_3:
[LT] Paladins deal more damage than knights but less than druids or sorcerers, and have the longest range \z
					in their distance attacks. ...
npc.oressa.array_4: [LT] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young adventurer. Tell me if you need help in \z {choosing} your {vocation}, or if you have {decided} on the {vocation} you want to choose.
npc.oressa.greet_msg_2: [LT] Welcome to the temple of Dawnport, child. \z If you need {healing}, I can help you. Ask me about a {vocation} if you need counsel.
npc.oressa.say_1: [LT] Then you should choose the {vocation} of a knight and become a valiant fighter with sword and shield. ...
npc.oressa.say_10: [LT] Then you should learn the ways of the druids, healers and powerful masters of natural magic. ...
npc.oressa.say_11: [LT] Druids can heal their friends and allies, but they can also cast powerful ice and earth magic to kill their enemies. They can do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_12: [LT] Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_13: [LT] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A SAGACIOUS DRUID? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_14: [LT] Then you should become a sorcerer, a mighty wielder of deathly energies and arcane fire. ...
npc.oressa.say_15: [LT] Sorcerers are powerful casters of magic. They use fire, energy and death magic to lay low their enemies. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
npc.oressa.say_16: [LT] Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
npc.oressa.say_17: [LT] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A POWERFUL SORCERER? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_18: [LT] SO BE IT. CAST OFF YOUR TRAINING GEAR AND RISE, NOBLE
npc.oressa.say_2: [LT] Knights are the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...
npc.oressa.say_20: [LT] Go through the second door from the right. Open the chest and take the equipment inside before you leave to the north. ...
npc.oressa.say_21: [LT] Take the ship to reach the Mainland. Farewell, friend and good luck in all you undertake!
npc.oressa.say_22: [LT] As you wish. If you wish to learn something about the
npc.oressa.say_3: [LT] Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...
npc.oressa.say_4: [LT] So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
npc.oressa.say_5: [LT] Then you should join the ranks of the paladins, noble hunters and rangers of the wild, who rely on the swiftness of movement and ranged attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_6: [LT] Paladins are jacks of all trades. They are tougher than the magically gifted and can carry more items than druids or sorcerers, but they can take not as much damage as a knight can. ...
npc.oressa.say_7: [LT] Paladins deal more damage than knights but less than druids or sorcerers, and have the longest range in their distance attacks. ...
npc.oressa.say_8: [LT] They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
npc.oressa.say_9: [LT] DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!

npc.ortheus.greet_msg_1: [LT] What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_1: [LT] I can't imagine a better place to live.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_10: [LT] He used to visit me for a chat, but ever since that new tavern opened I haven't seen him much anymore.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_11: [LT] He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_12: [LT] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_13: [LT] I can't imagine a better place to live
npc.ortheus.stdmod_15: [LT] I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_16: [LT] They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_17: [LT] You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_2: [LT] Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_3: [LT] Hm, good question. Maybe old, wise man?
npc.ortheus.stdmod_4: [LT] I'm used to being called old man. Simple as that.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_5: [LT] I don't know what you're talking about.
npc.ortheus.stdmod_6: [LT] Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry.
npc.oswald.stdmod_1: [LT] I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
npc.oswald.stdmod_10: [LT] It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
npc.oswald.stdmod_11: [LT] It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
npc.oswald.stdmod_12: [LT]  If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
npc.oswald.stdmod_13: [LT] It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.
npc.oswald.stdmod_14: [LT] You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?
npc.oswald.stdmod_15: [LT] What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.
npc.oswald.stdmod_16: [LT] Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?
npc.oswald.stdmod_17: [LT] I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?
npc.oswald.stdmod_18: [LT] They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.
npc.oswald.stdmod_19: [LT] This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.
npc.oswald.stdmod_2: [LT] I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_20: [LT] Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.
npc.oswald.stdmod_21: [LT] He sells his scrolls far too expensive.
npc.oswald.stdmod_22: [LT] I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.
npc.oswald.stdmod_23: [LT] He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.
npc.oswald.stdmod_24: [LT] You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
npc.oswald.stdmod_26: [LT] I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.
npc.oswald.stdmod_27: [LT] A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.
npc.oswald.stdmod_28: [LT] They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.
npc.oswald.stdmod_29: [LT]  Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.
npc.oswald.stdmod_3: [LT] I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
npc.oswald.stdmod_30: [LT] What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.
npc.oswald.stdmod_31: [LT] Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.
npc.oswald.stdmod_4: [LT] I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.
npc.oswald.stdmod_5: [LT] You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.
npc.oswald.stdmod_6: [LT] Ah, yes, yes, hail to King {Tibianus}! Long live the king and so on...
npc.oswald.stdmod_7: [LT] I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.
npc.oswald.stdmod_8: [LT] My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.
npc.oswald.stdmod_9: [LT] Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!
npc.oswald.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye, and don't come back too soon.
npc.padreia.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
npc.padreia.stdmod_1: [LT] I am the grand druid of Carlin. I am responsible for the guild, the fields, and our citizens' health.
npc.padreia.stdmod_2: [LT] Every druid is able to learn the numerous spells of our craft.
npc.padreia.stdmod_3: [LT] Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
npc.padreia.stdmod_4: [LT] I am Padreia, grand druid of our fine city.
npc.padreia.stdmod_5: [LT] Time is just a crystal pillar - the centre of creation and life.
npc.padreia.stdmod_6: [LT] We are druids, preservers of life. Our magic is about defence, healing, and nature.
npc.padreia.stdmod_7: [LT] Sorcerers are destructive. Their power lies in destruction and pain.
npc.palomino.greet_msg_1: [LT] Salutations, |PLAYERNAME| I guess you are here for the {horses}.
npc.partos.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.
npc.partos.stdmod_1: [LT] You mean that's a JAIL? They told me it's the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy roomservice!

npc.pemaret.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, young man. Looking for a passage or some fish, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.pemaret.stdmod_1: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.pemaret.stdmod_3: [LT] I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish.
npc.pemaret.stdmod_4: [LT] I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish.
npc.pemaret.stdmod_5: [LT] My fish is of the finest quality you could find. Ask me for a trade to check for yourself.
npc.pemaret.stdmod_6: [LT] It's a lovely and peaceful isle. Did you already visit the nice sandy beach?
npc.pemaret.stdmod_7: [LT] My name is Pemaret, the fisherman.

npc.penny.stdmod_1: [LT] I am miss Penny, your secretary.
npc.penny.stdmod_2: [LT] Yep, Penny's my name. You seem to be as smart as you're talkative.
npc.penny.stdmod_3: [LT] I'm a secretary. I'm organising all those papers and your mail.
npc.penny.stdmod_4: [LT] <Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
npc.penny.stdmod_5: [LT] <Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
npc.penny.stdmod_6: [LT] <Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
npc.penny.stdmod_7: [LT] You can get a letter from me.
npc.penny.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Wait... will you take me a diamond when you're back?
npc.perod.voice_1: [LT] Stop by before embarking on your great adventure! Distance weapons and general equipment on sale today!
npc.peter.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on.
npc.peter.stdmod_1: [LT] There it's even more smelly than in the factory quarter. Smells a bit like rotten eggs.
npc.peter.stdmod_11: [LT] That quara brood should be extinguished.
npc.peter.stdmod_12: [LT] The leader of their pack is the biggest criminal among them all.
npc.peter.stdmod_2: [LT] You don't look as if you would last one second there.
npc.peter.stdmod_3: [LT] One day I will walk into the office of my superior and announce my resignment. Probably not long from now.
npc.peter.stdmod_4: [LT] Good idea. Go for a walk there. Preferably six feet down.
npc.peter.stdmod_6: [LT] Go there if you wanna get beaten up.
npc.peter.stdmod_7: [LT] Sergeant first class of the Yalaharian Guard Force. But I don't care about ranks and titles.
npc.peter.stdmod_8: [LT] I can't stand those arrogant fools.
npc.peter.stdmod_9: [LT] Leave me alone with your 'mission' unless you have precise orders from my superiors.
npc.petros.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
npc.petros.stdmod_1: [LT] I'm sorry but I don't sail there.
npc.petros.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.petros.stdmod_3: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.petros.stdmod_4: [LT] My boat is ready to bring you to {Venore}, {Port Hope}, {Liberty Bay}, {Yalahar}, {Gray Island}, {Ankrahmun}, {Krailos} or {Issavi}. Or to {Travora} - a place between the worlds.
npc.petros.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.petros.stdmod_6: [LT] Where do you want to go - {Krailos}, {Venore}, {Port Hope}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Gray Island}?
npc.phillip.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!
npc.phillip.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, mighty adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Can I teach you something you don't know?
npc.phillip.stdmod_1: [LT] I am fine, thank you very much.
npc.phillip.stdmod_10: [LT] Dungeons are places of danger and puzzles. In some of them a bright mind will serve you more then a blade.
npc.phillip.stdmod_11: [LT] An interesting place you should consider to visit.
npc.phillip.stdmod_12: [LT] You don't have to thank me, it's only my duty.
npc.phillip.stdmod_13: [LT] To learn about gods, visit the temples and talk to the priests.
npc.phillip.stdmod_14: [LT] The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.
npc.phillip.stdmod_15: [LT] The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.
npc.phillip.stdmod_19: [LT] To learn about weapons read appropriate books or talk to the smiths.
npc.phillip.stdmod_2: [LT] My business is knowlegde and it is for free.
npc.phillip.stdmod_20: [LT] To learn about magic talk to the guild leaders.
npc.phillip.stdmod_21: [LT] Rebellion? What for? We are contend with our situation.
npc.phillip.stdmod_22: [LT] Tod will come and save us all. He will bring freedom and beer to the men of Carlin.
npc.phillip.stdmod_23: [LT] This servant of evil is protected by the dark gods and can't be harmed.
npc.phillip.stdmod_24: [LT] He is a follower of evil. His powers were boosted by a sinister force and he is beyond human restrictions now.
npc.phillip.stdmod_25: [LT] This weapon is said to be very powerful and unique. It was hidden in ancient times and now is thought to be lost.
npc.phillip.stdmod_3: [LT] I am honored to be teacher in this school.
npc.phillip.stdmod_4: [LT] I run this school, there are other travelling teachers who we call Loremasters.
npc.phillip.stdmod_5: [LT] If you are lucky you'll meet one in your journeys.
npc.phillip.stdmod_8: [LT] I will provide you with all knowledge I have.
npc.phillip.stdmod_9: [LT] Monsters come in different shape and power. It's said there is a zoo in the dwarfs' town.
npc.pino.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
npc.pino.stdmod_1: [LT] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.pino.stdmod_2: [LT] Never heard about a place like this.
npc.pino.stdmod_3: [LT] Do you seek a ride to
npc.pino.stdmod_6: [LT] I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Zao}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.pino.voice_1: [LT] Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!

[LT] Every Adventurer has one. \z
					The big advantage is that you can access your money in every branch of the World Bank! ...
npc.plunderpurse.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young adventurer! Harr! {Deposit} your gold or {withdraw} \z your money from your bank account. I can also explain the functions of your {bank} account to ya.
npc.plunderpurse.kw_mainland_1:
[LT] Aye, Tibia is a vast world, my friend, with plenty of adventures, harbours, and loot! \z
			The Mainland is open to everyone; but there are many beautiful islands and more cities to explore, \z
			if you have premium rights and can use a ship.
npc.plunderpurse.kw_mainland_2: [LT] Once you have reached level 8 here on this isle, you can choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland.
npc.plunderpurse.say_1: [LT] Every Adventurer has one. The big advantage is that you can access your money in every branch of the World Bank! ...
npc.plunderpurse.say_2: [LT] Would you like to know more about the {basic} functions of your bank account, the {advanced} functions, or are you already bored, perhaps?
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_10: [LT] Arrr. Not a very profitable place.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_11:
[LT] Arr! I'm a pira... er, I mean <cough> <cough> ... clerk. Banking clerk. \z
			That's what I am. You need somethin'? Bank business, p'raps?
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_12: [LT] There's a choice of four: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_13: [LT] I'm afraid this service is not available to you until you reach the World mainland.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_14:
[LT] He's an ol' trapper and knows his away around in Tibia, aye. \z
			Ask him how a thing works and he'll be sure to have an answer. ...
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_15:
[LT] Gloomy sort. Keeps glaring at me for some reason. Or maybe for no reason, harr. \z
			Formidable blacksmith, anyway. Sharpest sword blade I've seen in a long time.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_16:
[LT] Fetching white beard, I hope I grow one in due time, would impress the younger folk no end! \z
			Knowing some sorcerer and druid spells like he does wouldn't come amiss, either. \z
			Go to him if you need mage spells.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_17:
[LT] Could've used his talent to brew up some more explosive runes back in the sea fight against... \z
			ah well, you wouldn't know the name anyway. Gotta admit, his potions are good stuff.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_18:
[LT] <shifts uneasily> Well, maybe I did come across his ship some time. In bad weather. \z
			And couldn't do a thing for those poor souls. And anyway, he swam ashore here. \z
			So it all worked out in the end, see.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_19:
[LT] That's Mr Morris to you, friend. \z
			Go get yourself a useful thing to do and ask him about a quest, will you.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_2: [LT] Don't burden yourself with too much cash - store it here!
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_20:
[LT] Harrr, what a dame! Would like to buy her a pint one day. \z
			<leers> Unless she kills me with one of her icy looks first. Anyway, decent healer. \z
			Can help ya with choosing a vocation.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_21:
[LT] Aye, what about my name? You don't like it? Well, you don't have to wear it! \z
			And I am quite happy with that!
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_22: [LT] Not my line of trade, friend! Mr Morris next door will tell you what needs doin' around here.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_23:
[LT]  I could swear he looks like that old pal I met back on... \z
			ah well, much salt water passed my ship since then. \z
			If ye need a spell or two for a knight or paladin, he's the spell teacher to go to.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_24: [LT] Arrr. We go wayyyy back, Keeran an' me. Best you ask him, I'm no good at details.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_3: [LT] Don't take the money and run - deposit it and walk instead!
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_4:
[LT] Yeah, well, some romantic at work there. \z
			Island was reached at dawn, new heroes and adventurers forthcoming, stuff like that.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_5:
[LT] Ah, wonderful stuff! That and a bottle o' rum, o'course! Harrharr. \z
			You have some gold you want to deposit or withdraw, just tell me.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_6: [LT] You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_7:
[LT] Once you are on the Tibian mainland, you can access new functions of your bank account, \z
			such as changing money, transferring money to other players safely or taking part in house auctions.
npc.plunderpurse.stdmod_9:
[LT] Here on Dawnport, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, \z
			so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. \z
			Ask me for your balance to learn how much money you've already saved
npc.plunderpurse.voice_2: [LT] Don't burden yourself with too much cash - store it here!
npc.plunderpurse.voice_3: [LT] Don't take the money and run - deposit it and walk instead!
npc.pompan.farewell_msg_1: [LT] It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.pompan.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
npc.prezil.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.prezil.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.prezil.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.prezil.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.prezil.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.prezil.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.prezil.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.prezil.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.prezil.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.prezil.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.prezil.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.prezil.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.prezil.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.prezil.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.prezil.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.prezil.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.prezil.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.prezil.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.prezil.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.prezil.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.prezil.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.prisoner.voice_6: [LT] Please! I beg you to stop!
npc.puffels.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yeah, another fool {disturbing} me, what a joy.
npc.puffels.stdmod_1:
