npc.pukosch.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.pydar.farewell_msg_1: [LT] May the fire in your heart never die, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.pydar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|! I can smell the scent of a phoenix on you!
npc.pydar.stdmod_1: [LT] The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
npc.pydar.stdmod_10: [LT] May the great flame devour them all!
npc.pydar.stdmod_11: [LT] Life feeds on fire and ultimately fire will feed on life.
npc.pydar.stdmod_12: [LT] A weapon too powerful to be wielded by mortals. It has to be returned to the fire which gave birth to it.
npc.pydar.stdmod_13: [LT] If he ever dares enter Kazordoon I will gladly dump him into the lava. Tthe sacred flame shall bring justice upon him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_14: [LT] Our city was founded in ancient times. Abandoned by the gods we once fought for, we created a secure haven for our people.
npc.pydar.stdmod_15: [LT] This mountain is said to be the oldest in the world. It is the place where fire and earth meet and separate at the same time.
npc.pydar.stdmod_16: [LT] Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_17: [LT] Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
npc.pydar.stdmod_18: [LT] She is the first knight of Kazordoon. She is responsible for teaching our young warriors how to handle an axe.
npc.pydar.stdmod_19: [LT] Etzel is a true master of the elements. He is a role-model for our youngsters, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the spark of the phoenix, pilgrim.
npc.pydar.stdmod_20: [LT] He and his wife are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_21: [LT] He is a smith. If you are looking for exquisite weapons and armour just talk to him.
npc.pydar.stdmod_22: [LT] She and her husband are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
npc.pydar.stdmod_23: [LT] Uzgod is a weaponsmith just like those in the old legends.
npc.pydar.stdmod_24: [LT] Though we are through with the so-called gods, Durin, the first dwarf to aquire divine powers of his own, is considered a protector of our race.
npc.pydar.stdmod_25: [LT] Unlike the gods, the elements don't use mortals as toys, A skilled mind can understand and even control them to some extent.
npc.pydar.stdmod_26: [LT] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_27: [LT] You can receive the Spiritual Shielding in the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais.
npc.pydar.stdmod_28: [LT] Ask for the Fire of the Suns in the Suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.pydar.stdmod_29: [LT] The druids north of Carlin can provide you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.pydar.stdmod_30: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_31: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_32: [LT] I'm the head pyromancer of Kazordoon. I guess you are here for healing or looking for a blessing.
npc.pydar.stdmod_33: [LT] There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.pydar.stdmod_34: [LT] We are the keepers and shepherds of the elemental force of {fire}.
npc.pydar.stdmod_4: [LT] The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
npc.pydar.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the head pyromancer of Kazordoon.
npc.pydar.stdmod_6: [LT] My name is Pydar Firefist, Son of Fire, from the Savage Axes.
npc.pydar.stdmod_7: [LT] Ask around. There's a lot to do, jawoll.
npc.pydar.stdmod_9: [LT] It's the fourth age of the yellow flame.
npc.pydar.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] May the fire in your heart never die.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.farewell_msg_1: [LT] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_1: [LT] LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_10: [LT] YOU LITTLE MAGGOT. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU CAN HANDLE A FIGHT AGAINST MY KIND.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_11: [LT] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_12: [LT] EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_13: [LT] I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_14: [LT] BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILLY AND I NEVER REGRET IT. MY {TREASURE} IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_2: [LT] ALRIGHT. BUT FIRST OF ALL I WANT YOU TO BRING ME SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE. SURPRISE ME....AND IF I LIKE IT, YOU MAY GET WHAT YOU DESERVE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_3: [LT] HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_4: [LT] I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_5: [LT] AS YOU WISH. WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO OFFER?
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_6: [LT] I LIKE THAT AND GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH FOR THE NEXT FEW MINUTES. COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME MORE TREASURES.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_7: [LT] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_8: [LT] THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE
npc.pythius_the_rotten.stdmod_9: [LT] TELL ME IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. MY TREASURE THIRSTS FOR GOLD.
npc.pythius_the_rotten.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_1: [LT] I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_10: [LT] I am Queen Eloise. For you it's 'My Queen' or 'Your Majesty', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_11: [LT] I don't care about gossip like a simpleminded male would do.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_12: [LT] Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_15: [LT] Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_16: [LT] We honor the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_17: [LT] All citizens of Carlin are my subjects. I see them more as my childs, though, epecially the male population.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_18: [LT] This beast scared my cat away on my last diplomatic mission in this filthy town.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_19: [LT] He is the scourge of the whole continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_20: [LT] The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_21: [LT] Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_22: [LT] Visit the church or the townguards for help.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_23: [LT] I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_24: [LT] Our city is rich and prospering.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_25: [LT] I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_26: [LT] Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_27: [LT] Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_28: [LT] Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_29: [LT] We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_3: [LT] Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_30: [LT] The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_31: [LT] I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_32: [LT] Ask one of the soldiers about that.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_33: [LT] Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_34: [LT] They dare to reject my reign over them!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_35: [LT] Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_36: [LT] My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_38: [LT] The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_39: [LT] They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_4: [LT] I remember about those uniforms, they had a camouflage inlay so they could be worn the inside out too. I will send some color samples via mail to Mr. Postner.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_41: [LT] It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_42: [LT] The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43: [LT] The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_44: [LT] The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_45: [LT] Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_46: [LT] The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47: [LT] The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_48: [LT] Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49: [LT] A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_50: [LT] If you want a reward, go and bring me something this silly King Tibianus wants dearly!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_51: [LT] A dusgusting organisation, which could be only created by men.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_52: [LT] It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_7: [LT] The uniforms of our guards and soldiers are of unparraleled quality of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_8: [LT] I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_9: [LT] We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
npc.quentin.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.quentin.stdmod_1: [LT] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.quentin.stdmod_11: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.quentin.stdmod_14: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.quentin.stdmod_16: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.quentin.stdmod_18: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.quentin.stdmod_19: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_2: [LT] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.quentin.stdmod_20: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.quentin.stdmod_21: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_22: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_23: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_24: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_25: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.quentin.stdmod_27: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.quentin.stdmod_28: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_29: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.quentin.stdmod_3: [LT] Ah, I see you brought a stake with you. Are you ready to receive my line of the prayer then?
npc.quentin.stdmod_30: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.quentin.stdmod_31: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.quentin.stdmod_4: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.quentin.stdmod_6: [LT] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.quentin.stdmod_7: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.quentin.stdmod_8: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_9: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.quentin.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.rabaz.greet_msg_1: [LT] Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.rachel.stdmod_1: [LT] Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.
npc.raffael.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.raffael.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_1: [LT] Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
npc.rafzan.stdmod_10: [LT] They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_11: [LT] Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_12: [LT] Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_13: [LT] Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_14: [LT] Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_2: [LT] Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_3: [LT] Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_4: [LT] You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_5: [LT] To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_6: [LT] Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_7: [LT] Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_8: [LT] So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_9: [LT] Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_1: [LT] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_10: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_12: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_13: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_14: [LT] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_15: [LT] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_16: [LT] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be power and compassion'. Now, bring your stake to Brewster in Port Hope for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_18: [LT] You should visit Brewster in Port Hope now.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_19: [LT] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_2: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_20: [LT] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_21: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_22: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_23: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_24: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_25: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_26: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_27: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_28: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_29: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_3: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_30: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_31: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_32: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.rahkem.stdmod_5: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rahkem.stdmod_8: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rahkem.voice_1: [LT] Please, not so loud, not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_1: [LT] Now that we have arrived you should waste no time and fight your way to the lair of evil and destroy its master before its too late!
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_2: [LT] Me humble name is Rapanaio. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rapanaio_boat.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.rapanaio_boat.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {evil isle}.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_3: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_4: [LT] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rapanaio_boat.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of this sailing-ship.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. I can travel you to {kazordoon}.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_2: [LT] Do you seek a passage to
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_3: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_4: [LT] My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
npc.rapanaio_isle_of_evil.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of this sailing-ship.
npc.rashid.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
npc.rashid.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.rashid.stdmod_1: [LT] I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_10: [LT] Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid.stdmod_12: [LT] I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid.stdmod_13: [LT] When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid.stdmod_15: [LT] I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid.stdmod_17: [LT] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid.stdmod_18: [LT] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid.stdmod_2: [LT] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid.stdmod_20: [LT] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid.stdmod_21: [LT] It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid.stdmod_22: [LT] Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
npc.rashid.stdmod_3: [LT] Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid.stdmod_4: [LT] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid.stdmod_5: [LT] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid.stdmod_6: [LT] I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid.stdmod_7: [LT] Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid.stdmod_8: [LT] It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid.stdmod_9: [LT] Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
npc.rashid_custom.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
npc.rashid_custom.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_1: [LT] I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_10: [LT] Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_12: [LT] I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_13: [LT] When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_15: [LT] I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_17: [LT] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_18: [LT] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_2: [LT] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_20: [LT] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_21: [LT] It's almost time to journey on.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_4: [LT] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_5: [LT] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.

npc.rata_mari.greet_1: [LT] Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.greet_msg_1: [LT] Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.rata_mari.stdmod_1: [LT] Your power of observation is stunning. Yes, I'm a rat.
npc.rata_mari.stdmod_2: [LT] Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
npc.raymond_striker.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.razan.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.red_lilly.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello sweetie. If you need general equipment, stuff like that, let me know.
npc.red_lilly.kw_quara_1: [LT] The quara are the curse of the sea. Everybody that dares to enrage the sea spirits has to fear their vengeance. They come at night to kidnap people who forgot their lucky charms at home ...
npc.red_lilly.kw_quara_2: [LT] Sometimes those evil beings take the most naughty children to raise them as their own underwater.
npc.red_lilly.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy vials of oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the empty one.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_1: [LT] Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_10: [LT] What interest could a king have in this little settlement? If a king cares about us, there must be something important behind all this.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_11: [LT] Liberty comes, liberty goes, only the bay stays. Hehe.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_12: [LT] I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_13: [LT] That guy is a shrewd trader, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_14: [LT] I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_15: [LT] Mostly, pirates are bad for business. But sometimes, they are good for business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_16: [LT] Sadly the workers have hardly enough money to buy something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_17: [LT] Ah, there is little in the world that comes close to the taste of rum.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_18: [LT] I heard there is a fine bounty on his head. Would be a shame though to lose such a handsome man to the executioner <winks>.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_19: [LT] Sugar lets the money flow. We depend heavily on it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_2: [LT] Just between you and me hun, that woman is a witch. Love potions, poison, voodoo dolls to torture your neighbour. You name it, she got it.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_20: [LT] Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of no use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_21: [LT] I heard Venore will soon acquire several trade monopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_22: [LT] Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who know this or that about voodoo and not all of them are up to something good. Just buy some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_23: [LT] A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think no one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_24: [LT] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial. Ok?
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_25: [LT] Hmm, but please keep Tibia litter free.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_26: [LT] You don't have any empty vials.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_3: [LT] Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you know? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_4: [LT] Kshh!! No talks about ... the magic folk here ... This might draw their attention.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_5: [LT] Hard to imagine that this fat man has such a pretty daughter.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_6: [LT] Don't mention HIM in my house you fool. You call evil and mayhem upon us.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_7: [LT] I am not dealing with food.
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_8: [LT] I won't say anything bad about such a high-born person. That's why I remain silent hun .
npc.red_lilly.stdmod_9: [LT] I run this little pawnshop, hun, but I think you knew that already.
npc.red_lilly.voice_1: [LT] Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!
npc.richard.array_1:
[LT] I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. \z
					So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm.
npc.richard.array_2: [LT] Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.
npc.richard.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.
npc.richard.say_1: [LT] I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm.
npc.richard.say_2: [LT] Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.
npc.richard.say_3: [LT] Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya!
npc.richard.say_4: [LT] Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_1: [LT] Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.stdmod_10:
[LT] You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. \z
			Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. \z
			Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.
npc.richard.stdmod_11:
[LT] Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. \z
			I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.
npc.richard.stdmod_12:
[LT] Can you believe how old he is? He won't say it, \z
			but I wouldn't be surprised if he had been around for loooooong time.
npc.richard.stdmod_13:
[LT] Don't talk to ME about squirrels! <shudders> Had to live off them the first days, \z
			when they were the only thing to go into my self-made acorn traps. Nasty.
npc.richard.stdmod_14:
[LT] Don't know what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. \z
			Always has a quest or two where he needs help, if you're looking for adventuring work.
npc.richard.stdmod_15:
[LT] Quiet little lady, her. Knows her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff \z
			but mostly spends her time in the temple, helping younglings like you choose a vocation.
npc.richard.stdmod_16:
[LT] You know, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that gold in the bank, \z
			I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some gold \z
			to spend on booze and babes! <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_17:
[LT] Tries to act tough, but he's quite a witty and decent bloke who wouldn't hurt a fly. \z
			We enjoy a good laugh together in the evenings.
npc.richard.stdmod_2: [LT] Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.stdmod_4: [LT] A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.stdmod_5: [LT] Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.stdmod_6:
[LT] Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.richard.stdmod_7: [LT] Richard. Just Richard. Lost my surname with my past in that storm. <winks>
npc.richard.stdmod_8:
[LT] This lovely island here. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. \z
			Nasty things though live underground, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you!
npc.richard.stdmod_9: [LT] <shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.
npc.richard.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
npc.richard.voice_2: [LT] Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
npc.richard.voice_4: [LT] A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
npc.richard.voice_5: [LT] Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
npc.richard.voice_6:
[LT] Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
npc.riddler.farewell_msg_1: [LT] HEHEHE! I knew you don't have the stomach.
npc.riddler.greet_msg_1: [LT] |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!
npc.riddler.say_1: [LT] FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... \z So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: \z What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
npc.riddler.say_2: [LT] HOHO! You have learned your lesson well. \z Question number two then: Who or what is the feared Hugo?
npc.riddler.say_3: [LT] Hm. I bet you think you're smart. All right. \z How about this: What does everybody want to become but nobody to be?
npc.riddler.say_4: [LT] UHM UH OH ... How could you guess that? Are you mad??? All right. \z Penultimate question: What is the opposite?
npc.riddler.say_5: [LT] NO! NO! NO! That can't be true. You're not only mad, you are a complete idiot! \z Ah well. Here is the last question: What is 1 plus 1?
npc.riddler.stdmod_1: [LT] This tower, of course, silly one. It holds my {master'}s {treasure}.
npc.riddler.stdmod_2: [LT] His name is none of your business
npc.riddler.stdmod_3: [LT] I am guarding the treasures of the tower. Only those who pass the {test} of the three sigils may pass.
npc.riddler.stdmod_4: [LT] I am known as the riddler. That is all you need to know.
npc.riddler.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the guardian of the paradox tower.
npc.riddler.stdmod_6: [LT] The key of this tower! You will never find it! A malicious plant spirit is guarding it!.
npc.robson.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.
npc.robson.voice_2: [LT] Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was not that bad but now I'm becoming a tourist attraction!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Promise to come back sometime, will ya?
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.greet_msg_1: [LT] Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_1: [LT] Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_2: [LT] No, you got it all wrong! I said I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_3: [LT] I can help you buy trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_4: [LT] Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Hey! Don't leave me alone with all these lunatics!
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome, this is the {Gray Beach temple}, |PLAYERNAME|. Whether you are wounded, poisoned - or wait, don't tell me - yes, this is probably a case of being more emotionally hurt, I will do my best to {heal} you.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_1: [LT] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_11: [LT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_12: [LT] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_13: [LT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_14: [LT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_15: [LT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_16: [LT] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_17: [LT] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_18: [LT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_19: [LT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_2: [LT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_20: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_21: [LT] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_22: [LT] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_23: [LT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_24: [LT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_4: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7: [LT] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9: [LT] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rokyn.greet_msg_1: [LT] Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.rokyn.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.romella.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
npc.romella.greet_msg_1: [LT] I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_1: [LT] Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_10: [LT] Don't go exploring without weapons. Especially you'll need a machete.
npc.romella.stdmod_2: [LT] I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
npc.romella.stdmod_3: [LT] I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_4: [LT] I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_5: [LT] Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
npc.romella.stdmod_6: [LT] It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
npc.romella.stdmod_7: [LT] I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
npc.romella.stdmod_8: [LT] Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
npc.romella.stdmod_9: [LT] I heard the amazons are after it.
npc.romella.voice_1: [LT] Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romir.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, traveller. I'm a magical trader and trainer for sorcerer spells. How may I help you?
npc.roswitha.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?
npc.rotem_valos.voice_1: [LT] <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.
npc.rottin_wood.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
npc.rowenna.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to the finest weaponshop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|! Tell me if you're looking for a good {trade}.
npc.rowenna.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.rudolph.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.rudolph.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.saideh.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello, my name is Saideh. Once this was the entry to the crypt of our heroes. One of the graves belongs to our beloved hero Dayyan. Nowadays it is not a good idea to visit this place.
npc.sam.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
npc.sam.stdmod_1: [LT] Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sam.stdmod_2: [LT] I am the blacksmith. If you need weapons or armor - just ask me.
npc.sam.voice_1: [LT] Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sandra.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.
npc.sandra.stdmod_1: [LT] Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.stdmod_2: [LT] If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.
npc.sandra.stdmod_3: [LT] I sell potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.sandra.voice_1: [LT] Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.voice_2: [LT] If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.
npc.sane_mage.greet_msg_1: [LT] ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_1: [LT] Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_2: [LT] What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3: [LT] Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4: [LT] I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5: [LT] I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6: [LT] Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_7: [LT] Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_8: [LT] Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_9: [LT] You want to help me? HELP me? You? Who... who are you anyway? Ah nevermind.
npc.sane_mage.voice_1: [LT] Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.voice_2: [LT] What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.voice_3: [LT] Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_10: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I gave you a fish to eat?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_11: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw Zirella! Did you?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_12: [LT] Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! It's great to see you. If you like, we can chat a little. Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
npc.santiago.greet_msg_2: [LT] Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_3: [LT] Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_4: [LT] Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_5: [LT] Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_6: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_7: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if those nasty cockroaches {hurt} you! Did they?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_8: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if I should demonstrate some damage on you. Let's do it, {okay}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_9: [LT] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I was about to show you how you regain health, right?
npc.santiago.voice_1: [LT] Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
npc.santiago.voice_3: [LT] Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
npc.santiago.voice_4: [LT] Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!
npc.santiago.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.sarina.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.sarina.sendtrade_msg_1: [LT] Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.sarina.voice_1: [LT] General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!
npc.scott.voice_1: [LT] Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!
npc.scrutinon.greet_msg_1: [LT] |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_2: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_2: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_3: [LT] Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Nargor}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_4: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_2: [LT] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_3: [LT] Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_4: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_5: [LT] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.ser_tybald.array_1:
[LT] Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.array_2:
[LT] There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.array_3:
[LT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an \z
			effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.array_4:
[LT] Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.array_5:
[LT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once \z
			you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.array_6: [LT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_1: [LT] Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: [LT] Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: [LT] Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: [LT] Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: [LT] There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: [LT] I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: [LT] A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: [LT] However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: [LT] There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: [LT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: [LT] Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: [LT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: [LT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: [LT] The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: [LT] Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: [LT] The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_1: [LT] In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_10: [LT] Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11: [LT] Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12:
[LT] A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13:
[LT] A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14:
[LT] Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15:
[LT] Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16:
[LT] He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17:
[LT] Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_2:
[LT] In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4:
[LT] I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6:
[LT] Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_7: [LT] I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8:
[LT] Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9:
[LT] A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.serafin.greet_msg_1: [LT] Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
npc.serafin.stdmod_1: [LT] There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost.
npc.servant_sentry.greet_msg_1: [LT] The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
npc.servant_sentry.stdmod_4: [LT] Our. Master. Is. Gone. You. Can. Not. Visit. Him! We. Stand. {Sentry}!
npc.servant_sentry.stdmod_5: [LT] {Master}. Conducted. Experiments. Great. Problems. You. Must. Go!
npc.servant_sentry.stdmod_6: [LT] {Slime}. Dangerous. We. Have. It. Under. Control. ... We. Will. Stand. {Sentry}.
npc.seymour.farewell_1: [LT] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.greet_1: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_1: [LT] Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.stdmod_10: [LT] Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_100: [LT] Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
npc.seymour.stdmod_101: [LT] A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_102: [LT] Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
npc.seymour.stdmod_103: [LT] In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_104: [LT] The oracle is a mysterious being just upstairs. It will bring you to the {Island of Destiny} to choose your {vocation} once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_105: [LT] Yes, Paulie is very important. He is the local {bank} clerk.
npc.seymour.stdmod_107: [LT] Tom the tanner buys fresh {corpses}, minotaur leather and paws. Always good to make some {money} if you can carry the corpses there fast enough.
npc.seymour.stdmod_108: [LT] He's the guard on the north {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {monster} locations. Just ask him about monsters!
npc.seymour.stdmod_109: [LT] He's the guard on the west {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {monster} locations. Just ask him about monsters!
npc.seymour.stdmod_11: [LT] HEY! You don't have so many!
npc.seymour.stdmod_12: [LT] Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_13: [LT] Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.stdmod_14: [LT] Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_15: [LT] HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_16: [LT] Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_17: [LT] Do you have a suitable present box for me?
npc.seymour.stdmod_18: [LT] THANK YOU! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.
npc.seymour.stdmod_19: [LT] HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_2: [LT] Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_20: [LT] Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
npc.seymour.stdmod_21: [LT] You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
npc.seymour.stdmod_22: [LT] For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young lady!
npc.seymour.stdmod_23: [LT] For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young man!
npc.seymour.stdmod_24: [LT] This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_25: [LT] It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
npc.seymour.stdmod_26: [LT] My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
npc.seymour.stdmod_27: [LT] At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_28: [LT] I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
npc.seymour.stdmod_29: [LT] Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_3: [LT] Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.stdmod_30: [LT] In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
npc.seymour.stdmod_31: [LT] Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
npc.seymour.stdmod_32: [LT] Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: [LT] Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: [LT] Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: [LT] Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: [LT] The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: [LT] There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: [LT] Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: [LT] Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: [LT] Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: [LT] Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: [LT] Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: [LT] We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: [LT] The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: [LT] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: [LT] Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: [LT] Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: [LT] You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: [LT] Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: [LT] One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: [LT] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: [LT] The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: [LT] There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: [LT] Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: [LT] Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: [LT] Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: [LT] You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: [LT] You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: [LT] A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: [LT] You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: [LT] A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_6: [LT] Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_60: [LT] Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: [LT] The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_62: [LT] The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_63: [LT] A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_64: [LT] I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
npc.seymour.stdmod_65: [LT] Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_66: [LT] Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_67: [LT] Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
npc.seymour.stdmod_68: [LT] Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
npc.seymour.stdmod_69: [LT] Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
npc.seymour.stdmod_7: [LT] Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_70: [LT] Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
npc.seymour.stdmod_71: [LT] Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
npc.seymour.stdmod_72: [LT] Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_73: [LT] The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
npc.seymour.stdmod_74: [LT] The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
npc.seymour.stdmod_75: [LT] The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_76: [LT] There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
npc.seymour.stdmod_77: [LT] You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_78: [LT] You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: [LT] The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_8: [LT] Only nonsense on your mind, eh?
npc.seymour.stdmod_80: [LT] Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
npc.seymour.stdmod_81: [LT] The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_82: [LT] To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_83: [LT] I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_84: [LT] Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_85: [LT] Shall I try and take a guess at your destiny?
npc.seymour.stdmod_86: [LT] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a sorcerer in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_87: [LT] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a druid in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_88: [LT] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a paladin in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_89: [LT] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a knight in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_9: [LT] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_90: [LT] Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.

npc.seymour.stdmod_92: [LT] Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
npc.seymour.stdmod_93: [LT] A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
npc.seymour.stdmod_94: [LT] This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_95: [LT] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_96: [LT] A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
npc.seymour.stdmod_97: [LT] Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_98: [LT] Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_99: [LT] A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
npc.seymour.voice_1: [LT] Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.voice_2: [LT] Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.voice_3: [LT] Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.voice_4: [LT] Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.walkaway_msg_1: [LT] Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!

npc.shanar.voice_2: [LT] Looking for protective spells for druids? I can teach you.

npc.shauna.stdmod_19: [LT] The city is is a peaceful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.
npc.shauna.stdmod_20: [LT] He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.
npc.shauna.stdmod_21: [LT] Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
npc.shauna.stdmod_22: [LT] Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.

npc.shauna.stdmod_24: [LT] Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
npc.shauna.stdmod_25: [LT] She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.
npc.shauna.stdmod_26: [LT] Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.
npc.shauna.stdmod_28: [LT] For me, he's the god of justice.
npc.shauna.stdmod_29: [LT] His cult is forbidden in our town.
npc.shauna.stdmod_30: [LT] Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_31: [LT] I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_32: [LT] Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_33: [LT] The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_34: [LT] For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.
npc.shauna.stdmod_5: [LT] Would you like to buy the general key to the town?
npc.shauna.stdmod_6: [LT] Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_7: [LT] If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.

npc.sherry_mcronald.farewell_msg_1: [LT] Grace our home with another visit soon, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.sherry_mcronald.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Welcome to our humble farm.
npc.sherry_mcronald.voice_1: [LT] Isn't this a beautiful day? Perfect for farming.
npc.shiantis.greet_msg_1: [LT] Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.

npc.shiantis.voice_1: [LT] Containers, decoration and general goods, all here!
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.greet_: [LT] Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
npc.shoddy_beggar.greet_msg_1: [LT] What do you want? Listen to the old madman? If you have nothing to spare, leave me alone.
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_2: [LT] That astronomer of the academy simply has no idea what he is dealing with...
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_3: [LT] Some secrets should better be left uncovered.

npc.siestaar.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.siflind.greet_msg_1: [LT] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are in need of potions or magical equipment, just ask me about my {offers}.

npc.sigurd.voice_1: [LT] Hiho adventurers, get your runes, potions, wands and rods here!

npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_2: [LT] Sir, Ma'am, have a gold coin to spare?
npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_3: [LT] I need help! Please help me!
npc.sinclair.greet_msg_1: [LT] Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. I have - very - little time, please make it as short as possible. I may be able to help you if you are here to help us with any of our tasks or missions.
npc.sinclair.voice_1: [LT] Indeed, there has to be some other way.
npc.sinclair.voice_3: [LT] Yes indeed, all of the equipment should be checked and calibrated regularly.
npc.sinclair.voice_4: [LT] No, we have to give this another go.

npc.sissek.voice_1: [LT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

npc.sister_of_jack.voice_1: [LT] Where did I put my broom? Mother?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_2: [LT] Mother?! Oh no, now I have to do this all over again
npc.skjaar.greet_msg_1: [LT] Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_1: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_2: [LT] Ah hello again |PLAYERNAME|! I still have one or two other {missions} for you. There are also some {tasks} someone needs to attend to.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_3: [LT] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_10: [LT] The people of Edron were digging there for minerals and gold. It seemed all that work was of no avail when they finally hit the motherlode. Gems, rare crystals and... water. So much that it flooded the whole system. And not a single soul escaped.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_11: [LT] I heard rumours of a fabled creature whose traces were found on an island near Carlin. It lives solely to collect all kinds of rare gems, crystals and minerals. Offering an item it does not already own, reportedly allows passage into its lair.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_2: [LT] So my initial calculations had been correct!
npc.spectulus.stdmod_3: [LT] Looks like I have to find another way then.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_4: [LT] Hm, I need to recapitulate my equipment...
npc.spectulus.stdmod_5: [LT] I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_6: [LT] I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_7: [LT] I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_8: [LT] The sea of light is what I call the endless arrangement of shiny stars in the night sky. If we fail to complete the {magic device}, science will probably never uncover its secrets.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_9: [LT] I found the cause of the initial failure. A rare component, a mirror crystal was used to store magical energy. Miscalculations within the construction damaged this fragile power source. The unleashed energy must have been devastating.
npc.spectulus.voice_2: [LT] So my initial calculations had been correct!

npc.spectulus.voice_4: [LT] Hm, I need to recapitulate my equipment...
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_1: [LT] I can't reveal much to you right now as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_2: [LT] I defeated him there in the past. It has been abandoned for many {years}, but I suspected him to return from the dead eventually, as he has done so often before.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_3: [LT] The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_4: [LT] I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.
